izzyondroid:com.topjohnwu.magisk.name: Magisk
izzyondroid:com.topjohnwu.magisk.description:
Install, upgrade, manage, configure the Universal Systemless Interface – Magisk within a single app: Magisk Manager! 
 Magisk is a systemless interface that developers can use to build custom MODs for Android devices without altering the system files.
 In a nutshell, Magisk modularizes the “systemless” modification concept, and then expands on it a bunch. Whereas before, if you were running systemless Xposed and root, you would have two different sets of hooks and mounts going on in the background to get access to the things they needed access to. With Magisk, that process is taken and done in once place, with the various modifications being installed to a shared Magisk partition, instead of each kind of doing it’s own thing.
Here are some feature highlights:
 MagiskSU: Provide root access to your device
 Magisk Modules: Modify read-only partitions by installing modules
 MagiskBoot: The most complete tool for unpacking and repacking Android boot images
 Zygisk: Run code in every Android applications' processes

izzyondroid:io.github.luantak.fokuslaunc.name: Fokus Launcher
izzyondroid:io.github.luantak.fokuslaunc.summary: Minimal launcher with clock, weather, fast app search, and gesture navigation.
izzyondroid:io.github.luantak.fokuslaunc.description:
Fokus Launcher is an Android launcher for people who want a simpler, cleaner default experience. It focuses on fast access to time, weather, and core apps with minimal visual noise.
 Home Screen 
 The home screen is intentionally minimal: a large clock and date, battery status, optional weather, configurable favorite app labels, and a configurable right-side shortcut rail. Tap the clock, date, or weather to open the apps you configure for each in settings. Primary interactions are gesture-based: swipe up to open the app drawer, swipe down to expand the notification shade, and swipe left or right to launch shortcut targets.
 App Drawer 
 The drawer supports quick search, categories you define in settings, and optional alphabetical or most-opened app order. When only one app matches a search, Fokus can launch it directly. Optional category sidebar mode replaces the inline search bar with a vertical category rail; use the search icon when you need text search. Long-pressing an app offers add to home, rename, hide, and uninstall.
 Dot search keeps you in that same field for web or in-app search. Type a period, a space, and your query, for example ". cats"; that searches in your browser by default until you change the default under Dot search in settings. For letter shortcuts, type a period, one lowercase letter, a space, and your query, for example ".a coffee" when you assigned the letter "a" there. Dot search settings also list search-capable apps and lets you add HTTPS or deep-link URL templates with a placeholder for the query.
 Customization 
 Edit home apps, configure right-side shortcuts (including launcher shortcut actions), hide or rename apps, choose a custom font, and manage launcher data from the settings screen.
 Weather 
 Weather is powered by Open-Meteo. No account or API key is required. Results are cached for 30 minutes. Location permission is optional and only used for local weather.
 Work Profile 
 Work profile apps are shown alongside personal apps in the drawer when a work profile is active on the device.
 Private Space (Android 15+) 
 On Android 15 and above (API 35+), Fokus supports Android's Private Space with lock/unlock controls and a separate section in the app drawer for private apps when the space is unlocked.
 Optional Device Controls 
 These features only work if you turn on accessibility for Fokus in Android settings.
 Double tap to lock can turn off the screen from empty home space. Return home after long lock can bring Fokus back to the foreground on unlock once the device stayed locked longer than a threshold you choose.
 First-Run Onboarding 
 On first launch, Fokus walks you through welcome, optional location permission, default-launcher setup, home-screen customization, swipe-shortcut setup, and quick gesture tips.
 Permissions 
 Fokus asks only for what it uses.
 That covers uninstall flows from the launcher, internet access for weather and dot search, optional coarse location for local weather, and hidden-profile access for Private Space on supported versions. It also covers expanding the notification shade from swipe-down gestures, battery-optimization prompts for optional long-lock behavior, and applying wallpapers you choose in settings.

fdroid:com.sysreadoutmonitor.app.name: SysReadout Monitor
fdroid:com.sysreadoutmonitor.app.summary: Everything your phone reveals about itself, as a KDE Konsole terminal
fdroid:com.sysreadoutmonitor.app.description:
SysReadout Monitor shows everything your Android phone will tell you about itself, grouped into pages you swipe between. Each page looks like a KDE Konsole session on Fedora: Breeze colours, the Hack font and a bash prompt, with colour used only for meaning (green fine, orange warning, red critical).
It works only while you look at it, and only for the page on screen, so it costs almost nothing the rest of the time.
The pages:
* sys (fastfetch): device, chipset, GPU and display; the Android build, fingerprint, security patch and how old it is, Play system update, encryption, verified boot and SELinux; how the kernel was built, bootloader and baseband; WebView and Play services versions; uptime.
* cpu (top): a meter per core, clocks, load, thermal status, every temperature sensor, the busiest processes.
* mem (free -h): RAM and swap meters, memory detail, processes by memory.
* power (upower -d): everything the battery reports: meter, voltage, current, watts, charger, cycles, capacity; with Shizuku, drain since the last charge with the screen on and off, doze, time left, use by part of the phone and by app, wake locks.
* net (ip addr; ss -tunp): connection, Wi-Fi and mobile signal in words, IP, serving cell, 5G and LTE-CA, traffic today and this month, open connections per app with server names, DNS lookups per app.
* scan: every Wi-Fi access point and Bluetooth device in range with its signal in dBm and %, how steady it is, and whether it's getting stronger. Find the best network in the garden shed, or tap a lost watch and walk until the meter fills.
* apps: screen time and unlocks today, notifications per app, foreground services still running.
* sensors: light, pressure, compass, GPS fix and every satellite, sunrise and sunset, moon phase, steps, Bluetooth devices and their battery, what's playing, next alarm.
* storage (df -h): storage meters, file systems, the biggest apps.
* journal (journalctl -f): a live event log: network and power changes, installs, app switches, services, screen and lock, new processes and connections, errors from logcat, DNS lookups, notifications.
* shell: type commands and see their output, as your own shell on the phone.
* conf: every setting as a config file, and what each access is for.
Long-press any line to copy it; pinch to change the text size.
Deeper monitoring, when you allow it. Every permission is asked for only when you tap the thing that needs it:
* Shizuku (optional, guided setup inside the app): processes, connections, per-core load, temperatures, wake locks, battery use per app, logcat, and the shell runs with the access adb has. Everything else works without it.
* Usage access: screen time, traffic per app, app sizes, app and screen events.
* Notification access: notification counts and events, what's playing.
* Location, phone, nearby devices, Bluetooth, activity: Wi-Fi and cell details, satellites, Bluetooth signal, steps.
* The optional DNS monitor, a local VPN that carries only DNS: which app looks up which server.
No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no accounts. Nothing is sent anywhere; the only network use is the optional DNS monitor passing your apps' own lookups on to the DNS server your network names, and optional reverse-DNS lookups of connection addresses.
Forked from SysReadout Launcher. Free software under the GNU GPL v3.

 Source of every app: Google Play, F-Droid, Aurora Store, Obtainium, RuStore, GetApps, Galaxy Store, AppGallery, Amazon — or an APK file, including the app it was opened from
 Install date, version, last update; filters by source; system apps optional
 Notes and your own download links (GitHub, Telegram, direct APK) for any app, plus a shared link catalog
 "What changed": installs and removals by day, comparison with another phone
 Save 
 Save the list as JSON, Markdown or CSV, share it as text, or autosave it to a file on every start
 WebDAV sync on a schedule (e.g. Nextcloud, Yandex Disk) with a folder per phone and several versions; a missed send is caught up later
 Backups of APK files you cannot get anywhere else — to a folder or to the server
 Save and restore AppShelf's own settings — to a file or the server, with or without the WebDAV password
 Restore 
 Open a saved list and see what is missing; install each app from its store, your link or an APK backup — or all of them in a row
 Updates for apps from GitHub releases
 Design 
 Material 3 Expressive, themes: system, light, dark, graphite, AMOLED black; optional transparency
 Soft blurred edges, haptic feedback, long-press help on every button
No ads, no trackers, no account. Network is used only for what you set up yourself: your WebDAV server, the link catalog and GitHub releases.

Video + is a modern video and audio player for media you own or are authorized to access. Version 5.0 brings a completely refreshed experience while continuing the app’s focus on flexible playback, personal media libraries, cloud storage, and offline viewing.
WIDE FORMAT SUPPORT
Open a broad range of video and audio file types:
• Video: MP4, MOV, M4V, MKV, AVI, WebM, 3GP, and OGV
• Audio: MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, FLAC, OGG, and Opus
• External subtitles: SRT and WebVTT
Depending on the container and device capabilities, compatible video codecs include H.264, HEVC/H.265, AV1, VP9, VP8, MPEG-4, MPEG-2, and VC-1.
Video + combines native Apple playback technology with an extended media engine for compatible formats, including advanced MKV playback. Actual compatibility depends on the codecs, profiles, subtitles, and audio tracks contained in each file.
PLAY YOUR MEDIA YOUR WAY
• Play video and audio in a wide range of popular formats
• Adjust playback speed and video display mode
• Use shuffle, repeat, queue controls, and a sleep timer
• Continue listening with background audio for supported media
• Watch with Picture in Picture
• Send supported media to compatible displays with AirPlay
• Load embedded or external subtitles and adjust subtitle timing
IMPORT FROM YOUR FAVORITE SOURCES
Bring your personal media into Video + from:
• URL links via Library > Import media > Import from URL Link
• Podcasts via Library > Import media > Podcasts (RSS / OPML)
• Files and iCloud Drive
• Photos
• Other apps using Share or Open In
• A computer on the same Wi-Fi network
• Finder or iTunes File Sharing
CONNECTED STORAGE
Connect to storage you control or have permission to access:
• Google Drive
• Microsoft OneDrive
• Dropbox
• Box
• pCloud
• Yandex.Disk 
• FTP, SMB, NFS, SFTP, WebDAV, HTTP, and HTTPS servers
• Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Subsonic, and Navidrome media servers
• Compatible UPnP and DLNA media servers
Play supported media directly from connected storage, or save your own files to the device for offline playback.
ORGANIZE AND CONTINUE
• Build playlists with local and connected media
• Keep a unified playback queue
• View technical media details
• Track recently played items
• Continue from your previous playback position
• Manage offline copies and transfer history
• Search and browse your personal library
WEB LINKS AND BOOKMARKS
The built-in browser lets you open webpages, organize bookmarks and history, and save video page links for later. Where supported by the webpage, Video + can remember playback information and help you return to where you left off.
The Online Library stores page links and playback metadata only. It does not save copies of media from websites.
PRIVATE ACCESS
Enable Passcode Lock to require a four-digit passcode whenever Video + returns from the background. Unlock quickly with Face ID or Touch ID when available. Your app passcode is stored securely in the iOS Keychain.
OPTIONAL ICLOUD SYNC
Keep playlists, saved links, playback positions, bookmarks, and browser organization available across your devices with iCloud sync. Imported media files, offline copies, cloud account sessions, and website sessions remain local to the device. File server password sync is optional and uses iCloud Keychain.
Video + does not host or provide media. Please use the app only with content you own or are authorized to access. Playback availability depends on the media format, network connection, connected service, and source availability.

flathub:com.github.varnholt.dynablaster_.description:
Dynablaster Revenge is a remake of the game Dynablaster, released by Hudson Soft in 1991.
 The goal of this remake is to keep the original game-play as untouched as possible while adding some new features such as networked multiplayer and real-time 3D rendering. In case you're not yet familiar with the original game goal, it's quite simple: Bomb all other players from the screen. Either by collecting flame extras to increase the bomb radius or by picking up bomb extras in order to have more bombs to drop you're able to surround your enemies with your bombs, or blow them away with clever bomb chain reactions.

flathub:com.play0ad.zeroad.name: 0 A.D.
flathub:com.play0ad.zeroad.description:
0 A.D. is a real-time strategy (RTS) game of ancient warfare.
 It's a historically-based war/economy game that allows players to relive
 or rewrite the history of fifteen ancient civilizations, each depicted
 at their peak of economic growth and military prowess.
 The fifteen factions are: Three of the Hellenic States (Athens, Sparta and
 Macedonia), two of the kingdoms of Alexander the Great's successors
 (Seleucids and Ptolemaic Egyptians), two Celtic tribes (Britons and
 Gauls), the Germans, the Romans, the Persians, the Iberians, the Carthaginians,
 the Han, the Mauryas and the Kushites.
 Each civilization is complete with substantially unique artwork,
 technologies and civilization bonuses.

flathub:dev.storyapps.starc.name: Story Architect (STARC)
flathub:dev.storyapps.starc.description:
Story Architect is a modern application for authors that combines flexibility and simplicity of the user interface with an incredibly rich set of features. It allows you to work on projects of different genres and forms, store all the information about your stories inside one project, and provides many opportunities to improve the life of authors.
 The main features of the application:
 Ability to maintain a project bible
 Detailed descriptions of the characters + diagram of their relationship
 Detailed descriptions of locations + map of locations
 Ability to work with screenplays, comic books, plays, audio drama and novels
 Specialized editors that automate the work on each of the forms of your works
 Ability to create an unlimited number of series within one project
 Ability to save your works in DOCX and PDF formats
 Opportunity to work on projects offline as well as collaborate with coauthors in real-time
 In par with the big modules, Story Architect provides a bunch of small tools for improving writers workflow:
 Poster designer tool
 Character name generator
 Character photo generator
 Logline generator
 AI Assistant
 Timer for organizing writing sprints
 Corkboard
 Timeline
 Statistical and visual reports
 Mind maps
 and much more
 Starc is being developed with strong authors’ involvement and support so we don’t waste the app performance on the features you don’t need.
 If you have any ideas, wishes, suggestions or comments, we are happy to discuss them to make the app even better! You can contact us through the feedback form on the site, or in any of the social networks.
 Happy writing!

Pioneer is a space adventure game set in our galaxy at the
 turn of the 31st century.
 The game is open-ended, and you are free to eke out whatever
 kind of space-faring existence you can think of. Explore
 and trade between millions of star systems. Turn to a

 At its core is an interpreter for Emacs Lisp, a dialect of the Lisp
 programming language with extensions to support text editing.
 The features of GNU Emacs include:
 Content-sensitive editing modes, including syntax coloring, for
 a wide-range of file types
 Complete built-in documentation, including a tutorial for new users
 Full Unicode support for nearly all human languages and their scripts
 Highly customizable, using Emacs Lisp code or a graphical interface
 Includes a project planner, mail and news reader, debugger
 interface, calendar, and more

fedora-packages:byaccj/byaccj.name: byaccj
fedora-packages:byaccj/byaccj.description: BYACC/J is an extension of the Berkeley v 1.8 YACC-compatible parser generator. Standard YACC takes a YACC source file, and generates one or more C files from it, which if compiled properly, will produce a LALR-grammar parser. This is useful for expression parsing, interactive command parsing, and file reading. Many megabytes of YACC code have been written over the years. This is the standard YACC tool that is in use every day to produce C/C++ parsers. I have added a "-J" flag which will cause BYACC to generate Java source code, instead. fedora-packages:cryptlib/cryptlib.name: cryptlib
fedora-packages:cryptlib/cryptlib.summary: Security library and toolkit for encryption and authentication services
fedora-packages:cryptlib/cryptlib.description: Cryptlib is a powerful security toolkit that allows even inexperienced crypto programmers to easily add encryption and authentication services to their software. The high-level interface provides anyone with the ability to add strong security capabilities to an application in as little as half an hour, without needing to know any of the low-level details that make the encryption or authentication work. Because of this, cryptlib dramatically reduces the cost involved in adding security to new or existing applications. At the highest level, cryptlib provides implementations of complete security services such as S/MIME and PGP/OpenPGP secure enveloping, SSL/TLS and SSH secure sessions, CA services such as CMP, SCEP, RTCS, and OCSP, and other security operations such as secure time-stamping. Since cryptlib uses industry-standard X.509, S/MIME, PGP/OpenPGP, and SSH/SSL/TLS data formats, the resulting encrypted or signed data can be easily transported to other systems and processed there, and cryptlib itself runs on virtually any operating system - cryptlib doesn't tie you to a single system. This allows email, files and EDI transactions to be authenticated with digital signatures and encrypted in an industry-standard format.

fedora-packages:emacs-flycheck-pychecker.name: emacs-flycheck-pycheckers

fedora-packages:emacs-flycheck-pychecker.description: This package provides a way to run multiple syntax checkers on Python code, in parallel. The list of supported checkers includes: * pylint * flake8 * pep8 * pyflakes * mypy * bandit This is an alternative way of running multiple Python syntax checkers in Flycheck that doesn't depend on Flycheck's chaining mechanism. Flycheck is opinionated about what checkers should be run, and chaining is difficult to get right. This package assumes that the user knows what they want, and can configure their checkers accordingly — if they want to run both flake8 and pylint, that's fine. This also allows us to run multiple syntax checkers in parallel, rather than sequentially.

firefox-addons:2613823.name: Consent-O-Matic
firefox-addons:2613823.summary: Automatic handling of GDPR consent forms
firefox-addons:2613823.description:
Cookie pop-ups are designed to be confusing and make you 'agree' to be tracked. This add-on automatically answers consent pop-ups for you, so you can't be manipulated. Set your preferences once, and let the technology do the rest!
This add-on is built and maintained by workers at Aarhus University in Denmark. We are privacy researchers that got tired of seeing how companies violate the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Because the organisations that enforce the GDPR do not have enough resources, we built this add-on to help them out. 
We looked at 680 pop-ups and combined their data processing purposes into 5 categories that you can toggle on or off. Sometimes our categories don't perfectly match those on the website, so then we will choose the more privacy preserving option.

firefox-addons:2723902.name: Hoplite Browser Security
firefox-addons:2723902.summary: The Hoplite Active Browser Security Addon is used to help keep clients safe without requiring VPNs, or other invasive software. This Addon helps protect you against online threats, such as links in phishing emails and websites designed to trick you.
firefox-addons:2723902.description:
The Hoplite Active Browser Security Addon is used to help keep clients safe without requiring VPNs, or other invasive software. This Addon helps protect you against online threats, such as links in phishing emails and websites designed to trick you into downloading and installing malicious software that can harm your computer. 
While you are surfing on the internet, malicious links and phishing URLs are everywhere. So this addon helps you block those phishing urls and malicious links easily. 
Using Hoplite's Active Security Addon will also provide the following benefits for your browsing:
Malvertising Protection
Web advertisements are being increasingly used as vehicles for distributing malware.
A legitimate ad can be infected by a virus or a fraudulent ad can be introduced into a network that places ads on web sites.
Faster Browsing
An ad can slow your computer and use up CPU time by reading and writing cookies, making many connections and downloading unwanted software.
“Malvertising” and other inefficient ads slow your browser’s performance by running processor intensive scripts and by reading and writing many cookies on your computer.
Improved Privacy
Cookies, Spyware and other malware spread through advertising banners can monitor your activities and steal your personal information.
This plugin is intended for either free use, and in conjunction with Hoplite Active Network Defense, and one or more industry compliance programs. 
*Free and anonymous use of this Addon provides active protection from cyber threats, and requires no registration. No personally identifiable information is gathered during free use of this addon.
*Commercial use of this Addon requires a contract and enterprise deployment to gain access to analytics and custom content filtering options.

firefox-addons:3002505.summary: Removes blur, hides the safety modal, and makes the whole product card clickable on AliExpress search pages.
firefox-addons:3002505.description:
Removes blur, hides the safety modal, and makes the whole product card clickable on AliExpress search pages.
AliExpress™ Age Verification Remover brings back a cleaner, smoother browsing experience on AliExpress™ search result pages.
No more blurred product images. No more hidden listings. No more distracting overlays standing between you and the products you want to browse.
In April 2026, AliExpress™ began introducing age verification for a wide range of products, including items that many users would not normally consider age-restricted, such as ultrasonic cutters. In some cases, users may be asked to submit highly sensitive information like an ID scan or a facial photo, while the verification itself may be handled by an external third-party company rather than AliExpress™ directly. If you care about privacy, that matters. History has already shown that identity-verification systems can create serious privacy risks, especially when sensitive personal or biometric data is involved.
This extension improves the browsing experience by removing visual blockers connected to age-verification elements directly from AliExpress™ product listings.

Find Amazon products on AliExpress
Amazon is one of the most popular and trusted online stores in the world. If you have an Amazon product that you want to buy, but you are looking for the best deals, then AliExpress might be your best bet. AliExpress is a rapidly expanding and open marketplace that sells almost anything you have ever thought of and ships all over the world.

firefox-addons:2833702.summary: Transkriptor, a browser extension powered by AI, revolutionizes transcription by making it fast, efficient, and user-friendly. Developed by expert engineers, it simplifies converting audio to text directly in your browser without extra software.
firefox-addons:2833702.description:
Transkriptor Description:
Transkriptor is an advanced transcription solution leveraging AI technology to convert speech into text with speed and accuracy. It is the ultimate tool for transcribing meetings, videos, and voice to text effortlessly, supporting a wide range of file formats for comprehensive accessibility. With 90 minutes of free transcription offered, users can explore the accuracy and efficiency of Transkriptor without initial investment.

Effortless Transcription: Convert a range of formats, including M4A, WAV, MP4, and MP3 to text. You can convert even YouTube videos to text and generate subtitles automatically with autocap. Transkriptor simplifies voice to text processes with diverse export options such as .srt, .txt, and .docx.

Accurate Dictation to Text: Our A.I. algorithm learns speech patterns, ensuring accuracy of up to 99% when converting speech to text. The platform offers transcription in more than 100 languages, serving a global user base.
Meeting Platforms Integration: Transkriptor integrates with various platforms, such as Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet. So, you can be sure that every spoken word is precisely captured.
Multilingual Translation and Subtitling: Easily translate your transcribed text into multiple languages. This feature is ideal for creating multi-lingual subtitles, expanding your content's reach to a broader audience.

firefox-addons:2932848.description:
Madomi is a real-time manga translator for Firefox. Read raw manga, manhwa, manhua and webtoons in your language, translated directly on the page as you scroll.
Open any raw chapter on any manga site and activate Madomi. It reads the Japanese, Korean or Chinese text inside every speech bubble using OCR built for manga fonts, then overlays the translation in your language. The original art stays untouched. firefox-addons:828185.name: Download with Free Download Manager (FDM)
firefox-addons:828185.summary: when activated, interrupts the built-in download manager to direct links to FDM
firefox-addons:828185.description:
This extension offers integration with Free Download Manager (FDM). By default the toolbar icon is disabled. In this mode, downloads are handled by the internal download manager. Once the extension is enabled from the toolbar button (when the icon is colorful), then an observer is installed. This observer monitors new downloads and sends requests to FDM and cancels the built-in download. 
Notes:
1. For the extension to work you need to have Free Download Manager (FDM) installed; http://www.freedownloadmanager.org/ 
2. For the extension to be able to communicate with FDM, a small native client is required. This native client can be found at https://github.com/belaviyo/native-client/releases . You will get the instruction on how to install this native client when extension tries to communicate for the first time.
For more info please visit:
 https://webextension.org/listing/download-with.html?from=fdm

bluejetty:00121889:ios.name: Pure Acid
bluejetty:00121889:ios.summary: Pure Acid is a top quality bassline synthesizer and drum machine in one app! Inspired by classic hardware bassline synthesizers and rhythm machines, which changed musical world back in 80's, like the legendary TB-303 synthesizer, TR-808 / 7
bluejetty:00121889:ios.description:
Pure Acid is a top quality bassline synthesizer and drum machine in one app! Inspired by classic hardware bassline synthesizers and rhythm machines, which changed musical world back in 80's, like the legendary TB-303 synthesizer, TR-808 / 707 / 909 rhythm boxes and their numerous replicas, Pure Acid is designed to bring back the feeling of retro analog gear in every detail in terms of sound, as well as to provide new functions previously unavailable in the original devices to make your music creation workflow fast and fun! A large number of factory preset patterns will immerse you into an exciting world of Acid House, Techno, Hardcore and Big Beat music genres, which will inspire you to create your own basslines and rhythms for your compositions!
You can use Pure Acid app as a ready-to-go realtime musical instrument (groove box) in your jam sessions together with Ableton Link to synchronize it with the rest of your music gear. Its bassline editing system and randomization options will be handy to create unique groovy basslines easily. Realtime master effects with XY-pad controls can add expression to your live performance. You can also use Pure Acid with AudioBus, AUM or other IAA-supporting apps to create complex and interesting sound setups.
Features:
• supports AUv3, Ableton Link, AudioBus, Inter-App Audio, Core Midi, Virtual Midi In/Out, Bluetooth Midi
• AudioBus state saving support
• 64-bit sound engine
• Midi Learn
• Export to midi file
• includes Multiple Output AUv3 plugin with 6 audio output busses
Bassline Section:
• 2 classic bassline waveforms: Saw and Pulse
• classic knobs: Tune, Cutoff, Resonance, Env Mod, Decay and Accent
• Distortion effect with amount, HPF and Boost knobs
• filter LFO with rate and depth knobs
Sequencer Section:
• up to 12 bassline patterns can be stored in one preset
• up to 32 steps per each bassline pattern
• patterns can be chained together to create more complex patterns
• pattern Tempo and Swing parameters
• Gate parameter, which allows you to adjust bass note lengths
• Pattern Editor allows you to copy, transpose patterns, shift notes left/right, insert or delete a note, variate (randomize all note properties expect pitch), shuffle (randomize notes order only), reverse and compose patterns using Bassline Composer function
• onscreen keyboard allows you to enter bassline notes in a comfortable way. You can also record basslines in realtime.
Drums Section:
• 16 independent drum parts
• 35 different classic drum sounds with ability to tune your own drum kit
• each drum part sound has its own parameters: Tune, Decay, Attack/Snap/Color, FX A send, FX B send, Boost, Pan, Level
• up to 12 drum patterns and 4 drum fill patterns per preset
• 16 steps per each drum pattern, with ability to add 16 "backbeat" steps between main steps (32 steps per drum pattern in total)
• patterns can be chained together to create more complex patterns
• Swing and Flam features
• Total Accent part with adjustable total accent value can give you ability to "highlight" specific steps in your drum pattern
• new: step conditions for drum steps
Mixer Section:
• 2 mixer channels: Bassline and Drums
• Drive effect for each channel
• 2 send effect pedals: FX A and FX B
• 14 send effect types
• send effect can be routed to either master output, MFX or another send effect (FX A -> FX B), which allows to chain several effects one after another
• MFX pedal with 22 effect types to choose from
• FX A and FX B send amount knobs for each mixer channel
• XY-pad on each effect pedal to control their parameters
• Master Limiter effect to prevent sound clipping
and more:
• Unlimited number of user presets
• 84 factory presets
• Audio export to wav file (16, 24 or 32 bit)
• Preset / Bank Share function
• Selectable UI color schemes with ability to adjust colors manually
• Can work either as a standalone app, or as AUv3 audio unit plugin
• Designed for both iPad and iPhone

bluejetty:00087602:ios.description:
Turn Every Lecture Into a Complete Study Kit
AcadAI is an AI-powered study companion built to help students understand lessons, save time, and study more effectively.
Record a lecture or upload your study material, and AcadAI transforms it into structured notes, clear summaries, flashcards, and personalized quizzes—all in one place.
KEY FEATURES
AI Lecture Recorder
Record your lectures and automatically capture the important concepts, explanations, and key points.
Smart Lecture Summaries
Turn long recordings into clear, organized notes without listening to the entire lecture again.
AI-Generated Flashcards
Convert your lectures and notes into bite-sized flashcards for faster, more effective revision.
Personalized Quizzes
Generate multiple-choice questions from your own study material, test your understanding, and reinforce what you have learned.
Step-by-Step Problem Solving
Take a photo or upload an academic problem to receive a detailed, easy-to-follow explanation.
Personalized Learning
AcadAI adapts its assistance based on your major, academic level, and learning preferences.
BUILT FOR STUDENTS
Whether you are preparing for an exam, reviewing a difficult lecture, or solving a complex problem, AcadAI gives you the tools to study with greater clarity and confidence.
Learning still requires effort—but AcadAI helps you focus that effort where it matters most.
Have feedback or questions? Contact us at [support@acadai.app](mailto:support@acadai.app).
NOTE: AcadAI provides educational assistance and does not offer professional academic advice. Always verify generated content and consult your educators when necessary.
Some AI features, including analysis results, require an active subscription. Subscription options and prices are displayed clearly before purchase.
Terms of Use: https://acadai.app/terms/

bluejetty:00070165:ios.description:
Is it a battle to get your child to do something quickly?
This visual countdown App was designed for my 2 year old son to help him get his reward chart star for getting dressed quickly.
Getting him dressed used to take forever with many stalling strategies being deployed. Now he runs upstairs asking for the "Countdown".
Watch as the timer runs from green to amber to red, helping the child understand that time is running out.
A fun picture is slowly revealed as the time runs down and when the time is up the child is rewarded with an exciting sound and the picture spins.
Background image changes to match the time of day, so that your child is given subtle hints as to what time of day the task they are being asked relates to.
Choose your own image to reveal from your iPhones photo library to really surprise your child.
Endless possible uses:
* Getting dressed
* Getting out the door (shoes and coats on)
* Tidying
* Brushing teeth
* Sharing toys
Turns daily struggles into fun time!

bluejetty:00178525:ios.summary: Tuner T1 Pro is the ultimate instrument tuner, designed for precision tuning of a wide range of musical instruments. Whether you're tuning a guitar, violin, viola, bass, piano, cello, flute, or any other instrument, Tuner T1 ensures impecca
bluejetty:00178525:ios.description:
Tuner T1 Pro is the ultimate instrument tuner, designed for precision tuning of a wide range of musical instruments. Whether you're tuning a guitar, violin, viola, bass, piano, cello, flute, or any other instrument, Tuner T1 ensures impeccable accuracy and ease of use. Ideal for both professional musicians and beginners, this chromatic tuner app is built to handle all common instruments with incredible precision, making it an essential tool for any musician.
Now Available on Apple Watch!
Tune directly from your wrist using the Apple Watch version, which features a fully functional chromatic tuner calibrated to standard A4 = 440 Hz. The watch app also includes a built-in tone generator, making quick tuning and pitch reference more accessible than ever.
Key Features:
• Extremely Accurate Tuning: Tune your instrument with an exceptional level of accuracy (within ±0.1 cents), ensuring perfect pitch every time.
• Chromatic Tuner for All Instruments: Tuner T1 supports a broad range of instruments, including guitar, bass, violin, viola, cello, piano, flute, and more. Whether you're tuning strings, winds, or brass, Tuner T1 has you covered.
• Tone Generator: Generate reference tones over a 3-octave range. Perfect for ear training or manual tuning when needed, the tone generator covers every note you need.
• Adjustable A₄ Frequency: For those who need custom tunings, Tuner T1 allows you to change the A₄ reference frequency from the standard 440 Hz to other frequencies to suit any musical or regional style.
• Customizable Detection Latency: Adapt the app to your specific needs by adjusting pitch detection latency. Lower latency settings allow for quicker pitch detection, ideal for fast-paced vocal practices. Higher latency settings help filter out unwanted noise and momentary sounds, providing stable tuning results—especially useful for precise instrument tuning.
• Beautiful, Simple, & Easy-to-Use Interface: Tuner T1 is designed to be intuitive, allowing you to start tuning instantly without any complicated setup. It’s built with simplicity in mind while maintaining all the advanced features you need for professional-grade tuning.
• Perfect for Professional and Amateur Musicians: Whether you're a professional musician performing on stage or an aspiring player honing your skills, Tuner T1 provides the accuracy and reliability you need to ensure your instrument is perfectly in tune every time.
• Optimized for Low-Latency Performance: Our app delivers low-latency pitch detection, ensuring quick response times without sacrificing accuracy, making it a great tool for live performances or recording sessions.
• Battery-Efficient: Tuner T1 is designed to minimize battery consumption, letting you use the app for extended tuning sessions without draining your device’s power.
Why Choose Tuner T1?
Tuner T1 stands out from other tuning apps because of its superior accuracy and low-latency pitch detection, specifically optimized for tuning a wide variety of common instruments. This app is built to cater to the needs of guitarists, violinists, pianists, and other musicians across different genres. bluejetty:00169951:ios.description:
Trench Warfare 1917 is a free fast paced action military strategy game taking place in the most brutal war, World War 1!
Play as the General of every major army in WW1 and lead your troops to victory and supremacy.
Select a variety of unique pixel units and spawn them strategically to be the hero of the war! 
Main features in the game:
- Real time strategy - simulate military battles in real time - you control everything!
- Campaigns - Play between 10 different FREE campaigns with 25 levels each! Play as Great Britain, Germany, France, Russia, Ottoman Empire, Austria Hungary, Italy, USA, Soviet Army, White Army
- Survival mode - Play as each country and survive for 50 waves. Control your own weapons and shoot down the enemy soldiers to gain supremacy!
- Creative/sandbox mode - Create and design your own levels. Recreate historical WW1 battle scenes and select from a variety of maps and different weather. You can also try spawning 1.000 tanks or flamethrowers and defeat the enemy on INSANE mode for a total war.
- Online level uploader - Save your creative levels and upload them online for others to play. Try playing one of the thousands of levels uploaded by our community from all around the world.
- Play in your own language - The game supports English, Russian, French, Spanish and Chinese
- Play offline - Play anywhere at anytime. Enjoy the game on long car rides or on the plane.
Trench Warfare 1917: WW1 RTS is a hardcore war strategy game. 
Build the strongest military army, fight in epic tank battles, and play with your own war strategy. 
To change history and win world war 1 you must defeat the enemy and fight as hard as you can with the tactical winning strategy. It’s a frontline army battle between generals and peace is on the stake - perhaps you have the power to prevent WW2?
Combine different war heroes with incredible power and build your ultimate battle team. Embark on a journey to discover new characters and fight mighty opponents along the way. It is the best game to enjoy tanks battle against any army of your choice.
10 DIFFERENT NATIONS
You can select and command the British German, French, Russian, Ottoman, Austria-Hungarian, American and Italian army. Become a WW1 hero in the ultimate Trench Warfare experience. 
Play with riflemen, shock troopers, machinegunners, snipers, tanks and a variety of special units. Command a heavy armor Sentry unit or burn up your enemies with the brutal flamethrower unit. 
BUILD AN ARMY
Become a tactical genius and use strategy when building your army. Let the heavy armor on the tanks take the bullets instead of your men. Place different soldiers, tanks and take advantage of all your army men. Use the environment and conquer the trenches.
CUSTOM LEVELS
Try out the Creative Mode where you can design your own levels. You can choose any country to play as and fight against and create alternative WW1 storylines. It can be played in 4 different difficulties, so it is up to you how large a war battle you want to create! 
You can simulate history and recreate real life world war 1 battles or you can use your fantasy and create WW2 scenarios as well!
BUILD YOUR OWN BATTLEGROUND
Build your battleground in the creative/sandbox mode according to your own strategy. Place decorations, armor bunkers / army buildings, barbed wire and tanks to sitotamulate a total war against the enemy army!
EPIC PIXEL WAR
Become an expert in the battlefield and take down all the enemy soldiers. Say yes to the call of war today and save tomorrow for the survival of humanity. 
Features of Trench Warfare 1917: WW1 RTS
- A fun and addictive real time strategy game
- An easy to play RTS pixel game
- Tactical war strategy in 250+ levels
- A survival and creative sandbox mode for an endless amount of hours
- Massive pixel war battles and total war
- Roleplay and simulation of WW1 history battles
- Bunkers and unique special troops
- Offline game supported
- A unique war game made with passion

Build the strongest military army, fight in epic tank battles, and play with your own war strategy. 

To change history and win world war 1 you must defeat the enemy and fight as hard as you can with the tactical winning strategy. It’s a frontline army battle between generals and peace is on the stake - perhaps you have the power to prevent WW2?

Combine different war heroes with incredible power and build your ultimate battle team. Embark on a journey to discover new characters and fight mighty opponents along the way. It is the best game to enjoy tanks battle against any army of your choice.

10 DIFFERENT NATIONS

You can select and command the British German, French, Russian, Ottoman, Austria-Hungarian, American and Italian army. Become a WW1 hero in the ultimate Trench Warfare experience. 

Play with riflemen, shock troopers, machinegunners, snipers, tanks and a variety of special units. Command a heavy armor Sentry unit or burn up your enemies with the brutal flamethrower unit. 

BUILD AN ARMY

Become a tactical genius and use strategy when building your army. Let the heavy armor on the tanks take the bullets instead of your men. Place different soldiers, tanks and take advantage of all your army men. Use the environment and conquer the trenches.

CUSTOM LEVELS

Try out the Creative Mode where you can design your own levels. You can choose any country to play as and fight against and create alternative WW1 storylines. It can be played in 4 different difficulties, so it is up to you how large a war battle you want to create! 

You can simulate history and recreate real life world war 1 battles or you can use your fantasy and create WW2 scenarios as well!

BUILD YOUR OWN BATTLEGROUND

Build your battleground in the creative/sandbox mode according to your own strategy. Place decorations, armor bunkers / army buildings, barbed wire and tanks to sitotamulate a total war against the enemy army!

EPIC PIXEL WAR

Become an expert in the battlefield and take down all the enemy soldiers. Say yes to the call of war today and save tomorrow for the survival of humanity.

bluejetty:00078234:ios.description:
Turn the thousands of photos on your phone into beautiful photo books you’ll love flipping through.
Once Upon is a simple photo book maker with high-quality Scandinavian design, B Corp certification, and over 9.6M downloads worldwide. Pick your photos and Once Upon places them in a clean, ready-to-edit layout, so you can go from camera roll to keepsake in just a few minutes.
Create a photo book for every kind of memory: family life, vacations, birthdays, weddings, baby albums, yearbooks, pet photos, kids’ drawings, recipes, or the little moments you do not want to forget.
Why create with Once Upon?
- Make photo books from your phone, tablet, or computer
- Choose up to 894 photos for one book
- Create books with up to 300 pages
- Start from scratch or let Once Upon arrange your photos for you
- Add captions to remember the story behind each picture
- Invite friends and family to create collaborative albums
- Create several books and photo prints at the same time
- Covered by our customer satisfaction guarantee
How Once Upon works
1. Choose photos from your phone, tablet, computer, Google Photos, or iCloud
2. Let Once Upon place them in a clean photo book layout
3. Add captions, move pages, change layouts, and adjust your cover
4. Choose your format and paper type, then order when you are ready
Our photo books
Once your book is created, choose the format that fits your story. All Once Upon photo books have a timeless square format and are designed to make your memories easy to keep, share, and come back to.
Softcover Medium, 8x8"
Hardcover Medium, 8x8", album title printed on spine
Hardcover Large, 11x11", album title printed on spine
Choose from silk matte or semi-gloss paper.
More helpful features
- Google Photos connection and iCloud sync where supported
- Projects backed up so you can keep creating across devices
- Copy spreads between books to keep multiple versions simple
- Easy photo selection with dates sorted by month
- Drag and drop to arrange your pages
- Try different layouts and find the look you like best
Photo prints
Want a smaller keepsake? Create high-quality photo prints in 5x7". Choose matte or semi-gloss paper, with portrait or landscape format depending on your photo.
Made with care
Once Upon is B Corp certified and designed to help you preserve meaningful memories in a more thoughtful way. Our photo books and photo prints are printed as close to you as possible through our print partners in Australia, Germany, the Netherlands, Sweden, the UK, and the USA.
Questions, or just want to say hi? Reach us at happytohelp@onceupon.se.
Find more photo book inspiration on Instagram: @onceuponapp.

bluejetty:00180113:ios.name: Link Master: Logic Puzzles
bluejetty:00180113:ios.summary:
Explore four types of line and path puzzles in one game.
Connect matching colors, follow number sequences, draw paths in one stroke, and plan routes that fill every cell. Start with simple puzzles and progress through increasingly complex
bluejetty:00180113:ios.description:
Explore four types of line and path puzzles in one game.
Connect matching colors, follow number sequences, draw paths in one stroke, and plan routes that fill every cell. Start with simple puzzles and progress through increasingly complex levels that test your observation, planning, concentration, and spatial reasoning.
FOUR PUZZLE MODES
1. Connect Colors
Connect dots of the same color without letting the paths cross. Complete every pair and fill the grid to clear the level. The puzzles begin simply, but larger boards require careful planning.
2. Number Path
Start from 1 and connect the numbered points in the correct order. Follow the sequence, choose the right route, and complete each board without missing a number.
3. One-Line Puzzle
Connect every required point with one continuous stroke. Study the shape before you begin and find a route that completes the entire pattern without lifting your finger.
4. Fill Every Cell
Start from the marked position and draw a route through every cell. Plan each move carefully so that no space is left uncovered.
GAME FEATURES
• Four different logic puzzle modes
• Thousands of levels to complete
• Multiple difficulty levels
• Simple touch controls
• Short puzzles for quick play sessions
• Increasingly challenging boards
• Color, number, line, and grid-based puzzles
EASY TO LEARN, CHALLENGING TO MASTER
The basic rules are simple, but later levels require more planning and precision. Try different routes, restart when necessary, and discover the correct solution for every puzzle.
PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Complete a quick puzzle during a break or take your time with a more difficult level. Each mode offers a different type of challenge, from matching colors to planning routes across an entire grid.
Test your logic, complete every path, and see how many puzzles you can solve.

bluejetty:00068353:ios.description:
++++ Master Your Mobile Connectivity with 69M+ Towers Worldwide ++++
Transform your mobile experience with FindTower, the most comprehensive cell tower locator app that puts the power of 69 million towers at your fingertips. Whether you're troubleshooting weak signals, planning travel routes, or optimizing your mobile setup, FindTower delivers precise tower locations and advanced network insights.
--- Key Features ---
Precision Navigation
Navigate directly to towers with our built-in compass feature. See exactly where to point your antenna or position your device for optimal signal strength.
Power Search Technology
Uncover hidden cell infrastructure using advanced carrier filtering. Our Power Search feature uses MCC/MNC codes and network type filtering to discover towers that standard searches miss.
Smart Phone Lookup
Get detailed carrier information for any phone number. Identify which network a number belongs to, perfect for understanding coverage patterns.
Best Carrier Analysis
Find the optimal carrier for your location with our intelligent analysis. Compare coverage, signal strength, and network performance across all major providers.
Interactive Tower Mapping
- View all nearby cell towers on an intuitive map interface
- Filter by carrier, network type (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G), and distance
- Tap any tower for detailed technical information, including MCC/MNC codes, cell IDs, and signal strength
Advanced Network Analysis
- Real-time signal strength monitoring
- Network speed testing with detailed metrics
- Coverage pattern analysis and optimization recommendations
Professional-Grade Tools
- Street View integration for 3D tower visualization
- Auto-refresh functionality for dynamic tower discovery
- Geo-search capabilities for worldwide tower lookup
Remote Workers & Digital Nomads
Find the best spots for video calls and reliable internet access. Never miss an important meeting due to poor connectivity.
RV Travelers & Outdoor Enthusiasts
Plan your routes with confidence, knowing exactly where you'll have cell coverage. Perfect for camping, hiking, and remote adventures.
Network Professionals & Technicians
Access detailed tower information, carrier codes, and technical specifications. Essential for field work and network optimization.

- Actual tower locations with precise coordinates and technical details
- Advanced filtering by carrier, network type, and distance

- Global database of 69 million towers with regular updates
- Intuitive interface designed for both casual users and professionals

- Phone number lookup and carrier identification
- Street View integration for 3D tower visualization

- Compass navigation for precise tower targeting

- Intuitive user interface

bluejetty:00024071:ios.summary: Transform your weight loss journey and embrace a healthier lifestyle with Walkster, the app that's guiding millions towards achieving their dream body simply through the power of walking. Our dedicated team of health experts and physical th
bluejetty:00024071:ios.description:
Transform your weight loss journey and embrace a healthier lifestyle with Walkster, the app that's guiding millions towards achieving their dream body simply through the power of walking. Our dedicated team of health experts and physical therapists tailors personalized plans designed uniquely for you, ensuring you not only shed those stubborn pounds but also enhance your overall health and vitality. Our customized fitness plans along with step & calorie tracking features will help you successfully reach your summer body goals!
Why Walkster Stands Out: Simplifying Success
Forget the fads, the failed diets, and the fleeting motivation. Walkster brings clarity and simplicity to your fitness goals. By focusing on intentional walking, we strip away the complexity, making your path to weight loss as straightforward as putting one foot in front of the other. Intentional walking is our mantra; it's about choosing to walk with purpose, much like you would decide to run, but gentler on your body and equally effective.
Personalized Plans, Real Results
With Walkster, every step counts. Our scientifically-backed, customized walking plans are crafted to motivate and challenge you, adapting as you progress. Each day, you're greeted with clear walking and step goals, pushing you closer to your weight milestones. As you walk, we meticulously track and analyze your pace, distance, calories burned, and more, fine-tuning your plan to keep up with your evolving needs. Plus, by logging your weight, you'll visually track your incredible journey.
Lose Weight, Gain Health
Walking is unanimously celebrated by experts as a remarkably effective, safe method for sustainable weight loss and health improvement. With Walkster, expect to see an average weight reduction of 1-2 pounds weekly—results that don't just show but last. Embrace the simplicity of our walking plans and witness the transformation both on the scale and in your wellbeing.
Walkster: The Key to a Healthier, Happier You
Whether you're a seasoned walker or new to consistent exercise, Walkster invites you into a world where fitness is accessible, enjoyable, and profoundly impactful. Walking isn't just about movement; it's about stepping towards a happier, healthier you. With Walkster, your motivation to lose weight and commitment to our walking plan will unlock the door to a myriad of benefits other programs can't offer, including enhanced heart health, stress reduction, improved sleep, and much more.
Your Path to Lasting Weight Loss
Achieving significant weight loss is a journey of small, consistent steps—both literally and figuratively. Our walking plans are designed around attainable short-term goals, fostering confidence, routine, and sustainable habits. With every step, you're not just moving towards a lighter you but building the foundation for lifelong health and happiness.
Features Designed for Your Success
Clear daily instructions to meet your weight goals within your desired timeline.
Comprehensive tracking of your route, distance, duration, pace, and calories burned.
GPS route visualization.
Step counting functionality.
Voice assistance for real-time updates.
Detailed analysis of your walking and stepping progress over time.
Join the Walkster community today and step into a brighter, healthier future. Your journey to lasting weight loss and enhanced well-being starts with a single step. Will you take it?
For support or more information, contact us at support@bickster.com.
Read our Terms & Privacy policy here: https://www.bickster.com/terms-privacy
Integrate seamlessly with Apple HealthKit to monitor your daily step counts and keep all your health data in sync.

bluejetty:00180319:ios.name: Zenoti Mobile
bluejetty:00180319:ios.summary: Enhance your guest experience and streamline your business operations with Zenoti Mobile. This powerful and intuitive app empowers front desk staff and service providers to directly serve their guests, from the moment they arrive, to fast a
bluejetty:00180319:ios.description:
Enhance your guest experience and streamline your business operations with Zenoti Mobile. This powerful and intuitive app empowers front desk staff and service providers to directly serve their guests, from the moment they arrive, to fast and effortless check-outs through a mobile device. 
Zenoti Mobile offers a variety of functionality, including a mobile POS, digital form management, and employee management.
For The Front Desk:
As a mobile POS, Zenoti Mobile offers seamless integration with Zenoti Payments, which means wireless, fast, and secure transactions. Zenoti Mobile works with the Zenoti desktop solution to give your guests a modern payment experience. You'll be able to:
• View and manage guest information, including purchase and visit history
• Add services, retail, or memberships to an invoice 
• Rebook appointments
• Accept secure payments with industry-first EMV support
• Swipe, dip, or tap payments and accept Apple Pay
• Collect digital signatures for payments or other forms like intake and consent forms
For Service Providers:
Zenoti Mobile provides staff with the ability to:
• Schedule appointments and view their existing schedules
• Track payroll with commissions & tips on a daily basis
• Perform chair side upgrades
• Access guest information, notes, and digital forms for improved guest experiences
• Capture treatment notes, before and after pictures, and annotate pictures
This app is only available for businesses that use Zenoti’s enterprise platform. To log in to the app, use your Zenoti username and password.
For more information about Zenoti products, visit our website.

bluejetty:00130571:ios.summary: Have you ever wondered “who is that actor?”, or perhaps “when was this movie released?”, or “what was the title of that one episode of that show I love”? Maybe you're a film aficionado, and wonder “how old was this person when this movie wa
bluejetty:00130571:ios.description:
Have you ever wondered “who is that actor?”, or perhaps “when was this movie released?”, or “what was the title of that one episode of that show I love”? Maybe you're a film aficionado, and wonder “how old was this person when this movie was released”?
Have you wanted to answer those questions *without* being prompted to log in every five seconds? Without advertisements, and without auto-playing videos? Without relying on a multinational conglomerate that is trying to sell you things?
You'll love Callsheet.
Callsheet is the best way to quickly look up information about the cast and crew in TV and movies. It respects your time, doesn't try to sell you stuff you don't need, and is designed to answer your questions quickly and easily.
Callsheet also has some novel features that your previous favorite database app does not:
• Prevent spoilers when watching TV shows by optionally hiding character names, episode counts, episode titles, or episode thumbnails.
 Don't let yourself get spoiled on a character's secret identity, or that they'll leave the show quickly, by hiding those hints.
• Quick access to trivia, Wikipedia, parental guidance, and where to watch (provided by JustWatch).
• Pin shows, movies, or people for quick access.
• Find things you've searched for before using recent searches and search history.
• Easily see the age of cast members *when a film was released* right inline with the cast list
• Easily see the age of a person for each entry in their filmography
• Easily see the height of actors (when possible)
• Dark mode support
• VoiceOver support
• Alternate app icons for subscribers
• Automatic, no-login integration with the wonderful Channels app
• Integration with Jellyfin and Plex via one-time login
Callsheet is written by one person, who REALLY cares about respecting your time. Callsheet is designed to let you drop in, find what you need with no fuss, and then get back to the movie or show you really care about. No distractions, and no requests to log in.
Callsheet offers 20 searches for free, and then requires a subscription. Subscriptions all come with a 1-week free trial. They support Family Sharing.
Give Callsheet a try. You won't believe how much better it is than the app you were using before.
Privacy Policy: https://callsheetapp.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://callsheetapp.com/terms

bluejetty:00062318:ios.description:
Finademy helps both beginners and active traders learn, practice, and refine their stock-market skills through structured courses, bite-sized lessons, real challenges, and a full StockSim environment.
From first-time investors to traders mastering advanced technical analysis—Finademy grows with your skill level.
Learn at your own pace with short, practical lessons inspired by the clarity of investopedia.
Courses include:
• How stocks, ETFs, and index funds work
• Market psychology & risk management
• Trading strategies
• Fundamental analysis
• Technical analysis for all levels
• Advanced chart patterns, indicators, and price action
Each course includes hands-on challenges you complete in the simulator.
Realistic Stock Market Simulator
Practice instantly in a safe, realistic environment—like a beginner-friendly version of tradingview mixed with a learning game.
 • Market & limit orders
 • Track P&L, positions, and portfolio performance
 • Test long/short strategies
 • Practice technical setups
 • Learn timing, entries, exits, and risk control
Perfect for beginners learning how to invest and traders who want to sharpen their edge.
AI Coach for Fast, Clear Answers
 • Ask anything—basic or advanced.
 • Your AI coach explains concepts, reviews trades, helps with technical setups, and guides you like a personal mentor.
Why Finademy Helps All Skill Levels
 • Short lessons for quick learning
 • Deep content for active traders
 • Hands-on practice through a realistic simulator game
 • Beginner guide + advanced class path
 • Helps you trade, invest, and analyze charts with confidence
 • Great for teens, adults, and motivated learners
Start Learning, Start Practicing, Start Improving
Finademy combines a complete course, a class, a simulator, and an AI coach into one simple app.
Download Finademy: Learn Stock Basics and build real investing and trading skills—beginner to advanced.

bluejetty:00132258:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00132258:ios.description:
We’ll spare you a long text, let’s explain in human words who we are.
To start we are a dating app like so many others. Whether you’re looking for new connections, friendships, or meaningful relationships, you’ll find your place in our global community. And all this for free without annoying ads!
What makes us special is our community! We began as a typical garage start-up with no investors. Today we are based in liberal Amsterdam & Berlin, and we lead ROMEO with the same spirit for more than 20 years.
Get the free ROMEO app now and chat with lots of gay, bi, trans, and queer people nearby and worldwide. Create your profile and start chatting within minutes!
10 ROMEO app FREE features you'll LOVE:
- Search for ROMEOs who are online now
- Unlimited free chat
- Customize your profile and share your interests
- Access search options
- Discover new people in your area
- See who logged in recently
- Hide your real GPS location
- Explore profiles around the world with our travel feature
- Share your photos with others for a limited time
- Link and show your friends in your profile
Connect and chat with our Rainbow community.
Are you looking for more features? Upgrade to ROMEO PLUS and make your journey more comfortable, like travelling first class.
10 ROMEO PLUS features you'll LOVE:
- Unlimited scrolling with more than 120 search options
- Hide profile visits
- 'Appear offline' to others
- Save unlimited contacts
- Upload unlimited photos
- See your visitors from the last 7 days
- Share your photos with QuickShare
- Choose your grid view and your favorite profile stats
- Connect with locals by being visible in the grid of your travel destination 2 weeks before arriving
- Instant messaging! Save frequently used phrases
At ROMEO we want to give you the tools to live your full life and we are one of the largest platforms worldwide with more than 3 million gay, bisexual, trans and queer people.
We are proud of developing a dating app in a team that is mostly queer and uses ROMEO every day.
We are independent of big companies or advertisement income, that means we can focus on your needs only, on the needs of our community. Furthermore, we believe this down to earth approach is the reason why we have been online since 2001 as GayRomeo and then Planet Romeo .
ROMEO, also known as PlanetRomeo or GayRomeo, is one of the world's most exciting dating apps and social network for gay, bi and trans people. We embrace diversity and support our global Rainbow family.
ROMEO Website version is also available.
ROMEO App is for people aged 18 and over.
Download the ROMEO App now!
Gay dating has never been easier.
Subscription Terms
● Payment will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase.
● Your subscription automatically renews and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
● Any remaining portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited once you purchase an auto-renewing subscription.
● We also encourage you to read our Terms and Privacy below.
● You can manage your subscriptions at any time and auto-renewal can be turned off in your App Store account settings on your device after purchase by going to: Settings > Your name > Subscriptions.
https://romeoapp.com/terms/
https://romeoapp.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00036250:ios.summary: It’s a brand-new superstar dress up game for everyone who like to play fashion games and stylish girl games! Dress up celebrity couple for a superstar fashion competition, fashion show or a red carpet. If you covet fashion outfits and styli
bluejetty:00036250:ios.description:
It’s a brand-new superstar dress up game for everyone who like to play fashion games and stylish girl games! Dress up celebrity couple for a superstar fashion competition, fashion show or a red carpet. If you covet fashion outfits and stylish clothes, explore your super stylist skills in our high quality supermodel makeover game.
*** Get points for your outfits and stylist skills to open new clothes items ***
Do you ever wandered what it like to be a celebrity? Or what it like to have a superstar boyfriend? Well it’s a perfect opportunity to meet a celebrity couple in fashion world. Being celebrity, supermodel star or fashion diva is pretty hard. You always have to be a stylish girl or boy. Paparazzi are watching, so you’re definitely needed to have a personal superstar fashion stylist. No matter if you participate in a fashion competition and fashion show or going on a red carpet with your top model boyfriend you should look perfect! Dress up celebrity fashion diva in supermodel makeover for superstar fashion contest. This talented and stylish girl just can’t be alone! So here boys dress up game also begins.. Pick up perfect clothes, hairstyle, accessories and the whole appearance for your girl. Her boyfriend is also from fashion world, he is supermodel star so together they are the dream couple. When you covet fashion clothes this is perfect opportunity to get it, so let’s start supermodel makeover fashion games.
Today you’re gonna be a super stylist of a celebrity couple. Explore fashion world of superstars in new superstar dress up fashion games and cool dress up games for girls! Everyone covet fashion outfits and stylish clothes and now it’s in your hands. Your girl is about to start her supermodel star or movie star career. Dress up stylish girl for a red carpet with her boyfriend. She’s a fashion diva and her boyfriend is a supermodel star. Reveal all your fashion stylist skills and dress the celebrity couple perfectly for fashion show. Your goal is to lead them to victory in the fashion competition game and get more awards. Let’s start our supermodel makeover. Pick up their makeup and hair, which is important for the fashion contest. Then, experiment with different looks for your models couple in our fashion game. Check your fashion stylist skills, because your models are going to fashion contest and the judges will rate their outfits. The better clothes they’ll have the more grades they’ll get. Get more points to receive more awards and evaluate your progress in fashion girl games. 
Features:
- Dress up celebrity couple for a important event
- Increase your game progress and open new clothes items
- Design boy and girl clothes at the same time
- Choose accessories, makeup and hair
- A lot of different and gorgeous clothes items
- Get rates for your outfits and super stylist abilities
- Collect points to get fashion awards in girl games
- Pick up backgrounds to set the context
- High quality graphics and unique art

bluejetty:00175539:ios.description:
GradeWay works with any school district that uses Home Access Center for student information.
FEATURES:
STAY LOGGED IN:
You only have to enter your HAC credentials once!
GRADES:
View your color-coded averages for all your courses at a glance, and for every marking period! View all of your individual grades and your class average by category.
GRADE INSIGHTS:
View your class averages over time to see trends and improvements. You can also see how your average has changed since the last time you opened the app, and see which grades have been recently added.
WHAT IF CALCULATOR:
Predict your average by adding mock grades and changing scores to see how it affects your average. This will help you better set goals for the scores you need in the future.
GPA CALCULATOR:
You no longer have to wait for the end of the semester to know your GPA. GradeWay calculates your weighted and unweighted GPA using all of your averages, your transcript, and all your credits. View GPA breakdowns, edit scales, and exclude courses to improve accuracy. Use the built-in what if calculator to predict changes to your GPA.
PLANNER:
Easily plan your homework out and set reminders for yourself, without needing a notebook or manually entering in courses yourself. Add homework assignments and tasks, seamlessly integrated with your HAC courses. View your work assigned by teachers from HAC and your own work, side by side, day by day, all in the same place. Set push notifications to stay on top of your work.
SIMPLIFIED HAC:
• View your class schedule separated by A and B day and by semester.
• View upcoming and missing assignments on the home screen.
• View your report cards and progress reports easily.
• View your transcript, straight from HAC.
• View your attendance in an easy to understand calendar for each month.
BELL SCHEDULE TRACKER:
Simulate the bell and keep track of time with a custom bell schedule. See how much time is left in each period and get notified before the next one starts so you are never late. Students in online school will be able to follow the same schedule they’re used to, at home!
EMAIL TEACHERS:
Email your teachers from within the app, without having to enter in their email addresses yourself.
MULTIPLE STUDENTS:
Add multiple students on the same device and easily switch between them. Extremely useful if you are a parent with multiple students.
PERSONALIZATION AND MORE:
GradeWay can be used in light and dark mode! Switch between 10 different color themes. You can even login with face or touch ID, give yourself a profile picture, or change your display name!

Authorized by Ragnarok Online, A Continuation of the Classic Adventure
Land of Snowflakes, the grand new expansion pack, has been launched. Beneath the Everlasting Primefrost whispers an elegy to a lost crown. The frozen land mirrors the glimmer of minds whose paths cross. Inside the abyssal furnace, an artificial heart pulses weakly. The Wind of Fate has arrived. Do you hear the call from another world?
===Game Features===
◈ Continuation of Classic, Original Will Upheld ◈
A free-to-play game with the authentic cute art style, easy switch between 3D and 2.5D, thousands of headwear items, and free trades!
◈ Fight Refreshing Battles As Any Job You Prefer ◈
You can access all the jobs of the original RO in RagnarokM. Test your skills with various job combinations and progression! No more hesitation when choosing your job, since you can change job in no time!
◈ Find Companions, Build Guilds ◈
Adventures bring Adventurers together. Build a guild with other Adventurers, help each other and strengthen your bonds! You're needed in MVP Scramble and GvG battles!
◈ A Catch-up Feature That Eases Your Burden ◈
You can complete daily quests quickly, earn multiplied EXP as a beginner, enjoy fast cross-server PvE teaming, and access privileges as a returning player. Whenever you play it, RagnarokM will bring you much joy!
◈ Teamwork Makes the Dominant Champion ◈
Lots of casual and competitive PvP and GvG modes that test your individual and team strategies. Divide tasks wisely and find the best strategies to win glory!
◈ Various Cosmetics and Varied Mounts ◈
Thousands of skins and headwear items for you to match as you wish. Numerous collectable mounts for one or two players. Each Adventurer can have a unique appearance!
===System Requirements===
Requires iOS 10.0 or higher
Minimum requirements: iPhone 6s or higher, 2GB RAM
Recommended requirements: iPhone XS or higher, 4GB RAM
===Contact Us===
Facebook:www.facebook.com/PlayRagnarokMGlobal

Real Baseball, Real Fast — The Ultimate MLB Game!
Step up to the plate with the officially licensed MLB mobile game that delivers fast, thrilling baseball action in the palm of your hand! From quick home run fun to building your dream team
bluejetty:00082339:ios.description:
Real Baseball, Real Fast — The Ultimate MLB Game!
Step up to the plate with the officially licensed MLB mobile game that delivers fast, thrilling baseball action in the palm of your hand! From quick home run fun to building your dream team and competing against players worldwide, the journey grows with you.
MLB PRO SPIRIT brings authentic baseball gameplay, smooth controls, and lifelike motion straight to your fingertips. Featuring Shohei Ohtani as the cover athlete, this is your chance to experience the speed, excitement, and intensity of real MLB action — wherever you play.
■ REAL MLB PLAYERS & STADIUMS
Play with real MLB stars from all 30 teams, from today’s superstars to legendary icons. Lifelike player models, authentic motion, and smooth animations built on a baseball simulation engine refined for over 30 years. Step into faithfully recreated MLB stadiums with official uniforms and team celebrations. 
■ YOUR MLB EXPERIENCE, ANYTIME
Jump into the action with controls that are simple to learn but satisfying to master. Every swing, pitch, and catch brings the thrill of MLB gameplay to your fingertips. Hit towering home runs, strike out batters, and even play both sides of the ball like Shohei Ohtani.
Designed to fit your play style:
*Quick, high-energy fun? Jump in for fast-paced home run thrills anytime.
*Competitive and strategic? Build your dream team and take on players worldwide.
*Casual or simulation play? Customize the experience to match your mood.
Whether you’re just starting out or chasing serious competition, the action is fast, intuitive, and rewarding — the perfect baseball game for every fan.
■ FAST & FUN GAME MODES
Arcade: Perfect for fast MLB action, Arcade Mode lets anyone step in and swing for the fences. Take control at key moments, rack up home runs, and tour all 30 MLB stadiums.
Season: Lead your team through a 52-game season, build your roster, and chase the World Series at your own pace — play it all or simulate the action.
Online: Test your skills against players around the world in real-time matchups. Play casually with friends or climb the ranks in Ranked Games to prove who’s the best.
Limited Time Events: Keep the excitement fresh with weekly events featuring exclusive rewards. Jump in, earn big prizes, and experience new challenges every week.
■ WHY FANS LOVE MLB PRO SPIRIT
*Official MLB Action – Play with real teams, players, and ballparks in a free-to-play game.
*Fast & Fun Gameplay – Intuitive controls make every swing and pitch exciting.
*Play Your Way – From casual home run thrills to competitive dream-team battles.
*Collect & Compete – Build your ultimate roster with superstars and legends.
*Live Events & Rewards – Weekly challenges keep the game fresh with exclusive prizes.
■ IMPORTANT
An internet connection is required to play.
■ SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS
iOS 15 or later
*Even on devices meeting the requirements, performance may vary due to device specifications, hardware limitations, or app usage patterns.
*Devices with insufficient 3D graphics capabilities may experience poor performance.
*Devices supporting split-screen mode may experience app malfunctions.

For all the City Island games fans over the past 10 years, we created a trip down memory lane game. BUILD, COLLECT AND MERGE
City Island: Collections is a merge City Building Game by Sparkling Society. Build the city of your dreams, collect all buildings found in City Island 1, 2, 3, 4 and City Island 5 and merge buildings in this city building merge collection sim game.
NO INTERNET REQUIRED

bluejetty:00129594:ios.name: Grandpa And Granny Adventures
bluejetty:00129594:ios.summary: You have to save one of the olds. Evil skeletons kidnapped a grandpa and locked him in a secret place. Your primary goal is to collect all keys from hostile skeletons and help the old man out of the trap. But it is not as easy as it sounds
bluejetty:00129594:ios.description:
You have to save one of the olds. Evil skeletons kidnapped a grandpa and locked him in a secret place. Your primary goal is to collect all keys from hostile skeletons and help the old man out of the trap. But it is not as easy as it sounds because skeletons are very clever, they hide masterfully and run very quickly. So you will have to do your best to catch the skeletons by all means to free a granny or a grandpa. 
The malicious skeletons hid the granny or the grandpa very well. Before you start searching for the keys, you need to find the locked old. You will have to rack your brains to trick the skeletons while hunting for the keys. Make sure you use items at hand – they are found all around the location. Be careful! Some skeletons can attack you, but they are themselves quite fragile, and a single hit is generally enough to get them to fall to pieces.
It depends on the character you choose at the beginning of the game, which of the two you will ultimately have to save. If you select a granny, then you will have to save a grandpa and vice versa. Each character has certain bonus skills. For example, the grandpa is stronger while the granny has better eyesight. 
Halloween, this scary but at the same time fun holiday, inspired us to create this game. That is why the creation is full of elements and attributes associated with this beautiful holiday.
Stay tuned for our updates, we are planning to include more chapters to the game where the granny and the grandpa will have more exciting adventures.
