WHAT PEOPLE ASK
"Here's a photo of my pantry. I don't kno
bluejetty:00141539:ios.description:
Whatever's on your mind — the house, the week, the thing you've been avoiding — just ask your coach. Sometimes you'll get a plan. Sometimes one small thing. Sometimes just company.
WHAT PEOPLE ASK
"Here's a photo of my pantry. I don't know where to start."
The shelves are fine — it's the floor that's become the overflow. Start there, twenty minutes, nothing else.
"I keep ordering in because I never know what to eat."
Pick three proteins and one theme. One shop on Monday, cook twice, eat all week.
"Company's coming and I've got two days."
Only the rooms they'll actually see. Bathroom Tuesday evening, kitchen and living room Wednesday, thirty-five minutes each.
"I forget my lunch every single morning."
Added to your 6:45 list, with a nudge the night before.
"I've drifted from a friend and I don't know how to text them first."
Let's write it together. Short, no apology for the gap.
"Honestly, I'm just done today."
Then nothing today. Want to talk it through, or should I move tomorrow back a day?
Home, work, family, health, the stuff in between. Your coach will break down what feels too big, tell you where to start, remind you at the right time, keep track of what you're working toward — and listen when that's all you want.
Pick the voice that suits you — calmer or more direct, practical or encouraging. Whoever you choose shows up the same way every day.
Aligned is not a medical service and does not provide diagnosis or treatment.

listings.name: Winmail Viewer - Letter Opener
listings.description:
Open Winmail.dat, MSG and XPS files with just a tap. 

ABOUT
A winmail.dat file or MSG file is an email from Microsoft Outlook that can not be read by other email applications. It needs to be converted for the content to be accessible. 

Letter Opener does that with a simple tap!

With over 10 years experience (and a special dislike for winmail.dat files) we made sure that working together with Microsoft Outlook and Windows users can be simple and seamless.

FEATURES
- Open Winmail.dat and MSG files and convert appointments, notes, contacts etc. to iOS native formats.

- Get access to all attachments in Winmail.dat files.

- Export files to another app.

SUPPORT
We provide direct personal support, so don’t hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or comments: support@winmail.help

Thanks for helping us to keep improving Letter Opener!

TERMS OF USE
https://winmail.help/legal/terms

bluejetty:00090875:ios.description:
p2Vest enables borrowers to obtain loans directly from lenders, reducing the cumbersome process of traditional lending. 
Borrowers can easily signup with valid credentials and request a loan. If approved, the loans get disbursed to the borrower. Lenders can also place funds on p2Vest and give out loans to borrowers.
GETTING STARTED IS VERY EASY;
Create an account.
Set up your loan profile or lending preferences
Apply for a loan or fund a loan
Receive your loan straight into your bank.
Increase your loan limit when you complete your KYC
REPAYMENT TERMS FOR ALL LOANS
Depending on the loan amount for which you are eligible, you have the option to choose repayment terms for up to 180 days. With p2Vest you can choose the best loan term that meets your needs.
ADDITIONAL NOTES
When processing your loan request for eligibility and sharing with available lenders on the app for funding, we look at several signals, such as your credit score, past loan performance, etc. We require that loan applications be filled with the correct information as any falsification could delay your loan request, or your profile may be blacklisted. For cases of fraud, you may be reported to the authorities.
CONTACT US
We're eager to hear from you as we welcome feedback and tips to make our services better. If you have any feedback, questions, or concerns, please contact us at support@p2vest.com.

bluejetty:00165837:ios.description:
Timer.Coffee is a free, open-source coffee brewing timer and calculator designed to enhance your brewing experience. The app is completely free. Optional in-app donations support ongoing development and never affect access to features.
Key Features
- 27 Brewing Methods: Step-by-step instructions for Hario V60, AeroPress, Chemex, French Press, Clever Dripper, Kalita Wave, Wilfa Svart Pour Over, Origami Dripper, Hario Switch, and more.
- Coffee Calculator: Adjust coffee and water quantities on the fly.
- Custom Grind Size: Save your grind settings per recipe — never forget your Comandante clicks again.
- Background Brewing: The timer keeps running accurately when you minimize the app — switch apps or check a message without losing your place.
- Live Activities: Follow your brew step-by-step on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island without unlocking your phone.
- Pulse: See what coffee lovers around the world are brewing right now, in real time.
- Create & Share Recipes: Build your own brewing recipes and share them with the community.
- Brew Diary: Automatically save timer-guided brews or add entries manually, with notes, ratings, taste, tags, grind, water temperature, and extraction.
- Bean Tracking: Manage your coffee bean inventory with AI-powered label recognition.
- Favorites: Quick access to your most-used recipes.
- Audio Chime: Audio alerts for every brewing step.
- Dial In Your Beans: Search and filter your history, bookmark best cups, compare attempts, follow bean journeys, and review monthly progress.
- Device Sync: Recipes, beans, and brews synced across all your devices.
- 22 Languages: Fully localized for a global audience.
- Dark Mode: Easy on the eyes at any hour.

CREATE
Whether games, art, stories or more, you can code whatever you want with kid-friendly programming. Publish your creations to Hopscotch’s fully moderated community, where kids can play and learn from your games.
PLAY
Explore and learn from millions of projects created by other kids. Open up any project to play, tweak, or remix it. With thousands of games published every week, you’ll never run out of ideas or inspiration!
LEARN
Our play-along video tutorials teach you to make Crossy Road, PokemonGo, and more. Listen, watch, and code as you go! As you become a better programmer, Hopscotch will challenge you to create increasingly advanced games and apps. These skills will help you in high school, college, and beyond.

bluejetty:00070161:ios.name: GarageBand
bluejetty:00070161:ios.summary: GarageBand turns your iPad, and iPhone into a collection of Touch Instruments and a full-featured recording studio — so you can make music anywhere you go. And with Live Loops, it makes it easy for anyone to have fun creating music like a D
bluejetty:00070161:ios.description:
GarageBand turns your iPad, and iPhone into a collection of Touch Instruments and a full-featured recording studio — so you can make music anywhere you go. And with Live Loops, it makes it easy for anyone to have fun creating music like a DJ. Use Multi-Touch gestures to play keyboards, guitars, and create beats that make you sound like a pro — even if you’ve never played a note before. Plug in a guitar or bass and play through classic amps and stompbox effects. Use a Touch Instrument, microphone, or a guitar to instantly record a performance, with support for up to 32 tracks. Use the Sound Library to download additional free instruments, loops, and sound packs created by some of the biggest producers in the world. And then share your song with friends and family.
Live Loops. Make music like a DJ
• Use Multi-Touch to tap and trigger a Live Loop cell or group of cells
• Get started with templates or build your own grid from scratch with Apple Loops
• Create custom loops by recording directly into a cell using any Touch Instrument
• Use Remix FX to perform DJ-style effects
• Tap record to capture your performance
Play your iPad, and iPhone, like a musical instrument
• Play a variety of musical instruments on the innovative Multi-Touch keyboard
• Play and record using the Alchemy Touch Instrument
• Build grooves inspired by classic electronic drum machines with the Beat Sequencer
• Download free instruments, loops, and sound packs for GarageBand with the Sound Library
• Capture any sound and apply studio-class effects
• Recreate legendary guitar or bass rigs using virtual amps and stompboxes
• Record performances from third-party music apps directly into GarageBand using Audio Unit Extensions*
Drummer
• Add virtual session drummers to your song, who take direction and play realistic grooves
• Choose from acoustic, electronic drummers and percussionists**
• Each character provides their own sound and the ability to create over a million realistic grooves and fills
Sound like a virtuoso with Smart Instruments
• Play an entire string orchestra using Smart Strings
• Perform with Chord Strips and autoplay using any keyboard instrument
• Groove with a variety of Smart Basses using upright, electric, and synth sounds
• Strum chords or trigger autoplay patterns on an acoustic and electric Smart Guitar
Create a song anywhere you go
• Record, arrange, and mix your song with up to 32 tracks using Touch Instruments, audio recordings, and loops***
• Record multiple times over any song section and choose your favorite using Multi-Take Recording
• Use professional mixing effects, including Visual EQ, Bitcrusher, and Overdrive
• Recording, mixing and exporting a song can be done at 24-bit audio resolution
• Trim and place musical regions exactly where you want them to play
• Automate the volume and record the movement of controls on Touch Instruments
• Add comments or lyric ideas to your song with an integrated notepad
Share your songs
• Keep your songs up to date across all devices using iCloud Drive
• Create custom ringtones and alerts for your iPad, or iPhone
• Share your songs using email or to social media sites like SoundCloud****
• Remotely add new tracks to your Logic Pro project from your iPhone, or iPad via iCloud
* Requires compatible third-party Audio Unit Extensions apps from the App Store.
** Requires free download from GarageBand Sound Library.
*** Multitrack recording requires a compatible third-party audio interface.
**** Sharing to some social media sites may require apps like iMovie, Clips or other third-party apps

bluejetty:00163173:ios.name: Zombastic: Time to Survive
bluejetty:00163173:ios.summary:
Enter the zombie apocalypse in Zombastic — a zombie survival game, zombie shooter, and roguelike action game where endless zombie hordes attack from every direction.
Move your hero, shoot zombies automatically, collect experience, and choo
bluejetty:00163173:ios.description:
Enter the zombie apocalypse in Zombastic — a zombie survival game, zombie shooter, and roguelike action game where endless zombie hordes attack from every direction.
Move your hero, shoot zombies automatically, collect experience, and choose one of three abilities every time you level up. Upgrade your skills, unlock powerful weapons, create devastating builds, and fight to survive each wave. Simple controls get you into the action fast, but only smart ability and weapon choices will carry you through the toughest zombie survival battles.
Explore a fantastic world packed with zombie hordes, dangerous bosses, powerful gear, epic loot, and nonstop shooting action. Build your hero, improve your equipment, and become the ultimate survivor.
SHOOT ZOMBIES 
Fight through intense zombie shooting as massive hordes surround your hero. Keep moving, dodge enemy attacks, and shoot zombies before they overwhelm you.
This top-down shooting game combines auto shooting, horde survival, and roguelike progression, offering new ability choices, new builds, and new ways to fight in every run.
Face stronger enemies, larger zombie hordes, elite monsters, and dangerous zombie bosses as you progress. Master powerful weapons, use upgraded abilities, and claim valuable rewards after every battle.
UNLOCK POWERFUL ABILITIES 
Choose one of three cards every time you level up.
Unlock new abilities or upgrade the ones you already have. Call air support, throw axes and boomerangs, deploy drones, unleash lightning attacks, and destroy waves of zombies with powerful explosions.
Upgrade your main abilities to level 5 and evolve them into super abilities. Combine active and passive skills, create powerful synergies, and experiment with different builds for every zombie survival challenge.
UNLOCK AND UPGRADE WEAPONS 
Collect powerful weapons and equipment to survive the zombie apocalypse.
Unlock new guns, upgrade gear, and increase your equipment’s rarity. Equip gloves, belts, helmets, armor, and boots to boost your damage, defense, and combat power against stronger zombies.
Create the perfect loadout, destroy zombie hordes, defeat zombie bosses, and push deeper into the campaign.
UNLOCK UNIQUE HEROES 
Collect unique heroes with powerful ultimate abilities.
Charge your hero’s ultimate during combat and activate it at the perfect moment. Clear entire groups of zombies, escape overwhelming hordes, or deal massive damage to zombie bosses.
Upgrade your heroes, improve their stats, and prepare them for increasingly difficult zombie survival missions.
COLLECT AND UPGRADE PETS 
There's no need to fight alone! Collect pets that fight alongside your hero in every battle.
Upgrade pets, equip them with gear, and increase their power. Choose the right pet gear combination to support your build, help shoot zombies, control enemy hordes, and defeat powerful monsters.
Pets add a new layer of strategy to every zombie survival battle and help you progress through the zombie apocalypse.
EXPLORE 100+ LEVELS 
Fight through more than 100 campaign levels filled with zombie hordes, elite enemies, boss battles, and valuable loot.
Complete missions, unlock new challenges, earn rewards, upgrade heroes, modify weapons, strengthen equipment, and discover new ways to survive.
Zombastic combines zombie survival, auto shooting, roguelike upgrades, horde survival, hero progression, and intense boss fights in one fast-paced action game.
Love zombie games, survival games, action shooters, and roguelike adventures?
Enter the zombie apocalypse, defeat endless hordes, and begin your survival journey in Zombastic!

bluejetty:00183856:ios.description:
Monetika is an application for personal finance accounting, budget planning, and gathering statistics.
● Finance Accounting ●
Start managing your finances with our application. We’ve made an effort to make this process more pleasant and convenient for you.
The application will answer the following questions: where does the money go? What are the biggest cost categories? Where can you save?
● Budget Planning ●
The key to success in managing your finances is consistency. Make a habit of keeping up with your expenses. The more often you use Monetika, the more valuable it becomes for you. 
● Gathering Statistics ●
The expenses and income chart will provide you with an understanding of your overall financial situation and help you gain valuable insights.
---- TOP Features ---
● Works offline
● Security: data is stored on your phone
● Adding accounts
● Expenses accounting
● Income accounting
● Transfer between accounts
● Managing the expenses categories
● Managing the income categories
● Account balance changes
● View account transactions
● Statistics by expenses category
● Statistics by income category
● General statistics
● Cash flow statistics 
● List of all transactions
● Multiple application languages
● Multiple currencies
● Account deletion
● iCloud backups
● Setting budgets by category
● Budgets control
We are committed to protecting the privacy of your data. Our service does not store information about your accounts, transactions, budgets, or statistics on remote servers. The information is stored only on your iPhone. We recommend making frequent backups through iCloud to mitigate data loss.
DOWNLOAD OUR APPLICATION AND START MANAGING YOUR FINANCES!
We made a concerted effort to develop the interface and ensure its responsiveness. When you open the application, you can enter your expenses right away in just two seconds.
The free version of Monetika does not require prepayment or your credit card information.
Premium features are paid for with a monthly or annual subscription.
Prices will be displayed before you purchase through your App Store account.
Premium subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account after you confirm your purchase. Your monthly subscription will automatically renew each month and be charged through your iTunes account. Yearly subscriptions will also automatically renew each year. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.

bluejetty:00017313:ios.description:
It’s Better at Treasure Bay, and this is another reason why. Your card gets your access to everything Treasure Bay Casino and Hotel has to offer – and all of YOUR offers!
Treasure Bay Casino and Hotel, a beachside casino resort located in Biloxi, Mississippi, offers gaming entertainment, a variety of dining options and luxury accommodations 24 hours a day, seven days a week. The property features approximately 25,000 square feet of gaming space, including more than 800 slot machines and 26 table games; four restaurants ranging from casual to fine dining, a nine-story, 185 room hotel, featuring luxury suites and Jacuzzi lofts; and 3,600 square feet of meeting and conference space.

Headquarters for Treasure Bay, LLC, the Biloxi property is part of a group of casinos managed by the company that includes Divi Carina Bay Casino in St. Croix, Alhambra Casino in Aruba, Flamingo Casino in Bonaire, and Treasure Bay Casino in St. Lucia.

bluejetty:00019559:ios.name: Microsoft Authenticator
bluejetty:00019559:ios.summary: Use Microsoft Authenticator for easy, secure sign-ins for all your online accounts using multi-factor authentication, passwordless, or password autofill. You also have additional account management options for your Microsoft personal, work
bluejetty:00019559:ios.description:
Use Microsoft Authenticator for easy, secure sign-ins for all your online accounts using multi-factor authentication, passwordless, or password autofill. You also have additional account management options for your Microsoft personal, work or school accounts.
Getting started with multi-factor authentication
Multi factor authentication (MFA)provides a second layer of security. When enabled, during login after entering your password, you’ll be asked for an additional way to prove it’s really you. Either approve the notification sent to the Microsoft Authenticator, or enter the one-time password (OTP) generated by the app. The OTP codes have a 30 second timer counting down. This timer is so you never have to use the same time-based one-time password (TOTP) twice and you don’t have to remember the number. The OTP doesn’t require you to be connected to a network, and it won’t drain your battery. You can add multiple accounts to your app, including non-Microsoft accounts like Facebook, Amazon, Dropbox, Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, and more.
Getting started with passwordless
Use your phone, not your password, to log into your Microsoft account. Just enter your username, then approve the notification sent to your phone. Your fingerprint, face ID, or PIN will provide a second layer of security in this two-step verification process. After you’ve signed in with two factor authentication (2FA), you’ll have access to all your Microsoft products and services, such as Outlook, OneDrive, Office, and more.
Microsoft personal, work or school accounts
Sometimes your work or school might ask you to install the Microsoft Authenticator when accessing certain organization resources. You will need to register your device to your organization through the app and add your work or school account. Microsoft Authenticator supports cert-based authentication by issuing a certificate on your device. This will let your organization know that the sign-in request is coming from a trusted device and help you seamlessly and securely access additional Microsoft apps and services without needing to log into each.
Microsoft Authenticator may request the following optional permissions, which require your consent. You can continue to use Microsoft Authenticator without granting these permissions. However, some features may be limited or unavailable. For more information, please see below:
- Face ID: To enable app lock and help protect your accounts
- Camera: To scan QR codes when adding accounts to Microsoft Authenticator.

bluejetty:00075170:ios.name: zFuse - Media Player
bluejetty:00075170:ios.summary:
- zFuse can play all video formats and encodings, allowing you to play video files on your mobile device without the need to convert to MP4.
- zFuse supports ASS/SSA/SUP effect subtitles, enabling you to experience full subtitle effects ju
bluejetty:00075170:ios.description:
- zFuse can play all video formats and encodings, allowing you to play video files on your mobile device without the need to convert to MP4.
- zFuse supports ASS/SSA/SUP effect subtitles, enabling you to experience full subtitle effects just like on your PC/Mac.
- zFuse features powerful networking technologies that allow you to play media from your PC or NAS directly, without occupying any space on your limited device storage and without needing to download anything.
- zFuse also allows you to easily download files or directories directly from your PC or NAS, making it the perfect companion for your trips.
- zFuse supports a variety of gestures - simply move your fingers to adjust playback position, font size, volume, and brightness.
- zFuse carefully protects your privacy with folder encryption, so you no longer need to worry about privacy issues.
- zFuse's detailed features include:
 * SMB/CIFS playback and discovery (easily play media files from your PC).
 * Download media files or directories from SAMBA/DLNA/WebDAV/FTP directly.
 * UPnP/DLNA playback and discovery.
 * Emby and Jellyfin media server support.
 * AirPlay playback.
 * Picture-in-Picture mode support.
 * iPad split-screen multitasking support.
 * Hardware acceleration.
 * HDR Tone Mapping support on non-HDR displays.
 * Subtitle effects support.
 * 0.5x-3.0x playback speed control.
 * 0.5x-5.0x screen zoom.
 * Media preview while seeking.
 * Built-in audio enhancement.
 * Multi-soundtrack selection.
 * Embedded/external subtitle track selection.
 * Subtitle synchronization.
 * Audio synchronization.
 * External subtitle font selection support.
 * Playlist file preview before playback.
 * Blu-ray directory playback.
 * Real-time playlist management and editing.
 * Screen mirroring.
 * File Management:
 - Delete, move, rename, create folders.
 - Wi-Fi file transfer support without USB cable connection.
 - Streaming media playlist creation support.
 - File decompression support: 7z, zip, rar, tar, bz, bz2, etc.
 * Gesture Controls:
 - Horizontal drag: adjust playback position.
 - Vertical drag on left side: adjust volume.
 - Vertical drag on right side: adjust brightness.
 - Pinch to zoom: adjust screen size.
 - Double-tap: play/pause.
 - Two-finger double-tap: change video aspect ratio.
 * External Keyboard Support:
 - Space: pause/play.
 - Left Arrow: backward seek.
 - Right Arrow: forward seek.
 - Esc: exit playback.
 - S: change playback speed.
 - B: play previous.
 - N: play next.
 - Z: change screen scale.
 * Supported Video Formats: MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WMV, FLV, RMVB, ASF, OGV, Blu-ray ISO and more.
 * Supported Audio Formats: MP3, WAV, WMA, FLAC, APE and more.
 * Supported Subtitle Formats: SRT, SSA, ASS, SUP, VTT.
 * Supported Image Formats: JPG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, GIF, HEIC and more.
 * Supported eBook Formats: EPUB, TXT, PDF.
 * Code Editor Supported Languages: JSON, HTML, XML, C/C++, Lua, Java, Objective-C, Swift, Python, JavaScript.
 * Supported Document Formats: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Numbers, Keynote, Pages, RTF, CSV.

bluejetty:00148090:ios.description:
wally, es una billetera digital con la que podrás manejar tu dinero fácilmente 100% desde tu celular, sin tener una cuenta de banco, sin filas y sin pesados trámites. Sin importar en qué lugar del mundo estés, recarga, envía, recibe y paga en dólares, mediante tu tarjeta Mastercard® wally digital o física, con la que puedes comprar por internet y en comercios.
Con tan solo acceder a la app de wally, podrás ver el saldo recargado en la billetera, el saldo disponible en tu tarjeta Mastercard® wally, el saldo total y tus movimientos.
Utiliza wally porque…
- ¡Es fácil de recargar! Recarga tu billetera digital usando tarjetas Visa® o Mastercard® de cualquier banco.
- ¡Puedes solicitar una tarjeta prepagada Mastercard® digital y física! con la cual podrás realizar compras por internet, y compras en comercios,
- Podrás transaccionar en tu billetera digital hasta USD$1500 mensuales, sin importar el país donde te encuentres.
- Es económica, segura y transparente, con bajas comisiones y tarifas que siempre serán claras para ti y sin letras pequeñas.
¿Cómo realizar recargas a la billetera digital?
Puedes realizar recargas a tu billetera digital a través de una tarjeta débito o crédito de Visa® o Mastercard®, siguiendo estos pasos:
- Ve al menú principal de tu billetera wally.
- Selecciona la opción recargar billetera.
- Coloca el monto de la recarga.
- Ingresa los datos de tu tarjeta Visa® o Mastercard®, con la cual realizarás la recarga de forma segura y ¡listo!. 
Tu dinero recargado estará disponible en tu billetera.
¿Cómo puedo recargar mi tarjeta Mastercard® wally?
Puedes recargar tu tarjeta Mastercard® wally con el saldo disponible de tu billetera.
- Selecciona la opción recargar tarjeta.
- Indica el monto a recargar y ¡listo! 
Tendrás disponible el dinero en tu tarjeta Mastercard® wally para que realices tus compras por internet o en comercios.
¿Cómo puedo enviar dinero desde mi billetera a otro usuario de wally?
En tu billetera wally:
- Seleccionas la opción de transferir a otros.
- Elige al destinario entre tus contactos o introduce el número del teléfono celular del usuario wally al que le vas a transferir.
- Ingresa el monto en USD a enviar.
- Agrega un breve mensaje como descripción y ¡listo!
¡Descarga wally y pásate al lado digital! 
¡Realiza tus compras por internet, tus compras en comercios físicos o transfiere a tus contactos wally, vive la experiencia y pásate al lado digital!

bluejetty:00155094:ios.description:

Enter the gigantic physics simulated environment with unlimited toolsets and unlimited amazing mods. No rules, no limitations, you are free to do anything with the world. Explore many interesting game modes that match your style. Join our world on your own way, alone or with friends.

- Online with other players: Feel lonely? You can create your own world yourself, or get help from other friends. Show them your fascinating mod!
- Lots of items: Select what you need from hundreds objects, to help you build your own creative world.
- Stylist 3D graphic: The game has a nice visual style that hardly found on any games with the same genre.
- Interesting mods & game modes: play anything that you want: Hunting Prop, Who is Garry, Prop Battle Royale, etc.
With more and more updates are coming, Ultimate Sandbox is gonna be the biggest sandbox game of all time. What are you waiting for? Grab your phone and start building your dream world with us, today!

bluejetty:00069192:ios.description:
Formerly SD Emergency. Official emergency information and alerts for San Diego County. 
Be prepared for any emergency with the new Alert San Diego app, the official mobile companion to AlertSanDiego.org. Developed by the County of San Diego's Office of Emergency Services, this app is your all-in-one tool for emergency, preparedness, and recovery information, with official information from public officials. 
Key features
• Targeted emergency alerts: Sign up for call, text, or email alerts for threats impacting your registered location, such as your home, workplace, or family address.

In a world where every moment counts, the 30A mobile app ensures your coastal experiences are rich, meaningful, and aligned with values that celebrate and protect our beautiful planet. From planning your day at the beach to discovering local art and culture, and from supporting eco-friendly businesses to joining beach clean-ups, the app is your gateway to a lifestyle where every day is a beach day, and every action contributes to a happier, healthier planet.
To dive into the BEACH HAPPY® lifestyle and explore the wonders of Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A, download the 30A mobile app today. It's more than just an app; it's your passport to an unforgettable journey along the Gulf Coast, where life shines brighter and every moment is an opportunity to make happy memories while making a difference. Join the 30A community and discover why millions have fallen in love with this slice of paradise. Learn more and start your adventure at www.30A.com.

bluejetty:00071413:ios.description:
Upgrade your experience at the European Poker Tour (EPT) and PokerStars Open festivals. Download the PokerStars Live app for instant access to schedules, results, player updates, league rankings, and essential event information, all in one place. The app is your must-have companion for making the most of every live event.
ESSENTIAL INFORMATION ABOUT EVENTS
~Make sure you know what’s coming up at all times with great features:
- Check and search tournament schedules
- Check the tournament structures
- Check registration hours
- Keep up to date with the latest news 
- Check the leaderboard rankings
ALL SCHEDULED TOURNAMENT DETAILS
~No more asking around for the important tournament information players need, just open the app and check:
- Buy-in Information
- Tournaments Starting Stack
- Structure
- Game Type
REAL-TIME TOURNAMENT INFORMATION
~Get important updates during all events:
- Number of entrants 
- Winners lists - see where your friends finished
- Registration Details
- Seat Draw information
- Live Clock
- Regular updated chip counts
OTHER GAMES AND FEATURES
~In addition to providing real-time tournament information, the PokerStars Live App also allows you to:
- Venue details – event dates, location, hotel information
- Choose your preferred language
The PokerStars Live App is proudly brought to you by PokerStars - the world’s biggest online poker site.
******************************************************************
About PokerStars Live
PokerStars Live is the home of all PokerStars-sponsored live events, including the prestigious European Poker Tour (EPT) and the exciting PokerStars Open festivals. Built on the legacy of major international tours, it unites players from around the globe for premier tournaments, substantial prize pools, and world-class festival experiences.

Lovee has two modes: Dating and Couple. Dating mode is designed to help singles find a match. Couple mode is designed to help
bluejetty:00033903:ios.description:
Lovee is the only app designed to find love for singles and grow relationships for couples. How does Lovee work?
Lovee has two modes: Dating and Couple. Dating mode is designed to help singles find a match. Couple mode is designed to help couples grow their relationship.
Dating mode means your goal is to find a dating match. You can like the profile and their photos/videos/personality. Commenting on others' photos or personality means like as well. If you both like each other, it's a match. Only mutual matches can send messages to each other.
We make it easy to start a conversation. Every match begins by someone liking or commenting on a specific part of your profile.
Truth or Dare is a new feature you can play with during the chat. You and your matches can choose from the questions Lovee provides and invite each other to answer. It can be a great way to break the ice & spice your conversation up.
Couple Mode aims to enhance the relationship between couples. It can show you how long you and your partner have already been together, and you can add your love events to remember every special day. If you already have a partner, you can directly select Couple Mode. If you meet someone on Lovee, you can also switch to Couple Mode.
Privacy: https://www.lovee.co/privacy-policy.html
Terms: https://www.lovee.co/terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00091875:ios.description:
Transform Your Mental Wellness with Paradym’s Proven Support System
Your Personalized Path to Better Well-Being Starts Here
YOUR MENTAL HEALTH, REIMAGINED
At Paradym, we understand that mental wellbeing is a journey, not a destination. That’s why we’ve created a complete support system designed to help you uncover the negative emotional patterns that might be holding you back and empower you to do the deep work that you’d typically do in a therapy room—all from the comfort of your own space. With proven results, you can trust that Paradym is guiding you on the right path.
WHAT PARADYM BRINGS TO YOUR JOURNEY:
- Guided Journaling: 
Our new AI-powered journal is at the heart of your personalized experience. Engage with reflective prompts that help you navigate your thoughts, understand your emotions, and identify patterns that might be impacting your well-being. Each day, the journal adapts to where you are in your journey, providing insights tailored just for you.
- Personalized Recommendations: 
Receive tailored suggestions and resources that address your unique challenges, with tools proven to make a real difference in your mental health journey. Our content is created by leading mental health professionals and designed to support your growth and help you do the work that matters most.
- Progress Tracking: 
Monitor your well-being with tools that measure your emotional growth over time, giving you a clear view of how far you’ve come and where you’re headed. Track your progress directly in the app and connect it with your therapist to enhance your therapeutic experience.
- Connect with a Therapist: 
Ready to take your journey further? Paradym allows you to connect with a licensed therapist right within the app. Whether you’re in NY, NJ, FL, CT, GA, TX, PA, or MD, you can seamlessly share your progress and receive professional support. (We're also slowly rolling out additional locations and partners, so stay tuned!)
- Secure and Private: 
Your data is fully protected with encrypted privacy, so you can reflect and share with complete peace of mind.
WHY CHOOSE PARADYM?
Because it works. Paradym is built on cutting-edge research in emotional science and designed by experts from Harvard, UCL, and more. It’s proven to improve outcomes in well-being, helping you uncover and address the underlying patterns that may be holding you back, one step at a time.
TRUSTED BY OVER 100,000 PEOPLE WORLDWIDE
Join a global community committed to mental wellness. Paradym isn’t just another tool—it’s your partner in creating lasting change. Whether you’re uncovering deep-seated emotional patterns or taking proactive steps to improve your mental health, Paradym is here to guide you every step of the way.
START YOUR JOURNEY TO BETTER WELL-BEING TODAY
Download Paradym and discover how a personalized approach to mental wellness can transform your life.
Terms of use can be found at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/minterms/

bluejetty:00160638:ios.summary: Pilates is a holistic exercise system that focuses on strengthening the core and enhancing flexibility, balance, and overall body fitness. Pilates exercises effectively activate and strengthen your core muscles and other key areas like the
bluejetty:00160638:ios.description:
Pilates is a holistic exercise system that focuses on strengthening the core and enhancing flexibility, balance, and overall body fitness. Pilates exercises effectively activate and strengthen your core muscles and other key areas like the abs, lower back, legs, butt and pelvic floor muscles.
Practicing Pilates has many benefits. Similar to yoga, Pilates exercises can not only enhance muscle strength, improve balance/flexibility, and help lose weight, but can also enhance energy, promote relaxation, and even improve sleep quality.
· Strengthen muscles
Pilates is highly effective for strengthening muscles, especially the core, through precise and controlled movements that target deep muscles in the abdomen, lower back, and pelvis, promoting overall body toning.
· Lose weight effectively
With just a 30-day Pilates plan, you can transform your body into a more toned figure. Pilates is an effective tool for those looking to shed excess pounds. This low-impact exercise engages multiple muscle groups simultaneously, effectively boosting calorie burn. 
· Enhance flexibility
Worried about your body being too stiff? Through its gentle yet effective movements, Pilates gradually lengthens and stretches muscles, increasing flexibility and range of motion, leaving the body more supple and agile.
· Improve posture & relieve pain
By strengthening muscles and promoting alignment, Pilates effectively addresses poor posture, making you look more upright and elegant. Moreover, it can effectively relieve shoulder, neck, and back pain caused by poor posture.
· Boost energy
Pilates boosts energy by metabolizing stress hormones, relaxing muscles, and incorporating specialized breathing exercises that enhance circulation throughout the body.
Extraordinary experience prepared by Pilates Workout at Home:
· Personalized plan just for you
Tailored plans designed exclusively for your fitness journey.
· Focus on your target areas
Targeted exercises for abs, chest, buttocks, legs, arms, and the full body.
· Suitable for all levels
Various plans and workouts cater to both beginners and experienced enthusiasts.
· No equipment needed
Whether at home, at work, or outdoors, you can practice Pilates anytime, anywhere.
· Expert-designed plans and workouts
Ensuring the highest quality and effectiveness in your Pilates routine.
· Various workouts to meet all your needs
Meet all your fitness needs, allowing you to choose routines that align with your preferences.
· Detailed video instructions
Guiding you through each exercise, ensuring proper form and technique.
· Smart progress tracker
Helping visualize your fitness journey and progress, keeping you motivated.
· Daily reminders
Keeping you on track, making it easy to maintain a consistent Pilates routine.
Take a few minutes each day for self-care, immerse yourself in the world of Pilates! Your body will become leaner, more toned, and healthier, while you'll also experience a more joyful state of mind.

bluejetty:00062610:ios.description:
Pu is a cute little panda who loves to eat, have fun and take selfies. He expects you to feed him, dress him, clean him and take care of him.
Dozens of activities and exciting mini-games are available to take care of your new friend.
Are you ready to take care of your new and adorable virtual pet ?
. ADOPT PU : Give him a special name and make it evolve to reach his adult size. He is so cute !
. DRESS PU : Make the baby Pu cute and adorable like you ! Dress it up in fashion where to disguise it, create your own look !
. FEED PU : Pu loves the tasty and delicious food, it will feast !
. GIVE A BATH : In order for Pu to be clean and pretty, wash it and dab it.
. PLAY WITH PU : Full of fun mini-games to win coins and make Pu Happy ! But also challenges every day to win diamonds !
. SLEEP TIME : After a happy day, Pu is sleepy, lining it up to make him sleep.
. DECORATE THE HOUSE : The walls, floors, carpet, bathtub and still other elements to make your home unique !
This game is a free virtual game created by a small independent developer, a game that caters to small and big, girls and boys and that I hope you will enjoy.
WHO IS THE PANDA ?
Pu is an adorable pet.
He does not know how to care and take care of himself so he expects you to teach him ! Here are a few tips to make him happy and cheerful: Check that he has always eaten enough and that he is clean !
Pu is very gambler, he does not ask much time, play games a few minutes with him and he will be very happy and affectionate but be careful, after playing well it must be given a bath and bed.
He will then be in good shape and will grow quietly.
If you dream of taking care and looking after a cute virtual pet, to see it grow, this game is perfect for you !
Adopt Pu and do in the happiest pets, you have to play !

bluejetty:00040395:ios.name: Detective S: Mystery Game
bluejetty:00040395:ios.summary:
“P, Please. You know how important this case is to S”
'S' lost one and only family in a button murder case.
There was only one reason she became a detective, to solve that case.
Investigate the crime scene with S and arrest the crimin
bluejetty:00040395:ios.description:
“P, Please. You know how important this case is to S”
'S' lost one and only family in a button murder case.
There was only one reason she became a detective, to solve that case.
Investigate the crime scene with S and arrest the criminal!
Find the evidence in the crime scene that differences in the scenes, and try to guess the criminal with the information you have acquired!
“Detective S,” the guessing game using Find the Differences
Escape from the cliché!
※SYNOPSIS
S became a detective to avenge his father "R". 
He was a police killed by a serial killer 10 years ago.
In the end, neither could the police uncover the case.
"S" feels the incompetence of the police.
S became a famous detective later, and while she was investigating on a case, she discovers a “wooden button” with a snake carved on it that looked like what was found in R's belongings.
S hears unexpected news while investigating on a case centered on the “wooden button,” a clue that she discovered in five years.
For five years, 'tree buttons' still remain in many places in unsolved murders...
Mr. S goes out with the police to find the escaped criminal.
※ Features of the game
Escape from the cliché!
▶ The crime scene of the case expressed by the differences
Let's get into the police line! He's already escaped!
From the crime scene to the belongings of the suspects
Find the differences between up and down crime scenes and collect evidence!
▶ A variety of characters, mystery stories that make you sweat with excitement
Let's understand various character relationships through webtoons.
Relationship with the victim through the ongoing conversation with the characters,
Let's get information about the evidence in the crime scene!
Discover the secret hidden ion the cases through interrogations!
▶ I am the true detective! Arrest system
This is no ordinary game of Find the Differences~
One of the four suspects is the criminal!
Find the murderer's murder weapon and the evidence that symbolizes the resentment among the evidence acquired from the picture game and arrest the criminal by matching them with the suspects!
▶ The truth of the case solved by webtoons!
The whole story of the event, which is shown in webtoons by chapter!
A webtoon that unfolds the beginning to the progress of the case appears every chapter!
Make your story more vivid! Have fun with playing the game!

bluejetty:00186657:ios.name: Flashnote Derby
bluejetty:00186657:ios.summary:
Flashnote Derby is a fun, effective way for kids to learn to read music through fast-paced note flashcard games.
Perfect for piano, guitar, band, orchestra, and general music students, this teacher-created app turns note recognition into an
bluejetty:00186657:ios.description:
Flashnote Derby is a fun, effective way for kids to learn to read music through fast-paced note flashcard games.
Perfect for piano, guitar, band, orchestra, and general music students, this teacher-created app turns note recognition into an engaging game that works equally well at home or in music lessons.
————
Learn to Read Music — Fast
Each race is a fast-paced challenge: identify notes correctly as you learn to read music faster and speed your horse toward the finish line. Missed or slow answers allow the other horse to catch up.
After each round, students can review the notes they missed— turning every race into a meaningful learning opportunity.
————
New! Practice Mode (No Timer, No Stress)
Students can now choose a relaxed 'practice mode' with unlimited time for each note.
Perfect for beginners, this mode builds accuracy and confidence before racing competitively.
————
Multiple Ways to Answer
Players can answer flashcards in a variety of ways:
• Play the note on any instrument. Flashnote Derby listens and recognizes what you play (including transposing instruments).
• Use a MIDI instrument
• Tap on-screen letter names
• Or play notes on the on-screen piano keyboard
————
Fully Customizable for Any Student
Tailor each drill to match your student’s level:
• Treble, bass, alto, or tenor clef
• Select specific note ranges or individual notes
• Add sharps, flats, or full key signatures
• Adjust time limits (or remove them entirely in Practice Mode)
• Expand difficulty all the way up to five-and-a-half ledger lines above and below the staff.
As skills grow, you can increase the challenge. Higher difficulty earns higher scores—keeping students motivated.
————
Multiple themes keep practice fresh
In addition to the classic horse race, students can take flight with the whimsical Pretty Pegasus course, blast through an arcade-style space challenge in Ecliptic Encounter, or switch to the seasonal Reindeer Race during the holidays.
————
Built for Teachers, Loved by Students
Flashnote Derby is designed to fit easily into lessons:
• Quick to set up and perfect for a 1–2 minute warm-up
• Send homework assignments directly to students
• Track progress automatically
• See which notes need more review
Teachers see real improvement. Students stay engaged. Parents appreciate the progress.
————
Why Flashnote Derby Works
Many students struggle because drilling note names feels boring and difficult. Flashnote Derby turns this essential skill into a game—one they’ll want to keep playing.
A little daily practice adds up quickly, and students learn to read music with confidence.
————
Get on the road to confident music reading today!
Download Flashnote Derby and help your young musician master notes with joy—not frustration.

Are you looking for a ringtone & wallpaper app with the best music ringtones, wallpapers and hit music ringtones for your iPhone or iPad? No PC or Mac needed to change the ringtone. You must try CallFusion: Ringtone&Poster.
RINGTONE MAKER
Create custom ringtones for your iPhone with ease. Select an audio file from your device or extract the audio from a video. VARIETY OF RINGTONES

• All features 100% free with no disruptive advertisements
• Highly accurate prayer times (Salah / Namaz)
• Sunnah prayers tracking: Tahajjud and Duha
• Beautiful Adhan notifications from world-renowned muadhins
• Smart alarm clock tailored for Fajr and Suhoor
• Precise Qibla compass with interactive map integration
• The Holy Quran with multiple reciters, translations, and Tafsir

• Share prayer schedules to social media or family in just two taps.

• A dependable Hijri guide for your sacred year.

■ Ramadan Fasting Times

With warmth and dedication,
The IslamApp Team

bluejetty:00034882:ios.name: City Transportation Tycoon
bluejetty:00034882:ios.summary:
Build & automate your transport empire! Grow your city offline with idle mechanics, strategic upgrades, and multiple income systems. Perfect for fans of idle tycoon games!
Welcome to City Transportation Tycoon — the ultimate idle city-buil
bluejetty:00034882:ios.description:
Build & automate your transport empire! Grow your city offline with idle mechanics, strategic upgrades, and multiple income systems. Perfect for fans of idle tycoon games!
Welcome to City Transportation Tycoon — the ultimate idle city-building and transport simulator where strategy meets automation.
Start from a small neighborhood and grow into a booming city by upgrading transportation, managing resources, and unlocking powerful systems. In this idle tycoon game, every bus you upgrade, every route you optimize, and every house you build brings you closer to becoming the ultimate transport magnate.
Build & Manage Your Transport Network
Buy and upgrade buses to transport workers who construct homes and city infrastructure. Expand your fleet, increase passenger capacity, and upgrade ticket prices to maximize income.
 Upgrade Your City with Smart Systems
2x Income Manager: Activate time-limited income boosts for faster progress.
Bank System: Store earnings securely and collect interest over time.
Pizza Delivery Service: Deliver pizzas to earn extra cash across districts.
Taxi Pickup System: Pick up residents from various locations and earn bonuses.
Train Station: Bring in more workers and resources faster than ever.
Helicopter Delivery: Fly in planks and materials needed for construction.
Repair Bus System: Maintain your fleet and prevent downtime for maximum efficiency.
Automate Your Empire
Hire managers to automate each system. Let your income roll in while you're away thanks to a robust offline earnings system, complete with a dedicated Offline Earnings Manager to maximize returns during downtime.
Expand Into New Zones
Unlock and develop new city areas as your population grows. With each district you open, fresh challenges and revenue streams await. Strategically decide where to invest next to keep the growth going.
Strategic Idle Gameplay
This isn’t just about tapping — it’s about smart decisions. Balance upgrades, resource flow, and automated systems to create a seamless transport operation and efficient city development loop.
Endless Progression & Satisfaction
There’s always a new upgrade, a better strategy, or a bigger reward just around the corner. Watch your city evolve from a small town to a sprawling, interconnected metropolis buzzing with life, traffic, and opportunity.
Key Features
Addictive idle tycoon and city builder mechanics
Unique systems: pizza delivery, taxis, trains, helicopters & more
Full offline earnings and automation support
Dynamic upgrades for buses, houses, and entire districts
Satisfying city growth loop with deep strategy
No internet required to play
Free to play with optional boosts
Can you build the most efficient transport network and become the richest city tycoon?
Jump in now and see your city grow — one bus ride, one delivery, and one upgrade at a time.

bluejetty:00042339:ios.description:
Plan your day, manage your to-do list, and organize your whole life in one app. ByDesign brings your tasks, daily planner, calendar, and notes together — synced across all your devices.
Features:
Calendar
- Connect as many calendars you want - personal, work or school.
- Manage and time box the tasks from ByDesign in the same calendar.
- Use colors to organize your calendar.
- Create all-day events and tasks and drag them to a specific time to plan efficiently.
Powerful note-taking
- Add attachments - PDFs, photos, audio, web links, and more. 
- Create checklists. Make a grocery list, a wish list, or a to-do list, then tap to check off items as you go.
- Apply different text styles, such as heading or body, bulleted lists, and more.
- Add tables to quickly organize information.
Organize and search
- Search for text in notes, your tasks, and tables.
- Link from one page to another to connect ideas, content, or any information. Try typing “/” for a shortcut to add links and pages while writing in your pages.
- Keep your notes in pages and folders, and sort them in the order you prefer.
- Use drag and drop as a fast and flexible way to categorize and organize your pages. 
Collaborate
- Collaborate on entire pages or sub pages.
- Mention friends to notify them of important updates.
- Select and add comments on a particular text and have a full conversation in the thread.
- Use page comments to discuss anything related to that page.
- See what others updated in a shared page while you were away with alerts.

bluejetty:00114290:ios.description:
DeepScan AI Search Assistant
Discover information faster and smarter with DeepScan AI, an advanced AI powered deep search assistant designed to explore, analyze, and summarize publicly available information from reliable sources.
DeepScan AI uses intelligent Deep Search technology to help you research topics, verify facts, and uncover meaningful insights across the web in a clear, structured, and responsible way.
If you are researching a subject, validating information, or exploring complex topics, DeepSearch AI delivers super fast, accurate, and well organized results powered by modern AI reasoning and smart indexing.
DeepScan AI is built to support deep searches across public information sources, analyze and summarize complex topics clearly, verify information accuracy using AI powered cross checking, discover context rich insights backed by multiple sources, and explore topics efficiently with layered DeepSearch results.
Inspired by modern AI research and deep analysis tools, DeepScan AI acts as an all in one smart assistant for information discovery, knowledge verification, and intelligent search.
DeepScan AI is designed for responsible information discovery. It does not access private data and operates using publicly available information only.
With built in deep verification logic, DeepScan AI helps you stay confident in the information you review while maintaining transparency and accuracy.
DeepScan AI delivers fast AI powered deep search, clear and easy to understand insights, smart topic analysis, intelligent summaries, and a privacy focused design optimized for accuracy and clarity.
Unlock the power of Deep Search, AI driven analysis, and intelligent research in one smart assistant.
The app is free to download with limited access. Some features require a subscription or in-app purchase. Details and pricing are shown before purchase.
Do you have any questions about the DeepScan AI app? We love receiving your feedback. You can reach us at theplusapps@gmail.com

Meet Your Ultimate Cleaning Companion
Use the SharkClean® to schedule cleans, customize maps, set no-go zones, monitor performance, and more. Whether you're at home, at work, or on
vacation, your floors will stay effortlessly clean.

UV Stain Detect™: Illuminates invisible stuck-on messes to see what you can't and cleans what other robots don't. After each run, the robot

Live robot tracking: See exactly where your robot is cleaning whenever you want.

2-in-1), 2700 (Stratos), 2800 (PowerDetect, PowerDetect 2-in-1), 2900 (PowerDetect ThermaCharged), 3000 (UV Reveal PowerDetect).
• Shark® Wi-Fi-Connected Robotic Vacuum

bluejetty:00022649:ios.description:
Meteo.it, l’app con previsioni meteo precise e affidabili grazie ai nostri algoritmi previsionali innovativi. Scarica gratis l’app Meteo.it e imposta il meteo delle tue località preferite, puoi scegliere tra oltre 20.000 località in Italia e nel mondo.
Con la geolocalizzazione attiva le previsioni saranno sempre con te ovunque ti trovi e grazie al nuovo Radar, potrai monitorare la situazione meteorologica in tempo reale!
Con una veste grafica immediata, l’app fornisce tutti i dettagli sulle previsioni del tempo: temperatura, precipitazioni, vento, umidità, pressione, stato del mare, raggi UV, orari di alba e tramonto e stato della luna. Dalla Homepage è possibile inoltre accedere alla nuovissima mappa, che mostra la situazione Radar delle perturbazioni in tempo reale.
Fornisce inoltre dettagli sulle località sciistiche ed i relativi impianti (Numero piste, tipologia, piste aperte), informazioni dettagliate per le località marine (analisi acque, divieti di balneazione) e le osservazioni in tempo reale dai principali aeroporti italiani.
I nostri meteorologi con la loro competenza completano le previsioni con news in tempo reale, articoli editoriali su bollettino neve, smog e qualità dell’aria, cambiamenti climatici e curiosità. Puoi consultare con facilità gli approfondimenti e gli ultimi video TgMeteo realizzati dai nostri esperti e condividere sui profili social previsioni e contenuti.
Previsioni attendibili necessitano di conferme e aggiornamenti: con l’app Meteo.it puoi controllare costantemente eventuali cambiamenti in corso e ricevere notifiche con allerte e approfondimenti. Attiva le notifiche push e resta sempre aggiornato sulla situazione meteo delle tue località preferite!
Con lo scorrimento orizzontale consulti tutte le località che hai scelto o inserito nei preferiti, ad esempio: la tua città, il luogo di lavoro, una località di mare o di montagna.
Con lo scorrimento verticale vedi le previsioni dettagliate delle settimana o dei giorni.
L’app Meteo.it è precisa, affidabile, completa e gratuita!

bluejetty:00079986:ios.description:
Snowbreak: Containment Zone is a 3D Waifu Sci-Fi RPG Shooter. Powered by the Unreal Engine 4, Snowbreak offers a next-gen, cross-platform gaming experience, sharing your progress across all of your devices. 
The Descent of the Titans turned a once-vibrant city into the devastated wasteland of Containment Zone Aleph. As the Adjutant of Heimdall Force, bravely undertake missions alongside Manifestations with the powers of gods and unique personalities, seeking to bring this bitter winter to an end...
[Enjoy Hybrid Combat]
Snowbreak's weaponry injects realism into a sci-fi setting, with designs closely simulating future firearms technology. This combines with the otherworldly, RPG-like skill mechanic to create a refreshing combat experience.
[Take on Titans]
The Descent of the Titans completely changed the world, and the battlefield. Feel the thrill of battling giants in this dystopian future!
[Befriend Operatives]
Spend time with your Heimdall Force companions in the Base system. Decorate, chat, and give gifts to grow closer!
[Play Co-Op in Gigalink] 
Tired of exploring alone? Join up with friends and fight enemies together!

Welcome to the enchanting realm of "Tales & Dragons: New Journey"! In this captivating free, open-world fairy tale idle RPG, you'll embark on a highly engaging adventure. Whether you're in the office or out and about, you can effortlessly enjoy the excitement of an RPG and experience the unique charm of idle mechanics.
In this magical adventure of fairy tales and dragons, you are the chosen Dreamer by destiny. Join forces with your fairy tale Heroes and embark on a thrilling journey in this open-world fairy tale realm! 
[Dragons and Magic | An Epic Fantasy Adventure]
Engage in intense dragon battles alongside over a hundred uniquely designed fairy tale Heroes in the emerald land of Oz. This is not just an ordinary RPG; it's an enchanting fantasy journey of epic proportions!
[Grind Free | A Lifetime of Hands-Free Leisure] 
Bid farewell to monotonous grinding! The auto-play feature ensures you seamlessly progress through the game, thanks to the support of the multi-line idle system. Immerse yourself fully in the card-based experience without the hassle of constant manual operations.
[Fantastic Beginnings | Log in to Claim 1001 Draws] 
Log in and receive 1001 draws as a generous starting gift. Further rewards include legendary Heroes, newbie rewards, and more during the first eight days!
[Deck Evolution | Rich Strategic Combinations]
Explore the intricate interactions of stats and skills, discover the innovative gameplay with magical Relics, and uncover the unique roles of each Hero. Adjust your tactics as needed, unleash the mighty power of divine artifacts, and ensure every strategic choice has a profound impact!
[Thrilling Battles | Bosses Await] 
Are you ready for some intense battles? Lead your team of Heroes and confront the evil boss, Shadow Tyrant, in heart-pounding showdowns, making the fairy tale world great again!
Embark on this incredible adventure, seamlessly blending idle RPG mechanics with the magic of fairy tales and dragons. Your destiny awaits!

bluejetty:00124387:ios.summary:
► A GAME TO KEEP YOU FULLY OCCUPIED
Ever dreamed of running your own hotel? Start from the ground up in this fun and fast-paced time-management game where the aim is to build an accommodation empire and demonstrate your dedication to hospi
bluejetty:00124387:ios.description:
► A GAME TO KEEP YOU FULLY OCCUPIED
Ever dreamed of running your own hotel? Start from the ground up in this fun and fast-paced time-management game where the aim is to build an accommodation empire and demonstrate your dedication to hospitality. Show your skills as a hotel manager, invest wisely in staff and property improvements, and work your socks off to become a hospitality tycoon in this addictive and entertaining casual simulator.
► FIRST-CLASS SERVICE
• Climb to the top: Start the game as a simple bellhop single-handedly cleaning rooms, greeting guests at reception, collecting payments and tips, and keeping the bathroom stocked with toilet paper. As your bank balance expands, upgrade rooms and facilities, and employ new staff to help keep up with the growing demand at your hotel. Your guests may be sleeping comfortably, but there’s no time to rest for a determined hotel tycoon.
• Build an empire: There are several hotels to explore and expand, each with dozens of different unique upgrades to make before you reach five-star perfection. Demonstrate your competence as a manager in each location, then get promoted to get a new and bigger property, and continue your path to becoming a true hotel tycoon. Each hotel has its own style and atmosphere too.
• Keep going: If you want success in this high-stakes industry, you can’t just stroll around your property at a leisurely pace. Upgrade your and your employees’ movement speed to work faster and provide your guests with all the services they need ASAP — it’ll boost your revenue too.
• Amenities are the answer: Maximise profits and get more funds to invest in this fun simulator by ensuring your hotels have all available amenities. Bathrooms are the first step, but work hard and you’ll soon have the opportunity to add vending machines, restaurants, parking lots, and swimming pools to your properties. Guests will pay extra for each facility, boosting your revenue. Though remember each facility also needs staffing, so get hiring or you’ll soon run off your feet with angry guests left standing in line for each amenity.
• Grand designs: Upgrade accommodation to improve guests’ experience of your property and choose from a range of different room designs in each location. In this engaging simulator, you’re not just a manager, you’re an interior designer too!
► FIVE-STAR FUN
Looking for a time-management game that’s original and simple to play and provides endless hours of entertainment? Dive straight into the fast-paced world of hospitality provision and develop your skills as a manager, investor, and designer. Download Hotel Master now and get to work building an accommodation empire.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00126223:ios.description:
Stop spam calls before they waste your time. Spam Call Blocker checks incoming calls against a spam number database that is updated every day and either blocks robocalls, scam calls and telemarketers automatically or shows a spam warning on the call screen, so you know what is calling before you answer.
Got a missed call from an unknown number? Look it up in the app to see whether it is a known spam, scam or robocall number before you call back.
BLOCK SPAM CALLS AUTOMATICALLY
• Robocalls, scam calls, telemarketers and other unwanted calls from a daily-updated spam database
• Works quietly in the background through the iPhone call blocking and identification settings
CALLER ID SPAM WARNINGS
• Prefer to decide yourself? Switch to identification mode: suspicious calls ring through with a spam label on the call screen
• The label shows the type of call: spam, telemarketing, scam, robocall, debt collector or survey
PHONE NUMBER LOOKUP
• Check any unknown number: is it spam, a scam or a robocall?
• Works for phone numbers from all countries
YOUR OWN BLOCKLIST
• Add any number you never want to hear from again
Spam Call Blocker does not show the caller's name: iOS lets call blocking apps add only a spam label.
SUBSCRIPTION
Spam Call Blocker Premium is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage the subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple Account settings after purchase. When you cancel, the subscription stays active until the end of the paid period.
Privacy Policy: https://legal.apptoro.support/hc/en-us/articles/4417734751377

bluejetty:00090630:ios.description:
Motion is an AI-powered all-in-one motion editor that transforms photos and videos into cinematic animated visuals. Powered by advanced AI, Geometric Motion Algorithms, and physics-based animation technology, it intelligently understands depth, structure, and movement to create natural, immersive effects. Easily animate photos, add dynamic motion to videos, and create eye-catching social media content in just a few taps.
Whether you want cinematic video motion, artistic photo animation, or eye-catching social media content, Motion gives you everything you need in one powerful and easy-to-use app.
Key Features of Motion:
• Motion Template
• Video Motion
• AI Video Generator powered by Gemini, Kling, Pixverse, Seedance, MiniMax, Hailuo, Lyria, WAN & Nano Banana
• 3D Photo Motion Animator
• Geometric Motion Algorithm
• Physics-Based Motion Engine
• Animated Border & Background
• Animated Smoky Fire
• Parallax Effects
• Smoke Flow
• 3D Focus
• Reflect Water
• Shadow
• Auto Water Animation
Transform your videos and static images into captivating animated masterpieces with Motion. Experience intelligent motion powered by physics simulation and geometric animation systems designed to deliver realistic and artistic results.
— AI Video Motion Effects
Animate your videos with cinematic motion and dynamic overlays. Add animated effects directly to video clips and create engaging reels or social media content with smooth physics-based motion rendering.
— AI Photo Motion Animation
Transform static images into magical moving artworks with customizable motion paths, speed control, zoom precision, and undo/redo support powered by intelligent motion tracking.
— AI Water Reflection Animation
Instantly add lifelike motion to water scenes with intelligent fluid simulation.
• Create natural water movement in one tap
• Automatically animate oceans, rivers, waterfalls, and reflections
• Realistic flow behavior powered by physics-based motion dynamics
— Geometric Motion Animation Technology
Design captivating structured animations using advanced geometric motion effects.
• Generate rotating structures, spinning elements, and patterned animations
• Bring landmarks and architectural scenes to life creatively
• Apply dynamic patterned motion to structural visuals
— Motion Template
Add dynamic motion with 20 different shapes. Adjust speed, size, direction, and use zoom for precision. Enjoy redo and undo options for perfect drawings.
— Animated Border
Enhance your videos and images with animated borders. Adjust speed, border width, layers, and choose from multiple color sets and unique effects.
— Animated Background
Breathe life into your videos and photos using animated backgrounds with customizable speed, colors, and configuration tools.
— Animated Smoky Fire
Create mesmerizing smoky fire effects with adjustable burn texture, depth, blend control, and movement styles.
— Parallax Effects
Access overlay collections with multiple motion styles and music tracks for immersive animation experiences.
— Smoke Flow
Add elegant flowing smoke effects with customizable color, speed, saturation, and luminance.
— 3D Focus
Bring cinematic depth to videos and images using advanced 3D motion effects.
— Reflect Water
Create realistic water reflections with adjustable motion speed and depth.
— Shadow
Add realistic shadows with customizable size, position, and transparency for perfect integration.
— Export Options
Share your creations in various formats including Still Image, GIF, Video, and Live Photo. Adjust FPS, quality, format, and duration for optimal results.
— Create Without Limits
From artistic photo animation to cinematic video motion editing, Motion combines geometry, physics, and AI intelligence to transform everyday moments into visually stunning masterpieces.

If you're looking for a modern approach to matchmaking that perfectly blends modern outlooks with traditional sensibilities, then start your love story with Aisle.
Over the years Aisle has become the largest community of vibrant Indians, South Asians, Desis, from around the world connecting online to go on meaningful offline dates. 
You can read beautiful stories of couples who met on Aisle at blog.aisle.co
Why Aisle is the Top Choice for Meaningful Dating:
Date-to-Marry Mindset: We’re built for people seeking serious relationships. Our users are high-intent singles who are genuinely ready for commitment and want to find their life partner. 
Verified Profiles, Real Connections: Every profile goes through a 2-step verification process to ensure authenticity and a safe dating experience. We check every profile so you can relax, knowing that Arjun from Bangalore is actually Arjun from Bangalore. 
Intent-Based Matching: Your mother tongue matters. Your Sunday routines matter. We match on the stuff that still matters 20 years from now. Our advanced algorithm considers your core values, life goals, mother tongue, faith and lifestyle - the essential elements that truly matter when building a future together.
Features which helps us standout:
Comments - Start a thoughtful conversation by responding to what caught your eye on someone's profile.
Aisle Concierge - For those who mean business. Handpicked profiles, global reach, and advanced filters to find your match 2X faster.
Private Browsing - Browse with complete control. Especially for women to date safely and confidently.
Advanced Filters - Search for people based on lifestyle preferences and recent activity.
Made for Indians, by Indians: Whether you're in Chennai or Chicago, we get why you need someone who understands both your Netflix queue and your family WhatsApp group. 
Join Millions of Success Stories: It's not about finding someone perfect - it's about finding someone perfect for you. What started as a dating app has grown into a community that proves commitment is what makes love last.
In-App Purchases: Upgrade your experience with premium features.
Aisle Plus: Unlimited likes to connect faster.
Aisle Premium: Everything in Plus, with more tools to deepen your search.
Aisle Concierge: The ultimate experience for high-intent marriage seekers.
Subscriptions renew automatically. Cancel anytime via app settings, 24hrs before renewal.

bluejetty:00115061:ios.description:
Welcome to Screw Block Away: 3D Puzzle, a fresh and relaxing puzzle experience where challenge meets beauty. If you enjoy brain teasers, logic challenges, or simply love relaxing games with visual delight, this is the perfect choice for you.
In each level, your goal is simple yet deeply satisfying: unscrew and remove the blocks that are locked together. Carefully find the right order, free each screw, and gradually clear the entire board. With intuitive controls and smooth animations, every move feels rewarding. As the pieces come loose one by one, you’ll feel the joy of solving puzzles and unlocking progress.
But Screw Block Away is more than just a puzzle—it’s a visual journey. Each stage is designed with stunning scenic backgrounds and beautiful model images, bringing extra charm to your gameplay. Relax on a virtual beach, wander through lush gardens, or enjoy stylish portraits while training your brain.
The game offers hundreds of levels, from beginner-friendly to mind-bending challenges. Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to immerse yourself for hours, there’s always a level waiting to be solved. With increasing difficulty, you’ll sharpen your logic, improve your patience, and enjoy endless satisfaction.
Perfect for fans of relaxing puzzle games, Screw Block Away: 3D Puzzle combines strategy, beauty, and fun in a single, engaging package. Download now and embark on a journey of unblocking screws, solving puzzles, and experiencing breathtaking scenes.

The Atlanta Journal-Constitution is home to the South’s essential stories. We cover the news you need to know and the stories that surprise and delight, with a perspective you won’t find anywhere else. It’s the Substance and Soul of the South. 
Download, subscribe and take all of the AJC with you, wherever you go. 
NEWS FOR ATLANTA, GEORGIA AND THE SOUTH 
Read distinctive reporting that follows the facts and cuts through the clutter. 
Get insights and perspective from Politically Georgia, the state’s best political team. 
Know who and what’s driving Georgia’s economy with the AJC’s business reporting. 
Follow the AJC’s investigations that hold officials and institutions accountable. 
Tap into UATL, a source for Black culture and community in Atlanta. 
SPORTS FOR FANS AND SUPERFANS 
Get on-the-field reporting about Georgia’s pro and college teams. 
Cheer on your teams with our columnists and sports newsletters. 
Follow high school athletics in Georgia with AJC Varsity. 
FOOD, FUN AND FREE TIME 
Find news places to eat with our dining guides and restaurant reviews for metro Atlanta, Savannah and across the state. 
Get out there with our recommendations for things to do — for date nights, family activities and weekend adventures. 
VIDEO STORYTELLING 
Watch journalist-led reporting that unpacks the biggest stories of the day. 
Find videos quickly and view them in a format optimized for your device. 
CUSTOMIZATION 
Easily reorder the sections in the navigation bar so your favorites are first. 
Personalize your notifications for breaking news alerts about topics that matter to you. 
EPAPER 
Read the news page by page in this daily edition. 
Click into articles and hyperlinks.

Get your first week free and explore everything the AJC has to offer in the app and on AJC.com.* 
After the free trial, subscription auto‑renews at $9.99/month or save with $99/year.

You can manage or turn off auto-renew at any time in your Apple ID account settings on your iOS device. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.

bluejetty:00030689:ios.description:
Feeltracker: 4.8 stars with 23K+ ratings • 800K+ downloads • 250K+ users/year • 5M+ saves/year • 96% satisfaction
Track your emotions with AI that listens, understands, and responds. Mood Journal combines intelligent mood tracking with conversational AI chat, hands-free voice conversations, and on-device intelligence to help you discover patterns, manage mental health challenges, and gain insights your therapist will value. Whether you're managing mood disorders or seeking emotional clarity, get compassionate, judgment-free support.
EMPOWERING FEATURES FOR YOUR MENTAL WELLNESS:
• Track moods, emotions, and feelings with detailed entries throughout your day
• AI Face Scanning: capture a selfie for mood suggestions from facial expressions
• AI Scene Scanning: point your camera at your surroundings for mood insights
• Support for CBT, DBT, and other therapeutic approaches
• Discover patterns and triggers with intelligent trends and visual analytics
• Multiple daily check-ins to capture your emotional fluctuations
• Medication and therapy tracking to monitor treatment effectiveness
• Add notes and context to understand your emotional patterns
YOUR PRIVACY, OUR PRIORITY:
• No account required—start tracking immediately with complete anonymity
• Apple Intelligence (iOS 26+): run AI fully on-device, 100% offline and private
• All data stays on your device with optional iCloud backup
• Export your data anytime in PDF, CSV, Excel, or JSON formats
DESIGNED FOR DAILY USE:
• Beautiful Liquid Glass design with calming Dark Mode
• Quick-entry widgets for logging moods directly from your home screen
• Smart reminders, 24-hour clock option, localized in-app FAQ
• Photo attachments to capture visual mood memories
PROFESSIONAL-GRADE INSIGHTS:
• Comprehensive analytics reveal mood patterns over time
• Interactive charts—tap any point to view detailed mood entries instantly
• Weekly, monthly, and six-month averages for therapist visits
• Track correlations between activities, sleep, and emotional states
• Generate detailed reports for healthcare providers or therapists
AI-POWERED FEATURES:
• Voice Chat: hands-free two-way conversations with the AI
• Ask a Question: instant answers about your mood patterns
• Chat: interactive conversations about your emotional wellbeing
• Voice Summary: audio summaries of your mood trends
• Trigger Identifier: discover what affects your mood
• Cognitive Reframing: fresh perspectives on negative thoughts
• Sentiment Timeline: visualize your emotional journey
• Pattern Detective: discover hidden correlations in mood data
• Goal Assistant: personalized mental wellness goals
• Doctor Summary: professional summaries for therapists
• Deep Research Report & Pro Health Report for deep analysis
• Song Recommendations: music matched to your mood
• Make Me Laugh, Calm Me Down for Sleep, Personalized Quiz
• Personalized greeting shares the meaning of your name
• Optional profile context (age, gender, sleep schedule, weather) for sharper insights
FREE WITH PRO OPTIONS:
• All core features completely free
• Pro unlocks Trigger Identifier, Cognitive Reframing, deep AI analysis, and Apple Intelligence mode
• Affordable pricing to support your long-term mental health journey
IMPORTANT HEALTH DISCLAIMER:
This app is for personal tracking and informational purposes only. AI insights and recommendations do not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified mental health provider before making health decisions.
Privacy Policy: https://feeltracker.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://feeltracker.com/terms/
