bluejetty:00174343:ios.description:
Your story lives in Tulsa. From reporting on all of your favorite teams to the news that matters most in your community, we cover it all. Get in-depth stories from the Tulsa area and beyond – including breaking news, sports, opinion, obituaries, entertainment, and politics.
Easily access the very latest news in an app built for you. Read, see, and hear exclusive commentary, stunning photography, video updates, and binge-worthy podcasts. Support local journalism by subscribing today for unlimited digital access.
Our app features:
* Your Stories – personalize your experience by selecting the local Tulsa news topics that matter most to you
* Get notified – stay in the loop by selecting alerts for news, sports, weather, and more
* Easy navigation – see all the latest local stories in northeastern Oklahoma by simply swiping up/down, and left/right
* Read stories your way – either in the News Feed or via the E-edition
* Breaking news updates – top banners let you know what’s happening right now
* Continue watching – pause a video and pick up where you left off across devices
* Bookmark for later – save stories to enjoy at your leisure
* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access to breaking news updates, analysis, and more.
Get the Tulsa World in Your Inbox
Get convenient, curated updates delivered to your Inbox. Sign up for Breaking News updates as they happen, the Afternoon Update for a roundup of the latest local top stories, TU Sports for Golden Hurricane coverage, Food & Drink for foodies, Garage Sales for bargain hunters and many more.
Visit https://tulsaworld.com/newsletters/ to view and subscribe to all of the Tulsa World Newsletters.
Keep Up with the Tulsa News
Follow us on Facebook and other social platforms:
https://x.com/tulsaworld
https://www.facebook.com/tulsaworld
https://www.instagram.com/tulsaworld/ 
About the Tulsa World
The Tulsa World has been providing its growing audience with the best, most complete news, sports, entertainment, business and shopping information since 1905. We offer exclusive Tulsa, OK content and advertising online, in print and through Apple apps. 
We'd love to hear what you think! For any technical issues or questions, contact us at https://tulsaworld.com/contact/
https://tulsaworld.com/terms/

bluejetty:00122248:ios.description:
Let's go do stuff, IRL. Discover local guides, events, experiences, & things to do with trusted recommendations from our team.
UNATION features tons of stuff to do in cities across the country. Events are not only user-generated, but also hand selected by our curators, guaranteeing we present you with the best happenings in the area. Whether you’re looking for a concert, sporting event, farmers market or anything in between, you’ll find it on UNATION. 
DISCOVER
Searching for events nearby? Want to find something to do this weekend? UNATION is the go-to app for finding the best things to do. Our curated guides include everything from local events and tickets, our favorite restaurants and bars, places to stay, and so much more, all in one place. 
UNCOVER
Our locally-curated Guides will be your go-to resource for hidden gems, beloved businesses, pro tips, and more. We write about the things we know and love, so you're always getting the latest inside scoop on the best things to do. 
CUSTOMIZE
We only bring you the type of stuff you love to do. We'll get to know you and your interests within the app, so your entire Home Feed feels like a custom experience. Save your favorite UNATION content to the Collections that you create and organize just the way you like. 
PURCHASE
We've partnered with your favorite major ticketing platforms for all the best events! We can help you seamlessly and securely buy tickets through our app, so you can spend less time scrolling and more time enjoying your city. 
CREATE
Turn your ideas into successful events with powerful tools built for organizers. UNATION makes it easy to create, manage, and sell tickets to conferences, festivals, corporate events, workshops, fundraisers, and more — with no platform fees for you, so you keep 100% of the base ticket revenue while buyers cover a small service and processing fee.
PROMOTE
Are you an event creator or business owner? Awesome, welcome to UNATION! Let's get your content onto our app and in front of our audiences. Want to take it a step further? You can get even more exposure by allowing our promotion experts to drive more traffic to your event than ever before. 
It’s time to put the screens down, grab your crew, and start exploring with UNATION!

bluejetty:00034152:ios.description:
Mood tracker by Zenly is your go-to app for daily journaling your mood. 
Unlike traditional mood journaling apps, Zenly actually helps you get deep insights, learns mood patterns and helps you stay positive.
Whether you want to understand your emotional patterns, learn what triggers you, improve your mental well-being, or just want to keep a track of your moods at different times of the day, Zenly can do it all. Isn’t it amazing?
With Zenly you don’t just track your mood, you also track your feelings, the weather, the people influencing your mood, and much more. Not only that, you can also add your own sections for better understanding of your mood and there’s a supportive community which can help you when you feel low.
Key Features
 Personalized Experience: Tailors your mood-tracking experience to your needs and gets personalized reports based on your daily mood tracking.
‣ Mood Journal: Log your daily mood quickly and effortlessly. Also, add notes, voice notes, and mood photos to your tracker to refer to in the future.
‣ Detailed Insights: Get detailed analytics to understand your mood patterns over time.
‣ Visual Maps: Access mood bars, graphs, triggers, your emotions and much more. Visual graphs to boost your understanding.
‣ AI Summary: Turn the data-driven reports into easy-to-understand summaries with AI in just one click.
‣ Sleep Tracker: Track your sleep regularly to see how your sleep is affecting your mood.
‣ Journal: Monitor past feelings and moods with your mood diary. Listen to your recorded voice notes to understand your state of mind.
‣ Community & AI Support: Join the different supportive Zenly Community or talk to an AI Friend whenever you feel like the mood is getting the better of you.
‣ Fidgets: Want to tackle anxiety? Manage anxiety with calming fidgets designed to help you relax.
‣ Affirmations: Boost how you see yourself with positive words of affirmation designed to improve your mindset.
‣ Secure Your Entries: Your mood is safe with us. Secure your entries and data with a face ID lock.
Understanding your moods helps you manage them and feel better faster. If you are more aware of your moods, you can better manage your lifestyle choices, make informed health decisions, prevent or avoid triggers of negative moods, and work towards a better quality of life.
Use Zenly to take care of your emotional health. Breathing exercises, fidgets, and other tools are designed specifically to help you during your mood swings. These tools can help you control your emotions.
Journal for your mental & emotional health! Download Now and take a step towards a better you.

bluejetty:00030383:ios.summary: Discover the colorful world of adventures in the game "Bobatu Island". The uninhabited island hides many stories and secrets, but only to those who are not afraid to go on this journey, wise ancestors will reveal the secret of an ancient ci
bluejetty:00030383:ios.description:
Discover the colorful world of adventures in the game "Bobatu Island". The uninhabited island hides many stories and secrets, but only to those who are not afraid to go on this journey, wise ancestors will reveal the secret of an ancient civilization.
Key features of the game "Bobatu Island":
EXCITING PLOT:
Together with the main characters of the game, you have to cross the ocean and uncover the secret of a lost civilization. Touch the world of adventure, solve the secrets of ancient temples and stone idols and go through all the puzzles and trials to save your friend!
JOURNEY:
You are with us along the way! Amazing adventures await you at the very edge of the earth: wild beaches, rocky shores, dormant volcanoes, marshy swamps, impenetrable forests and mangrove jungles. And if you try to enter a dark cave, you will surely find a mountain of gems and meet the one who lives there.
STUDY:
Explore the surroundings of the island properly! Among the thickets you can see abandoned temples, majestic ruins and mysterious mechanisms. Rumor has it that they keep the secrets of a lost civilization.
FUN FISHING:
You will need a fishing rod and bait to try your luck at fishing. And the most nimble and experienced natives will be able to cook their catch in the Tropical Kitchen.
TROPICAL FARM:
Gather juicy fruits and fruits from exotic trees, plant and grow crops, and have your own animals. Set up your farming business and be ready for new adventures!
AMAZING FINDINGS:
Mysterious artifacts and mythical treasures promise fame, wealth and good luck! Find out if the stories and legends that these lands keep are true!
TROPICAL TRADE:
The doors of the merchant's shop are open for travelers! Collect coins, make purchases, sell and exchange the collected resources, and decorate and develop your base on the island with the proceeds.
BUILDING AND CRAFTING:
Build buildings and upgrade buildings to unlock new types of crafting and create even more unique resources. Build bridges and ferries to explore the most remote places of the island. To travel to the ends of the earth, build a raft, but if you want, you can make a real ship out of it.
GAME FEATURES:
You will find funny 2d animation, funny characters, dozens of bright locations, daily events, intuitive controls and many unique game mechanics. The game "Bobatu Island" can be played offline, but in order to save game progress and send and receive gifts to friends, you need to connect to the game server.
Surviving on the island is not an easy task, these tips will come in handy:
 - Gather resources, craft tools and weapons to explore the island and develop your base.
 - Meet the inhabitants of tropical islands, new acquaintances and friends will be useful to you!
 - To get a big harvest, buy additional plots of land in the tropical shop.
 - Farm and look for seeds of new plants to develop your garden and vegetable garden.
 - Tropical cuisine is your key not to feel hungry. Build this building and learn how to cook food, drinks and other dishes.
 - Don't forget to take care of the animals so that your pets bring valuable resources.
 - If you install fences, your animals will be safe and predators will not be able to get to them.
 - Be careful! Wild and very hungry animals can hide in the jungle!
 - Be more decisive! Closed doors and stone walls are no reason to retreat! To overcome the obstacles formed, look for keys, create master keys or try to find a workaround.
 - Be attentive! Bushes, palm trees, and flowers can hide something important from view!
Trust the spirits of the island! Beware of traps and use clues to solve the riddles of abandoned temples and find your missing friend.
When you first launch the game you'll need to download about 100MB.
Privacy Policy:

listings.name: Bobatu Island: Survival Quest
listings.description:
Discover the colorful world of adventures in the game "Bobatu Island". The uninhabited island hides many stories and secrets, but only to those who are not afraid to go on this journey, wise ancestors will reveal the secret of an ancient civilization.

Key features of the game "Bobatu Island":

EXCITING PLOT:

Together with the main characters of the game, you have to cross the ocean and uncover the secret of a lost civilization. Touch the world of adventure, solve the secrets of ancient temples and stone idols and go through all the puzzles and trials to save your friend!

JOURNEY:

You are with us along the way! Amazing adventures await you at the very edge of the earth: wild beaches, rocky shores, dormant volcanoes, marshy swamps, impenetrable forests and mangrove jungles. And if you try to enter a dark cave, you will surely find a mountain of gems and meet the one who lives there.

STUDY:

Explore the surroundings of the island properly! Among the thickets you can see abandoned temples, majestic ruins and mysterious mechanisms. Rumor has it that they keep the secrets of a lost civilization.

FUN FISHING:

You will need a fishing rod and bait to try your luck at fishing. And the most nimble and experienced natives will be able to cook their catch in the Tropical Kitchen.

TROPICAL FARM:

Gather juicy fruits and fruits from exotic trees, plant and grow crops, and have your own animals. Set up your farming business and be ready for new adventures!

AMAZING FINDINGS:

Mysterious artifacts and mythical treasures promise fame, wealth and good luck! Find out if the stories and legends that these lands keep are true!

TROPICAL TRADE:

The doors of the merchant's shop are open for travelers! Collect coins, make purchases, sell and exchange the collected resources, and decorate and develop your base on the island with the proceeds.

BUILDING AND CRAFTING:

Build buildings and upgrade buildings to unlock new types of crafting and create even more unique resources. Build bridges and ferries to explore the most remote places of the island. To travel to the ends of the earth, build a raft, but if you want, you can make a real ship out of it.

GAME FEATURES:

You will find funny 2d animation, funny characters, dozens of bright locations, daily events, intuitive controls and many unique game mechanics. The game "Bobatu Island" can be played offline, but in order to save game progress and send and receive gifts to friends, you need to connect to the game server.

Surviving on the island is not an easy task, these tips will come in handy:

 - Gather resources, craft tools and weapons to explore the island and develop your base.
 - Meet the inhabitants of tropical islands, new acquaintances and friends will be useful to you!
 - To get a big harvest, buy additional plots of land in the tropical shop.
 - Farm and look for seeds of new plants to develop your garden and vegetable garden.
 - Tropical cuisine is your key not to feel hungry. Build this building and learn how to cook food, drinks and other dishes.
 - Don't forget to take care of the animals so that your pets bring valuable resources.
 - If you install fences, your animals will be safe and predators will not be able to get to them.
 - Be careful! Wild and very hungry animals can hide in the jungle!
 - Be more decisive! Closed doors and stone walls are no reason to retreat! To overcome the obstacles formed, look for keys, create master keys or try to find a workaround.
 - Be attentive! Bushes, palm trees, and flowers can hide something important from view!
Trust the spirits of the island! Beware of traps and use clues to solve the riddles of abandoned temples and find your missing friend.

When you first launch the game you'll need to download about 100MB.

bluejetty:00074438:ios.description:
Music is listened together. Now also decided together. - With mubo.
Connect to a Musicbox or create your own. Your Musicbox is ready to use within seconds. Just add a Playlist and press play. Just try it, it's really that simple.
The idea: The song with the most votes is the furthest up in the playlist of the Musicbox. To keep it exciting, the cooldown resets all votes after a fixed time and everybody can vote again.
You can add your own music or easily add music from AppleMusic, Spotify, Audius or YouTube to your Musicbox. Then you just have to start your Musicbox and your guests can already vote for their favorite songs. If you allow it, your guests can even add songs to your Musicbox. The song with the most votes is the furthest up in the playlist of your Musicbox. To keep it exciting, the cooldown resets all votes after a fixed time and your guests can vote again.

bluejetty:00161816:ios.name: Res i STHLM
bluejetty:00161816:ios.summary: Simplify your traveling in Stockholm using Res i STHLM, a free journey planner for SL, the Stockholm region's public transport authority. Either you're traveling by bus or commuter train, metro or light rail, the app helps you plan you whol
bluejetty:00161816:ios.description:
Simplify your traveling in Stockholm using Res i STHLM, a free journey planner for SL, the Stockholm region's public transport authority. Either you're traveling by bus or commuter train, metro or light rail, the app helps you plan you whole journey easily. 
Functions: 
Search trip - Specify where you want to travel within the Stockholm region and get proposals for journeys including the subway (metro), commuter trains, local trains, buses and boats among others . Select real time or scheduled departure times. See walking path on the map.
Right exit - See which exit/entrance in subway you should go to.
Next departure - Showing current departure times for any chosen stop and line.
Favorite locations - Save your favorites to speed up future trip searches and view upcoming departures . These are available in the Apple Watch extension as well and enable you to look up departures directly from the Apple Watch.
 Traffic state - Showing any disruptions or deviations affecting the public transport.
Share trip - Send trip details by sms, email or other sharing options.
Reminder - Specify how many minutes before departure you want to be reminded, and the app will remind you either in the iPhone or in your Apple Watch (when the phone is in sleeping state).
Buy SL single ticket - For your chosen trip, the app can hand over zone information to simplify your ticket purchase from SL. Note: The app itself does not save the ticket, it only assists you to start the buying process correctly. 
Automatic language support for English and Swedish. Ability to change in settings.
The app supplies information about all of SL:s public traffic thanks to the Trafiklab API:s SL Place locator, SL Nearby stops, SL Journey planner, SL Realtime information, SL Traffic situation och SL Deviation information.

bluejetty:00026997:ios.name: KIRA STOKES FIT
bluejetty:00026997:ios.summary:
Purposeful movement. Proven results.
The Kira Stokes Fit App delivers full-body strength, mobility, and core workouts powered by The Stoked Method™—Kira’s proprietary science-backed training system developed over 30 years of hands-on exper
bluejetty:00026997:ios.description:
Purposeful movement. Proven results.
The Kira Stokes Fit App delivers full-body strength, mobility, and core workouts powered by The Stoked Method™—Kira’s proprietary science-backed training system developed over 30 years of hands-on experience with clients of all levels.
Whether you're at home, traveling, or in the gym, the app gives you access to highly effective, structured programming that builds strength, improves mobility, enhances endurance, and supports total-body function—at every stage of life.
Why The Kira Stokes Fit App Stands Out:
The Stoked Method™
Kira’s signature training system is known for its intelligent layering, movement progressions, and total-body focus. Each workout is designed to optimize efficiency, challenge the body safely, and help you move better—not just during workouts, but in daily life.
Smart, Sustainable Training
From 10-minute finishers to 60-minute full-body sessions, the app meets you where you are and helps you stay consistent—whether you’re new to movement, coming back from a break, or leveling up your training.
Train Anywhere, Anytime
With minimal equipment—bands, sliders, a ball, and optional weights—you can take your workouts with you wherever you go. Most workouts are bodyweight-friendly and travel-ready.
Real-Time Coaching with Kira
Every workout is guided by Kira’s real-time coaching, form cues, and motivation. It’s like training with a top-tier coach in your own space, on your schedule.
For Every Body
Stoked programming is designed to support strength, energy, and longevity for all. It’s low-impact where needed, highly intentional in structure, and scalable based on your fitness level. You won’t find random workouts here—just smart, effective training that respects your body.
Consistent Progress Without the Guesswork
The app includes curated weekly Stoked Stack Attacks, structured programs, and challenges that take the guesswork out of training. You’ll build momentum, stay engaged, and feel the difference week after week.
Key Features:
+ Full-body training programs rooted in The Stoked Method™
+ Core, strength, mobility, glutes, and recovery flows
+ Equipment-based and bodyweight-only workouts
+ Workouts from 10 to 60+ minutes
+ Monthly challenges and weekly workout stacks
+ Expert form cues and coaching in real time
+ Filter workouts by time, focus area, and intensity
+ Constantly updated with new releases every 2 weeks
--------------
KIRA STOKES FIT includes Apple Watch
- You can track your workouts and meet your fitness goals.
- Monitor Stats during Workouts: View heart rate/calories burned on your watch & video player.
- HEALTH App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Health app (Healthkit) to track workouts, duration, calories burned, heart rate, and active energy. You choose the data you want stored, and you can change it anytime in the Health app.
- FITNESS App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Fitness App, and workouts contribute to your daily goals. View stats, share your activity, and get those Activity Rings!
- Use your Watch as a Remote: Play, stop, & rewind videos without interrupting workouts.
- Install using iPhone: Install app on iPhone, open Watch app, select "Show on Apple Watch".
--------------

Cancel anytime in Account Settings.

bluejetty:00137460:ios.description:
One stroke is a very fun puzzle game. When it comes to One Stroke, the first thing that comes to your mind may be the pentagram. But in fact, this type of game can be said to be a representative of casual games that are easy to learn and difficult to master. And the patterns that can be created with just one stroke are also intricate and complex. 
Don't underestimate this seemingly simple game. Click on the origin of each aperture to connect the line segments without interruption, but the line segments that have already been illuminated can not be reconnected until the completion of the graphic shown is a successful breakthrough. It's a simple game, but you can kill a lot of time with your brain. It's time to exercise your logical skills. Are you ready to take on the challenge?
Game features:
1. The game graphics are non-interference and easy to think about. The screen is very concise, with rounded elements reflecting the cute style, making it more exquisite.
2. The game won't be monotonous: it will randomly change colors and animations.
3. The levels are designed cleverly with simple lines, bringing you endless fun.
4. It can activate your brain, engage in flat thinking, exercise divergent thinking, and spend leisure time.
5. The game has a lot of levels to give you endless fun!
Tips:
The difficulty of the game will increase step by step. Because the later patterns are more complex with more connection points. At this point, let's not rush to move. We need to figure out how to connect the patterns before connecting them. But even if you make a mistake, it doesn't matter, there is a restore button below, you can revert to the previous step. This type of game is a great test of brain. If you encounter patterns that you cannot pass, you can also post them on the our official Facebook page for help. Let's hurry up and get to the next level! See how many levels you can pass.
Come and try the limits of your brain, waiting for you to challenge!

bluejetty:00041364:ios.description:
You have a little, nagging question at 3:00 a.m. Wouldn't it be great to talk to a nurse right away and get the answer? Turn to your Regence Pregnancy Program app for trusted pregnancy and parenting information, plus click-to-call directly to our maternity nurses.
The Regence Pregnancy Program app is for Regence members. Regence is a family of regional Blue Cross and Blue Shield health plans in Oregon, Washington, Idaho and Utah, connecting people and their families to health care when and where they need it most. 
With your Regence Pregnancy Program app, you can track your pregnancy through each milestone and trimester. In-app tools help you navigate your health and learn about the growth of your baby each day. After baby comes, support continues from pregnancy to parenthood, including health tracking just for baby.
Use this app to: 
- Get notifications about important health to dos and more.
- Learn about signs and symptoms to watch out for with smart search in the Learn Library. 
- Track your weight gain, baby’s diapers, and more.
- Watch videos about your baby’s weekly development.
- Find local resources and learn about programs you may be eligible for.
- Create a list of questions for your doctor.
- Relax and reset with a breathing timer.
This app is designed to help keep you and your baby healthy throughout pregnancy and beyond. 
PREGNANCY
- Pregnancy and postpartum to dos 
- Week-by-week development milestones 
- Due date calculator 
- Blood pressure tracker
- Weight tracker 
BABY & TODDLER AGES 0-2
- Developmental milestones 
- To dos for baby’s first 2 years
- Diaper tracker
- Feeding tracker
- Growth tracker
NEW PARENTS
 - Tips on challenges facing new parents, including postpartum depression screening 
 - Life hacks for new parents like sleep, swaddling and traveling
REGENCE RESOURCES & CONNECTIONS
 - Simple click-to-call for 24/7 access to Regence Pregnancy Program maternity nurses
 - Reminders for childbirth classes, postpartum check up and well-baby check ups
 - Access to breastfeeding supplies
 - Store all of your doctor’s appointments and questions in the Q-List.
The content for the Regence Pregnancy Program app was developed in conjunction with a board-certified OB-GYN, nurse midwives and other medical experts. Please send your comments and suggestions to feedback@wildflowerhealth.com.
The Regence Pregnancy Program app is for educational purposes only. Medical advice is not provided. Do not rely on information in this app as a tool for self-diagnosis. Always consult your doctor for appropriate examinations, treatment, testing, and care recommendations. In an emergency, dial 911 or visit the nearest hospital.

bluejetty:00132315:ios.name: Radio Mariam-Arabic
bluejetty:00132315:ios.developer: ASSOCIAZIONE RADIO MARIA A.P.S. ENTE MORALE RICONOSCIUTO
bluejetty:00132315:ios.summary: Radio Mariam is the first Radio Maria in Arabic. It was founded in December 2015 in order to give Arab Christians a voice and to support evangelization and the process of peace in the countries of the Middle East, answering the call of Pope
bluejetty:00132315:ios.description:
Radio Mariam is the first Radio Maria in Arabic. It was founded in December 2015 in order to give Arab Christians a voice and to support evangelization and the process of peace in the countries of the Middle East, answering the call of Pope Francis to help the Arab Christians, especially in this very difficult moment. 
Thus Radio Mariam broadcasts began with the opening of the Jubilee of Mercy. It is a sign of the Mercy of God in the heart of all Arabic speaking people and a sign of hope for all the suffering and persecuted Christians. 
This station will be the voice to and from the Arabic speaking Christians in the Middle East and around the world, with their culture and the multifaceted religious heritage of the different churches to which they belong.
The main purpose of this project is to give support and consolation to persecuted Christian community in Muslim countries at war.
Radio Mariam Arabic will be the symbol of peace and reconciliation in the various communities in the middle east area, preventing these very ancient communities from disappearing because of deportations and forced displacement. Hence, Radio Mariam Arabic will spread their voice everywhere, keeping alive a great religious tradition which unites the whole Christian world .
The broadcast of Radio Marian Arabic is made via web and via satellite from a central studio and from mobile studios spread all over the Middle East Region and managed by local dioceses .

Protect Your Phone Number. Block Spam Calls. Communicate with Confidence. 
Your phone number is your digital identity.

YouMail protects your phone number by blocking spam calls, identifying unknown callers, screening suspicious calls, protecting your voicemail, and helping reduce your online exposure so you stay in control of who can reach you. 
Answer your phone with confidence, not uncertainty. 
Join more than 13 million people who trust YouMail to block scammers, protect their privacy, and take back control of their phone number. 
1. Stop Spam Calls & Robocalls 
Stop unwanted calls before they interrupt your day. 
Powered by one of the nation's largest spam intelligence networks, YouMail automatically blocks spam calls, robocalls, spoofed callers, telemarketers, scam callers, and other unwanted calls while helping legitimate callers still reach you.

Free Features

• Robocall Blocking 
• Caller ID for Unknown Callers 
• Scam Text Protection 
• Privacy Scan to identify exposed personal info 
• Voicemail Protection 
Need even more protection? 
Upgrade for Advanced Protection 
•Screen unknown calls 
• Force spammers to prove they are human 
• Ensure only good calls ring through 
• Second phone number keeps work and private life separated 
Advanced Call Screening asks unknown callers to identify themselves before your phone rings, helping you avoid scammers while making sure legitimate callers can still reach you. 
2. Protect Your Privacy Online 
Your phone number shouldn't be easy to find. 
Data brokers collect and sell your personal information, making it easier for scammers, robocallers, identity thieves, and unwanted callers to reach you. 
YouMail helps you: 
• Discover where your personal information is exposed with Privacy Scan 
• Remove your information from participating data broker websites (Plus) 
• Reduce your digital footprint 
• Make it harder for scammers to find your phone number 
The less information available online, the more control you have over your privacy. 
3. Keep Your Phone Number Private 
Not everyone needs your personal phone number. 
Whether you're shopping online, selling on Marketplace, dating, traveling, applying for jobs, running a business, or signing up for new services, YouMail helps you protect your privacy with a second phone number. 
Stay in control by: 
• Using a second phone number for work or personal use 
• Keeping your real number private

• Separating your personal life from your public life

Perfect for:

A small business owner managing customer calls 
A gig worker protecting your personal number 
Someone tired of spam, robocalls, and unwanted interruptions

Whether you're blocking spam calls, protecting your privacy, removing your personal information from the web, or keeping your phone number private with a second number, YouMail gives you the tools to communicate with confidence. 
Because your phone should connect you with the people you want to hear from, not the ones you don't. 
Download YouMail today and discover why more than 15 million people trust YouMail to protect their phone numbers, privacy, and peace of mind.

bluejetty:00030156:ios.description:
Hunch is built for one thing: getting you on a real date, faster and with less effort. Not more swipes. Not more endless chats. An actual plan, with an actual person, in the real world.
Why Hunch is different
Dating today doesn't fail because you lack options or intent. It fails because interest rarely turns into action. Conversations stall. Plans dissolve. Dating becomes background work you manage indefinitely — and nothing moves.
Hunch takes that burden off you. We handle the intros, the place, and the time — so the real work can happen on the date, not before it.
How it works
→ Share when you're free — set your general availability, not a rigid calendar. Hunch works around your life.
→ Meet people ready to date IRL — everyone on Hunch is here to actually show up. No browsers, no collectors, no one using this as a second Instagram.
→ Everyone is verified — 100% photo-verified profiles, so you know you're connecting with a real person.
→ We suggest the plan — Sia, your matchmaker, recommends a venue, a time, and makes the intro. You just show up.
This is for you if...
You're done with the setup work. You'd rather spend your energy on the date itself — not the weeks of texting that never turn into one. You don't need an app to decide for you. You need one that gets you into the room.
This is not for you if...
You enjoy browsing matches, collecting conversations, or using dating apps for entertainment. Hunch is built for follow-through, not for browsing.
The rest of the magic happens in real life.
Download Hunch and go on your next date.
Terms: https://hunchapp.com/terms-of-use | Privacy: https://hunchapp.com/privacy-policy | Support: customersupport@hunchapp.com

bluejetty:00075132:ios.name: zFuse - Video Player
bluejetty:00075132:ios.summary:
- zFuse can play all video formats and encodings, allowing you to play video files on your mobile device without the need to convert to MP4.
- zFuse supports ASS/SSA/SUP effect subtitles, enabling you to experience full subtitle effects ju
bluejetty:00075132:ios.description:
- zFuse can play all video formats and encodings, allowing you to play video files on your mobile device without the need to convert to MP4.
- zFuse supports ASS/SSA/SUP effect subtitles, enabling you to experience full subtitle effects just like on your PC/Mac.
- zFuse features powerful networking technologies that allow you to play media from your PC or NAS directly, without occupying any space on your limited device storage and without needing to download anything.
- zFuse also allows you to easily download files or directories directly from your PC or NAS, making it the perfect companion for your trips.
- zFuse supports a variety of gestures - simply move your fingers to adjust playback position, font size, volume, and brightness.
- zFuse carefully protects your privacy with folder encryption, so you no longer need to worry about privacy issues.
- zFuse's detailed features include:
 * SMB/CIFS playback and discovery (easily play media files from your PC).
 * Download media files or directories from SAMBA/DLNA/WebDAV/FTP directly.
 * UPnP/DLNA playback and discovery.
 * Emby and Jellyfin media server support.
 * AirPlay playback.
 * Picture-in-Picture mode support.
 * iPad split-screen multitasking support.
 * Hardware acceleration.
 * HDR Tone Mapping support on non-HDR displays.
 * Subtitle effects support.
 * 0.5x-3.0x playback speed control.
 * 0.5x-5.0x screen zoom.
 * Media preview while seeking.
 * Built-in audio enhancement.
 * Multi-soundtrack selection.
 * Embedded/external subtitle track selection.
 * Subtitle synchronization.
 * Audio synchronization.
 * External subtitle font selection support.
 * Playlist file preview before playback.
 * Blu-ray directory playback.
 * Real-time playlist management and editing.
 * Screen mirroring.
 * File Management:
 - Delete, move, rename, create folders.
 - Wi-Fi file transfer support without USB cable connection.
 - Streaming media playlist creation support.
 - File decompression support: 7z, zip, rar, tar, bz, bz2, etc.
 * Gesture Controls:
 - Horizontal drag: adjust playback position.
 - Vertical drag on left side: adjust volume.
 - Vertical drag on right side: adjust brightness.
 - Pinch to zoom: adjust screen size.
 - Double-tap: play/pause.
 - Two-finger double-tap: change video aspect ratio.
 * External Keyboard Support:
 - Space: pause/play.
 - Left Arrow: backward seek.
 - Right Arrow: forward seek.
 - Esc: exit playback.
 - S: change playback speed.
 - B: play previous.
 - N: play next.
 - Z: change screen scale.
 * Supported Video Formats: MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WMV, FLV, RMVB, ASF, OGV, Blu-ray ISO and more.
 * Supported Audio Formats: MP3, WAV, WMA, FLAC, APE and more.
 * Supported Subtitle Formats: SRT, SSA, ASS, SUP, VTT.
 * Supported Image Formats: JPG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, GIF, HEIC and more.
 * Supported eBook Formats: EPUB, TXT, PDF.
 * Code Editor Supported Languages: JSON, HTML, XML, C/C++, Lua, Java, Objective-C, Swift, Python, JavaScript.
 * Supported Document Formats: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Numbers, Keynote, Pages, RTF, CSV.

bluejetty:00074632:ios.description:
The Field Magazine is the essential read for lovers of country sports, rural living and the great British outdoors. For over 170 years, it has celebrated the spirit, traditions and pursuits of country life, offering unmatched expertise and inspiration across shooting, hunting and fishing.
Every issue delivers:
- In-depth coverage of game shooting
- Expert gun and kit reviews
- Beginner fishing tips and seasonal tactics
-Top dog training advice and stories from the field
- Delicious recipes 
- Insightful pieces on country houses, woodlands, outdoor activities and rural lifestyle
- Perspectives and stunning photography on life in the rural UK countryside
Whether you’re passionate about outdoor activities, preparing for the shooting season or simply enjoy the elegance of country living, The Field is your monthly guide to the very best of the countryside.
Download now and enjoy the UK’s most respected countryside magazine.
-------------------
Once you’ve downloaded our app, you will need to take a free trial or purchase a single issue or subscription to access our in-depth content. We also publish specials and guides - browse our publications, read what interests you most, and get inspired.
Back issues, specials, and future issues are available for purchase within the app. Subscriptions are available on various monthly and annual terms, and auto-renew until you decide to cancel it. Check inside the app for current pricing.
*** Please Note: Our digital edition is not printable and does not include the covermount items or supplements you would find with the print edition ***

bluejetty:00024589:ios.description:
Whether you run out of space or get a new phone, backing up your precious memories from your phone is important and makes room to keep creating new ones! Keep your photos, videos, and contacts safe and secure with the Ultimate Backup family of products.
• On-The-Go - A must during travel, Ultimate Backup can be used anytime and anywhere.
• Free up Space - Backup your current device to Ultimate Backup then delete the photos and videos off your phone to make room for more, knowing they are safe & secure on your Ultimate Backup! 
• Compatible - Ultimate Backup works on most mobile and desktop platforms. Ultimate Backup recognizes each device and knows where each backup left off making it easy to share with the whole family. 
• Secure - With a portable backup device, your files are always kept private and protected.
• Convenient - Want to show someone pictures from your computer or another device? Just plug your Ultimate Backup drive in to view, manage, and share those files! 
• Backup & Restore - Do you have an old phone with tons of awesome pictures and videos or maybe your phone broke and you need a new one? Easily transfer your photos, videos and contacts from one device to another with Ultimate Backup.
* Some features vary depending on the type of Ultimate backup drive and type of iOS device you own.

bluejetty:00063730:ios.description:
MISSOURI LOTTERY OFFICIAL APP
The new official Missouri Lottery® app is here! Scan your Draw Games and Scratchers tickets to check for winners and easily enter them into your My Lottery Player’s Club account for a chance to win in promotional drawings and shop in the digital store. The store features Missouri Lottery coupons that can be redeemed at licensed retail locations, as well as e-gift cards and other digital prizes.
App features include:
• Scan your ticket to see if it is a winner.
• Scan your ticket directly into your My Lottery account.
• View Scratchers game details and remaining prizes.
• Easily access the player’s club for new Rewards, Points for Drawings, your Points balances, Order History and more. 
• Create and store digital playslips.
• See current second-chance promotions.
• Check winning numbers and prizes paid.
• Find a retailer.
We made every effort to ensure the information in this application is accurate; however, in the event of a discrepancy, the winning numbers and prize amounts in the official records of the Missouri Lottery shall prevail.
The Missouri Lottery designs its games to be fun entertainment, and we encourage our customers to play responsibly. Only Missouri Lottery licensed retailers are authorized to sell and validate Missouri Lottery tickets. For detailed game odds and information, visit MOLottery.com. Must be 18 years or older to purchase a Missouri Lottery ticket. All Missouri Lottery proceeds go to public education. Apple is not a sponsor or involved in lottery activity in any manner.

bluejetty:00035047:ios.summary: Ancients Reborn is a popular MMORPG that combines the intricate mechanics of a modern online role-playing game, with the nostalgic lineage of old-school MMORPG adventure games. Play casually with your friends or as a hardcore adventurer and
bluejetty:00035047:ios.description:
Ancients Reborn is a popular MMORPG that combines the intricate mechanics of a modern online role-playing game, with the nostalgic lineage of old-school MMORPG adventure games. Play casually with your friends or as a hardcore adventurer and destroy your enemies in battle.
Beautifully Crafted Fantasy Adventure
A hand-crafted vibrant 3D fantasy world with a feel similar to classic old-school MMO role-playing games.
Feel the nostalgia of a classic dungeon crawling experience with unique styles of play and a modern look and feel. Adventure your way through a glorious open world.
Elegant Offline Automation System
Casually progress when offline by hiring workers to mine ore, catch fish, and chop trees. Then take your resources to be crafted into useful equipment, weapons, and food for healing while adventuring.
A fantastic old-school role-playing experience, but with casual role-playing advantages!
Defeat Epic Dungeon Bosses
Crawl through the huge open-world labyrinths and catacombs in a party with your friends, defeating ancient dragons and hoards of godly, legendary enemies.
Style your Appearance
Thousands of possible character configurations and customizations. Utilize uniquely stylized armor and the best weapons to further enhance your look.
Conquer a Vast Variety of Skills and play styles
From combat skills and equipment crafting to cooking and mining, there is a huge range of character skills to level up.
Play as a merchant and trade with other players to become a popular hero known throughout the kingdom, or partner with guild friends to form a legendary clan. Mastering your skills will make you a legend in this Open-World MMORPG.
Exciting PvP and PvE
A multiplayer role-playing game where you raid tombs for legendary loot, slay dragons, and vanquish beasts.
Play online as a dragon hunter or a humble merchant. Only you can carve out your fabled destiny.
It's a top RPG experience, so you will easily find other battle-worthy opponents for some challenging player vs player (PvP) action.
A fantasy game filled with adventures and the best MMORPG quests, top RPG battles and fun awaits.
Leaderboards and Events
Rise to glory and be recognized by thousands of other players competing on the multiplayer leaderboards!
Enjoy the social aspects of a large open-world MMORPG with immortal dungeons and exciting RPG encounters.
A Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game for players who enjoy open-world fantasy adventures.
Join us on Discord:
https://discord.gg/CdzJp3B
Privacy Policy:
https://xislegames.com/privacypolicy.htm
Terms of Use:
https://ancientsreborn.com/termsofuse.htm

Join MIR4, the unique open world K-Fantasy MMORPG.
Train your characters in MIR4 and help them grow stronger. Triumph in countless battles. Those who win the war become kings, and that clan will gain absolute power and honor. 
MIR4 has diverse growing systems so anyone can become strong through time and effort. A small difference can change the outcome. The wars aren’t just fought with strength - strategies in the growth system and war tactics are a must.
New Armor and Accessories appear in the Land of Mir.
Enjoy more intense battles with the newly craftable NEW Armor 'Belt' and NEW Accessory 'Seal'!
Celebrate the update with exciting events packed with generous rewards.
Experience new opportunities for growth in the Land of Mir — right now!
■Key Features
Warriors, which path would you choose in the land of MIR?
Would you like a brand new heart pounding experience?
Perhaps live a peaceful life through hunting and gathering?
Or even wage war against other warriors and clans to conquer over all.
Follow your heart and choose your path.
This is where your story begins... MIR4.
*Beauty and elegance of Oriental movement
Experience the elegant style of oriental martial arts combined with real-time fluid combat motions.
*All paths lead to your growth
Every trade has its master! Tired of hunting? Try gathering or mining.
All of your activities in MIR4 will ultimately reward you with character growth.
Your time and effort spent in-game never goes to waste!
*AI system moderates and prevents fraudulent transactions
Sophisticated AI system identifies and prevents bot farmers and abnormal transactions, providing a healthy and safe trading environment for all Warriors in MIR4.
*Free Looting
Unprecedented Free-for-All looting system where anyone has the right to claim loot.
Be aware of others when attempting to loot!
*Blue Dragon Statues and Token of the Ancient Dragon, rewards from your adventures within the land of MIR. 
Your time and effort in MIR4 yields great rewards!
Various adventures and contents in MIR4 will handsomely reward you with Blue Dragon Statues and Tokens of the Ancient Dragon!
Collect these rewards to trade in for heroic items
*From my battle to our war, Castle Siege.
Endless adventures to overcome my limitations,
Facing the challenges of life and death along side clanmates.
Compose an epic story through countless glorious battles.
At the end of your conquest, the strongest Clan will be born!
For your Clan's honor and your legacy, start your war now in MIR4!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/mir4global

iOS 13 or later, iPhone 7 or later

“From my BATTLE to our WAR”
Join MIR4, the unique open world K-Fantasy MMORPG.

Train your characters in MIR4 and help them grow stronger. Triumph in countless battles. Those who win the war become kings, and that clan will gain absolute power and honor. 

MIR4 has diverse growing systems so anyone can become strong through time and effort. A small difference can change the outcome. The wars aren’t just fought with strength - strategies in the growth system and war tactics are a must.


New Armor and Accessories appear in the Land of Mir.

Enjoy more intense battles with the newly craftable NEW Armor 'Belt' and NEW Accessory 'Seal'!

Celebrate the update with exciting events packed with generous rewards.
Experience new opportunities for growth in the Land of Mir — right now!


■Key Features
Warriors, which path would you choose in the land of MIR?

Would you like a brand new heart pounding experience?
Perhaps live a peaceful life through hunting and gathering?
Or even wage war against other warriors and clans to conquer over all.

Follow your heart and choose your path.
This is where your story begins... MIR4.

*All paths lead to your growth

All of your activities in MIR4 will ultimately reward you with character growth.
Your time and effort spent in-game never goes to waste!

Sophisticated AI system identifies and prevents bot farmers and abnormal transactions, providing a healthy and safe trading environment for all Warriors in MIR4.

Be aware of others when attempting to loot!

Various adventures and contents in MIR4 will handsomely reward you with Blue Dragon Statues and Tokens of the Ancient Dragon!

bluejetty:00165344:ios.description:
Covering novels of various genres like Romance, CEO, Sci-FI, Werewolf, Fantasy, Paranatural, Vampire, and so on, DeeReader provides readers with a perfect reading experience with its comfortable interface and rich content.
DeeReader has five main features. Enjoy your reading by searching or filtering the keywords in your mind. 
Synchronous Updating
To get a better reading experience, our system will keep updating daily with the pace of the writer. Readers will obtain the latest chapters in time without waiting too long.
Various Genres
Find the book by filtering the categories: Werewolf, Romance, CEO, Reborn Heroes, World of Wuxia, Adventure, etc. Whether you’re looking for more LGBT, Fairy Tales, Forbidden Love or Thrillers to read, there is always one kind in your taste on DeeReader.
Personalized Recommendation
Based on your past reading habits, DeeReader will also send personalized recommendations for you. You can quickly pick them up and have fun reading immediately.
Read everywhere, anytime!
You can start a journey by reading novels online, or download the novel to continue reading when you’re offline. 
Customize Shelf
Add the novels you like to the shelf so that you can find them and continue to read easily.

bluejetty:00040652:ios.description:
Plume – Tes fiches de révision, tes quiz et ton coach IA
Plume transforme tes cours en fiches de révision claires, en quiz et en cartes mémo, en quelques secondes. Pensée pour les élèves de collège et de lycée, elle t'accompagne du contrôle de la semaine jusqu'au brevet et au bac.
CRÉE UNE FICHE EN QUELQUES SECONDES
 • Scanne une page de cours ou un polycopié : Plume en fait une fiche structurée
 • Importe un document ou un PDF
 • Rédige ta fiche à partir de zéro, avec une mise en forme propre
 • Enregistre un audio : ton résumé oral devient une fiche écrite
 • Fiches adaptées à ton niveau, du collège à la terminale
RÉVISE AVEC LES BONS OUTILS
 • Quiz générés à partir de chaque fiche pour te tester tout de suite
 • Cartes mémo (flashcards) pour retenir les notions clés
 • Exercices d'entraînement générés sur ta fiche
 • Mode audio pour réviser dans les transports ou avant de dormir
UN COACH IA QUI T'EXPLIQUE
 • Pose une question sur ta fiche et obtiens une explication claire
 • Prends en photo un exercice : le coach te guide étape par étape
 • Il reformule, donne des exemples et vérifie que tu as compris
ORGANISE TES RÉVISIONS
 • Toutes tes fiches classées par matière
 • Retrouve en un instant la fiche à revoir avant un contrôle
 • Révise un peu chaque jour, même cinq minutes
TOUTES LES MATIÈRES
Français, mathématiques, physique-chimie, SVT, histoire-géographie, anglais, espagnol, philosophie, SES et bien d'autres.
POUR QUI ?
 • Collège : devoirs, contrôles et préparation du brevet
 • Lycée : bac de français, spécialités, grand oral
 • Tous ceux qui veulent réviser efficacement sans y passer leurs soirées
ILS UTILISENT PLUME
 « Application parfaite pour créer des fiches de révision rapidement. Les quiz sont idéals pour réviser tous les jours. »
 « Très utile pour réviser dans les transports ou entre deux devoirs. »

bluejetty:00091998:ios.description:
My CHI. My Future.’s goal is to connect every teen in Chicago to meaningful out-of-school time opportunities, both in-person and virtual.
Now, you can access thousands of youth focused opportunities and activities from across the city using the My CHI. My Future. mobile app.
FIND THE PERFECT OPPORTUNITIES JUST FOR YOU
● Select an interest area to explore
● Search opportunities by keyword
● Filter your search results by location, age, date, and price
ACCESS THE TOP EVENTS AND ACTIVITIES AROUND CHICAGO
● Select events and activities that fit your interests
● View events and activities near you
● Plan ahead by searching for events by date and location
NEVER MISS OUT ON AN UPCOMING PROGRAM
● Save upcoming opportunities for later
● Share your favorite events and activities with your friends and family
● Receive reminders about your saved opportunities
PERSONALIZE THE APP TO DEFINE YOUR EXPERIENCE
● Get age-specific recommendations
● Let the app update your recommended activities and events based on your current location
● Include your interests and goals to receive the most relevant recommendations
ABOUT My CHI. My Future.
The City of Chicago’s My CHI. My Future. App provides you access to all the best events, programs, jobs and resources for youth throughout Chicago.
Easily personalize your experience through interests, age, date and distance to quickly identify opportunities for you. Save your favorite programs to receive notifications later or apply / register now through the organization’s site. Let the My CHI. My Future. App be your source for all the best opportunities all year long in Chicago.

bluejetty:00167489:android.description:
Team up with the mighty warrior Prince Arthur Brightborn on a journey through the lands of Vathria! You will travel far and wide across this magical landscape, amass treasures, recruit champions from diverse races, and leverage your strategic skills to battle powerful enemies alongside your teammates. Make friends with warriors worldwide in guilds, dominate the arena, and prove your wisdom and courage.
Start this epic adventure now! You have been chosen to become a legend!
▶Game Features
Explore the Fantasy World
Travel across different regions, face down strong opponents, and uncover hidden treasures. With exquisite 3D modeling leading the way, you'll experience original stories and unveil the secrets of diverse factions and races.
Aid Prince Arthur in clearing his name and uncovering the truth of the monstrous threat on the horizon; every decision will impact your destiny.
Recruit Legendary Champions
Recruit champions from 22 factions, forming teams of humans, dwarves, undead, high elves, faeries, and more. Engage in thrilling chapters to defeat formidable bosses with your unparalleled squad.
Equip and enhance your champions; unlock multiple artifacts to reveal new appearances and stories.
Engage in Tactical RPG
Experiment with various champion combinations, master the timing of skill release, and equip unique artifacts. Defeat fearsome dragons, demons, treants, and other corrupt beasts to win rich loot.
Use strategy to arrange unique defensive line-ups so that even underdogs can secure victories in the arena.
Experience Rich Guild Gameplay
Join a guild and form alliances, unlock special Titans to win guild battles with guild members, and exchange for generous rewards for free.
Servers host players from across the globe, supported by an in-game translation system that allows for seamless chatting and strategy exchanges with players from other countries.
Follow Ace Alliance's official Facebook page to participate in exciting events organized by our team, and receive even more gifts and important updates to our game.

bluejetty:00092347:ios.description:
EXCH Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with EXCH Mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the EXCH Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a EXCH Mobile digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00132071:ios.description:
Mail App for Gmail is a brand new app for the next generation of Gmail. It’s perfect for quickly triaging your inbox and uses Gmail’s blazing fast new platform to instantly send and receive messages.
Mail App for Gmail features:
- Fast tools for managing your email
- Multiple Actions
- A brand new, rock-solid codebase written entirely in Swift
- Zero wait time for launch
- Much more reliable performance on Virtual Private Networks (VPN) since it does not use IMAP or POP connections
- A beautiful interface built on a custom new animation engine
- Instant sync thanks to secure, all-HTTPS communications
Note that Mail app for Gmail a native Gmail app for triaging recent email, but not currently an archival utility for searching your entire history.
We’d love to hear what you think about Mail app for Gmail. To reach us, use the in-app support option in settings.
 Mail app for Gmail is an auto renewable subscription:
- Badge removal
- Realtime Inbox Monitoring for Notifications
- Themes

Any unused portion of a free trial period, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

bluejetty:00100739:ios.description:
“Leaving life’s mess for an ideal realm of words.” —The New Yorker
“My favorite iOS app for writing in Markdown, without question, is iA Writer. iA Writer is just beautiful. To me, it’s the gold standard for Markdown syntax styling... an elegant champagne flute. That’s iA Writer for me.” —John Gruber
“iA Writer creates a clean, simple and distraction-free writing environment for when you really need to focus on your words.” —The New York Times
“iA Writer is an example of how powerful simplicity and accessibility can be.” —The Guardian
“iA Writer is all about textual production—writing this phrase, this sentence, this word at this moment.” —WIRED
4 x Best of App Store Winner
# The Simple Writing App
iA Writer removes distractions. Giving you a calm, focused, writing space, so you can express yourself clearly.
# Focus
Focus Mode dims everything but the current sentence or paragraph, helping you stay in the flow.
# Start
Don’t worry about the format. First, write in plain text. Then preview in HTML. 
# Organize
Search, sort, and quickly swap between documents from different clouds.
# Customize
When you tap and hold a key in the command keyboard, you’re given the chance to choose your own layout. Rearrange your keys, or pick new ones from the extensive list.
# Search
You can open documents and launch frequent actions in no time with the new Quick Search. It lives in the keyboard so it’s always close at hand.
# Work
iA Writer includes an inverted light-on-dark-mode, perfect for working day and night.
# Clean
Spot superfluous adjectives, weak verbs, repetitive nouns, false conjunctions and clean your text of the usual rumble. 
# Shape
Customize your templates and export to WordPress or Medium, HTML, Microsoft Word (.docx), or PDF. 
# 100% Text
Embed links, pictures, tables and text files in plain text and see them in preview.
# Get in Touch
- Visit ia.net/writer for more information
- Visit ia.net/writer/support for support and feedback

bluejetty:00173623:ios.name: Bodybuilding.com - Fitness App
bluejetty:00173623:ios.summary:
Welcome to the new Bodybuilding.com app. 
Designed with seven different ways to workout, trackable health metrics, a customized social experience and an in-app shopping hub for your supplements needs, the BBCOM app is the key to unlocking
bluejetty:00173623:ios.description:
Welcome to the new Bodybuilding.com app. 
Designed with seven different ways to workout, trackable health metrics, a customized social experience and an in-app shopping hub for your supplements needs, the BBCOM app is the key to unlocking your true potential. Though don’t just take our word for it. Dive into why you should download the Bodybuilding.com app now.
1. Choose Your Workout Experience 
Follow along with guided workouts led by our coaches, choose an accessory, dive into a multi-week program, design your own workout/progrram, stack your experiences, or learn new moves with our movement library. There’s a way to work out for everyone. 
Our team of Master Coaches consists of accredited professionals with decades of experience. They’ll lead multiple modalities ranging from strength and hypertrophy to body recomp and performance. Need a time out? Pause a workout at any time to watch the movement tutorial without exiting. Time for a rest day? Jump into an accessory to take a breathwork, stretching or mobility sequence. 
Take planning into your own hands by constructing a workout or program specific to you. Build out your calendar using the move library or stack pre-existing workouts together. Find your routine with endless possibilities.
2. Connect With Likeminded Users
Chasing goals requires support, and when it comes to finding support, community is king. Build your profile, share content, and scroll the feed to find your favorite lifters, workouts, and accounts. 
Don’t want to share with the world? No sweat. Set your profile to private and accept invites when they come. You’ll be able to like, comment, share and save content in your feed. Stay tuned for our “Groups” feature coming in 2025- where locals can plan meetups IRL, because nothing beats training together.
3. Track Metrics and Store Data
Stored in your profile, connect to Health Kit or Google Health Services to stay on top of heart rate, calories, and other key metrics. Trying to break down your splits? “Blue Man” is here to help track which muscle groups you’ve worked this week to help inform your next workout selection. 
We’ll be revealing fitness devices eligible for syncing in 2025.
4. Earn Badges and Rewards
It’s true, we’re all still utterly obsessed with collecting badges, and you can collect a set of your very own in the app. From “total weight lifted” milestones, to streak celebrations and limited-edition holiday badges, there’s a new goal to chase every month. Don’t worry, we reward recovery warriors, too. 
Be on the lookout for future badge releases. Have a concept? Hit up our team to bring your badge to life.
5. Shop Supplements
Yes, you’ll be able to shop for your favorite supplements directly in the app. Did we mention it’s as easy as one click? Annual members will be eligible to year-round free shipping on orders, 10% off our Signature™ line (+ ALL its new products), and if you join now, you’ll earn a $49.99 product coupon to kickstart your journey. The ease of merging supps with your workout plan is here. 
Later this year we’ll be activating a feature that helps you track when it’s time to restock based on your workout routine.
== Subscriptions and Terms ==
The Bodybuilding.com Fitness app offers two auto-renewing All-Access subscription options: monthly and yearly plans.
Annual: $59.99
Monthly: $9.99
The subscription is auto-renewable. This means that it will automatically renew unless you turn off auto renewal in account settings in the App Store after purchase. We also offer a one month free trial to new subscribers so that they can start making gains right away.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00043470:ios.description:
The story of Kadriye Baştürk began with the dream of becoming a qualified company and a world-famous brand, which is indispensable for its quality and wants to be remembered with its original and time-defying designs. In line with this vision, the brand, which attracted great attention with its trendy designs and extraordinary craftsmanship, managed to make its name known in a short time. It took its place in the sector as one of the most admired fashion brands. Taking quality and elegance as its mission, it has further strengthened its position at the top as a unique brand with the attention to detail in its designs.
It was founded by Kadriye Baştürk, a luxury clothing brand with a dynamic spirit and a distinctive image. The brand, which is the choice of strong women, opened its first store in Ümraniye in 2016, promising complete elegance, expanded its service network by opening 9 more stores in 5 years. From the start, Kadriye Baştürk has attracted the attention of its customers by combining its trendy designs with extraordinary craftsmanship and creating a passionate customer base with its collections, and has become a well-known brand in the fashion world. By incorporating a wide range of collections including clothing, shoes and bags, it has become a versatile brand where everyone can easily find pieces that appeal to their own style, and it has managed to make a name for itself. The various successes and determination in the field of business and fashion took place as two important factors that brought the Kadriye Baştürk brand to its current position. The brand, which has succeeded in establishing a throne in the hearts of its customers with its striking designs and perfecting its quality, has developed itself in the field of e-commerce in 2016 and continues to expand its customer base and reach all over the world today, and will continue to do so.

bluejetty:00060843:ios.description:
----Manage Your Business, Any Time, Anywhere----
√ An official Alibaba product
√ Provides services for businesses on Alibaba.com, and is an essential app for any e-commerce business
√ Dedicated to providing solutions for businesses and increasing operational efficiency
----Basic Description----
The official Alibaba Supplier app serves as a dedicated e-commerce store operation, business management, and information and communication mobile tool for businesses all over the world. With Alibaba Supplier, you can easily manage store merchandise and orders, check shop data and messages, process quotes, and take advantage of business opportunities anytime, anywhere, allowing you to best manage your valuable time and better interact with potential buyers.
----Main Features----
[Workbench] Provides core operational data and a personalized operation page that includes plugins for things like products, order transactions, member management, inquiries and requests for quotation (RFQ). Shop owners can add or delete plugins freely to build their own personalized workbench.
[Messages] Notification messages for the receipt of goods, orders, business opportunities and campaigns.
[Chat] Inquiries from buyers can be answered in the blink of an eye. Alibaba Supplier supports a computer and mobile device being logged into the same account at the same time so that no transactions will be missed. There are also several ways to chat such as voice and video chat, and you can also check the read/unread status of messages and quickly understand what the buyer wants.
[Services] Provides e-commerce services to businesses and increases their operational efficiency.
[Headlines] Abundant and up-to-date e-commerce news with diverse content such as official laws, marketing strategies, high-quality products and live videos.
----Contact Us----
If you encounter any problems while using Workbench, please contact us at:
- Online assistance: Go to Qianniu > Me > Settings > Questions and Feedback
- PC official website: www.alibaba.com
- Mobile phone official website: m.alibaba.com

From the makers of Bloons TD 6 comes a revolutionary collectible card game featuring th
bluejetty:00035139:ios.description:
The Storm gathers, and only true Heroes can stem the Bloon tide. Gather up your cards, choose your favorite Hero, and enter the Arena to claim victory!
From the makers of Bloons TD 6 comes a revolutionary collectible card game featuring the fan-favorite Monkeys and Bloons, rendered and animated in gorgeous 3D. Develop deep strategies, build your collection by crafting awesome cards, and carefully construct decks to help you win PvP and single player games.
Featuring 4 unique Heroes with 3 Hero Abilities each, 130+ cards at launch, and 5 different Arenas to battle on, the tactical combinations are endless!
BALANCE OFFENSE AND DEFENSE
Monkeys can't attack other Monkeys, so you'll need to stock up on both Bloon AND Monkey cards in order to win. Send Bloons swarming at your opponent, fend off opposing Bloon rushes with your Monkeys, and find that perfect balance essential for victory!
USE HERO ABILITIES WISELY
Playing Bloons will power up Hero Abilities that can turn the tide of battle in your favor. Whether it is Quincy with his bow or Gwen with her flamethrower, each Hero has a unique set of potent Hero Abilities. Choose them wisely!
TEST YOURSELF IN SOLO ADVENTURES
Looking for something more relaxing than fur-flying PvP action? Our solo Adventures are crafted single-player experiences that will test your deck building and game management skills to the limit. Try out the Prologue Adventures or support the game by buying the full DLC Adventures.
FULLY CROSS-PLATFORM
Take your collection of Bloons and Monkeys with you wherever you go, as Bloons Card Storm is fully cross-platform - just register your account and your progress stays with you.
BUILD THE BEST DECKS
Build crazy combo behemoths, fun theme decks, or use the latest meta decklists - the choice is yours!
PLAY AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS
Private match support at launch so you can challenge your friends to a game anywhere, anytime! Matchmaking is also fully cross-platform so what are you waiting for?
Download now and join the Card Storm!

- Easy connect and control media playing
- Full playback controls, add and remove videos from playback queue.
- Cast video, photo, music from Camera Roll to TV.
- Cast any media files from Dropbox & Google Drive Cloud.
- Web video streamer
How TV-Cast works: To use TV Cast, simply connect your iPhone,iPad and Chromecast device to the same network
Notice
* Remember connecting to your Chromecast Device before start playing video.
* iTunes movies, Flash video, and DRM protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO now are not supported!

DOOR brings together keyless access, smart home control, and on-demand services in one intuitive app. It’s designed to simplify life for residents in modern buildings.

 Send secure, time-limited access to guests or service providers—no handoffs required.

 Adjust lights, temperature, and more to fit your routine, even while you’re away.
 - Get real-time updates
 Receive alerts when doors are opened, humidity rises, or motion is detected or, so you're always informed.
 - Book trusted home services

 - View your private access log
 See who entered your unit and when, while your access history as a resident is private and only visible to you.
DOOR is designed to feel intuitive and effortless. It’s how modern buildings stay connected—and how residents stay in control.
Already live in a DOOR-enabled building?
Download now and experience simpler, smarter living.

bluejetty:00073757:ios.description:
Transform any text, PDF, document, cloud file, or webpage into high-quality audio with NaturalReader. Trusted by over 1 million monthly users and backed by 15 years of AI technology experience, we are the ultimate tool for productivity and accessibility.
GET STARTED INSTANTLY
Start for Free: No account required to start listening.
No Ads: Enjoy a completely ad-free experience so you can focus entirely on your content.
EXPERIENCE NATURAL TEXT-TO-SPEECH
Listen to Any Text: Seamlessly support for PDF, Cloud Files (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive), MS Word (.doc & .docx), MS PowerPoint, Mac documents, RTF, TXT, DRM-free EPUB eBooks, and image files.
OCR Camera Scanner: Snap a photo of a physical book, handout, or printed notes to convert them into spoken audio instantly.
Download MP3: Save audio files in MP3 format for offline listening on any device.
Cross-Platform Sync: Create a free account to sync your history across devices. Start listening on your mobile device and seamlessly switch to the NaturalReader Online Reader.
NATURAL READING EXPERIENCE
Customizable Tones & Delivery: Use a simple prompt to customize the tone and delivery of your narrator to perfectly match your content.
200+ High-Quality Voices: Access 200+ AI voices in 90+ languages. Find the perfect narrator for any type of document.
Speaker Controls: Speed up playback (up to 5x) to save time, or slow down (0.5x) for deep comprehension. Adjust the number of speakers, pause duration, and sentence repetition, perfect for language learning.
AI-POWERED PRODUCTIVITY
AI Podcasts: Condense long readings into engaging AI Podcasts to consume content faster.
AI Recap: Instantly generate concise summaries of your documents.
Voice Cloning: Create a custom AI voice that sounds just like you.
AI Quizzes: Study smarter by testing your knowledge with automatically generated quizzes.
ACCESSIBILITY & READING TOOLS
Dyslexia Friendly: Enhanced reading support with dyslexia-friendly fonts and customizable reading modes.
Visual Aids: Follow along easily with synchronized word/sentence highlighting and closed captions. 
Annotations: Highlight important passages and add notes to organize key information effortlessly.

bluejetty:00034615:ios.description:
Stuck in a loop of endless tasks and screen fatigue?
Unwind with Woodle Screw®! Experience the ultimate wood puzzle where satisfying unscrewing mechanics meet addictive match-3 clearing. Remove the pins, match the colors, and let the ASMR sounds melt your stress away.
Gameplay
In this ultimate screw game, your goal is to clear the board, collect keys, and rebuild an entire city.
· Match 3 screws of the same color to clear them from the board.
· Plan your moves carefully before unscrewing a bolt
· Remove nuts and bolts in the right order to avoid getting stuck
· Earn keys by conquering boards to unlock treasure chests
· Use tools and drill boosters when faced with a tricky board
Enjoy the satisfying fun of restoring landmarks with every unscrew challenge you solve.
Why You'll Love Woodle Screw®
Play Offline Anywhere
· Fully optimized as one of the best offline games available
· Continue your city rebuild anytime, anywhere — no Wi-Fi required
Color-Blind Friendly
· Clear visibility for every pin, bolt, and board element
· Quick and easy to turn on in Settings
No one misses out on the fun of unscrewing!
No Annoying Ads
· Enjoy uninterrupted puzzle-solving with zero forced interruptions
· Watch optional rewarded videos only if you want extra progression items
Play at No Cost
· Access every core board and rebuild milestone entirely through logic
· Optional in-app purchases are available for cosmetic items or convenience only
City Rebuilding
· Transform landscapes and bring a beautiful city back to life
· Save your city and collection across devices automatically
ASMR Soundscapes
· Enjoy the crisp click of a wood screw and gentle metallic tones
· Experience a deeply rewarding and relaxing audio profile
Woodle Screw® is more than a game — it's a journey where logic, strategy, and creativity come together.
Ready to challenge your mind and build something extraordinary?
Download Woodle Screw™ Pin Nuts & Bolts now!

bluejetty:00072490:ios.description:
→ Tune your brain & ADHD Relief — Brainwaves Binaural Beats.
→ Better sleep & relaxation — Green Noise.
Brainwaves First: 5 Mainstream Sounds to Quiet Your Mind Quickly
1. Delta wave (0.5–4 Hz): Linked to dreamless sleep and deeper rest. Helps support better deep sleep.
2. Theta wave (4–7 Hz): Supports meditation, creativity, and sleep during the REM phase.
3. Alpha wave (7–13 Hz): May encourage relaxation and calm.
4. Beta wave (13–30 Hz): May help promote concentration and alertness.
5. Gamma wave (>30 Hz): Supports maintaining arousal and mental engagement while awake.
Brainwave Scenarios (Quick Picks)
* Morning Coffee: Gentle Alpha + Beta waves to start the day.
* Espresso Shot: Energizing High Beta + Gamma binaural tones.
* Morning Meditation: Alpha + Theta for a centered mind.
* Focused and Alert: High Beta + Gamma to maximize focus.
* Critical Thinking: Theta + Mid-Beta blend to boost logical thinking.
* Concentration: Mid Beta binaural tones for steady concentration.
Key Features
1. Expertly curated library of premium soundscapes.
2. Adjustable volume with high, medium, and low settings.
3. In-depth insights plus audio-visual recommendations for each track.
4. Audio categorization tailored to common scenarios.
5. Personalized recommendations based on diverse needs.
6. An immersive interface—visually and auditorily—for your pathway to tranquility.
Healing Frequencies & Calming Tones
* 285 Hz tones promote tissue repair, release tension, and renew energy.
* 741 Hz: Natural tranquilizer that calms the mind, releases body tension, reduces anxiety, and enhances sleep.
* 528 Hz “Love frequency” is thought to bring transformation, increased energy, awareness, creativity, and inner peace.
* 432 Hz music reduces anxiety, lowers cortisol, and eases stress-related symptoms like headaches and tension.
SUBSCRIPTION
Healing Sleep offers monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscription options to get unlimited access to all content in the app. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Terms of service: https://bettersleepcycle.com/terms
Feedback: support@bettersleepcycle.com
