bluejetty:00091445:ios.description:
"Are you ready to laugh, recycle, and shed a rusty tear? The evil Baron Blightsworth is trashing the planet and it looks like you are the only one who can stop him!
It’s time to turn junk into gold and scrap into stacks of cash! Dive into an easy-to-learn, addictively fun idle tycoon game where you’ll clean up the waste, build a thriving empire, and prove that one person’s trash is another person's treasure - maybe even worth a fortune!
Why You Won’t Be Able to Put Down Idle Junkyard Tycoon!
- Trash to Treasure – Transform mountains of garbage into glittering gold! From rusty scraps to hidden gems, every piece of junk has potential. Upgrade, automate, and profit!
- Collect & Command – Recruit quirky managers with unique abilities. Will you choose the hustling businessman, the mysterious miner, or maybe the recycling-obsessed cat? Build your dream office and let your crew do the dirty work while you watch your junkyard empire grow!
- Build Your Fleet – Select and expand your fleet of garbage trucks. Upgrade them to carry more scrap, waste, and hidden treasures from the depths of your junkyard.
- Unique Play Mode - City Clean Up Mode where players clean up the city with their super trucks.
- Upgrade Your Factory – Your junkyard isn’t just a pile of trash—it’s a fully automated recycling machine! Upgrade crushers, sorters, and shredders to turn scrap into valuable materials and keep your tycoon business booming!
- Expand Beyond the Junkyard – Why stop at one dump? Conquer new lands, oceans, and even distant fields in your quest to turn the world’s garbage into gold!
- Earn While AFK – This idle simulator never stops! Your managers, trucks, and factory keep making money even when you’re offline. Sit back, relax, and watch your junkyard empire thrive!
Whether it’s the satisfaction of crushing a car, the thrill of finding hidden treasure, or the joy of automating your junkyard business, Idle Junkyard Tycoon promises a highly addictive journey for eco-warriors, business tycoons, and idle game lovers alike!
Download Idle Junkyard Tycoon now and start building your empire from the ground up—one rusty screw at a time!

bluejetty:00118895:ios.name: CMA CGM
bluejetty:00118895:ios.summary: Led by Rodolphe Saadé, the CMA CGM Group, a global player in sea, land, air and logistics solutions, offers end-to-end business solutions to help manage all aspects of your transportation process in a real-time, interactive, and secure onli
bluejetty:00118895:ios.description:
Led by Rodolphe Saadé, the CMA CGM Group, a global player in sea, land, air and logistics solutions, offers end-to-end business solutions to help manage all aspects of your transportation process in a real-time, interactive, and secure online environment.
The CMA CGM Mobile App further reinforces this offer by allowing you to track and trace your containers, plan your transport with fast and easy schedule information, check all your rates and keep up to date with the latest news from your mobile device in a clear and user-friendly interface. 
► Login to the mobile application to access your shipment dashboard 
Login to access a list of your shipments and accurate information related to your containers. 
Manage your account and related information. 
► Get your price 
Check all your existing quotations online or get a new instant quotation when no existing quotation is available, thanks to our pricing features. You can also benefit from our SpotOn offers to get a quotation quickly with secured spot onboard. 
► Track your shipments 
Track your shipments and check the details related to your containers. 
Stay up to date their status and preparation. 
► Follow your container(s) with our Shipment Tracking tool 
Track and trace your shipment, getting a clear understanding of all the steps from the Place of Loading to the Place of Delivery, including the various transport solutions, vessels, and shipping lines on which your shipment is assigned. You can also follow up on your shipments by consulting your shipping documents. 
► Look up specific vessel schedules, voyages, or use our routing finder 
Use the CMA CGM App to search for specific vessel schedules, voyages, or use our routing finder. Directly plugged to the CMA CGM’s Information System, the App will provide information and optimized routing solutions from among more than 200 shipping lines and over 500 vessels calling 420 ports all around the world. 
► Bookmark and Share 
When using the App, each search can be bookmarked for an easier management of multiple shipments. Just log back onto the App and click on your bookmarks to quickly get the information you need. 
You can also share your search results to keep people informed of your shipment’s status, news, or any other information accessible within the App. 
► Stay up to date with the latest news 
Read all the CMA CGM Group's latest News to stay up-to-date with the Group’s activity. You can easily filter which categories you want to see whether you’re interested in service updates, corporate information, etc. You can also bookmark news to check on them later or simply keep track of them.
► Agency network 
Our agencies offer a wide range of services suited to the needs of our diversified base of professional customers, businesses, and local authorities. Access our agencies’ contact details: schedules, addresses, email addresses and phone numbers. 
► Contact CMA CGM easily 
Whether you need help or have any question, you can contact our team easily through the App using our Customer Service Tool.

Get Truckstop Go™ for easy access to trucking's largest mobile load board app to keep your wheels turning and your truck loaded. With Truckstop Go in the palm of your hand, you can do business anywhere, anytime!
From finding the right loads fast to factoring that gets you paid when you need it, do it all with Truckstop Go.
Truckstop Go is the best way to find good loads fast in today’s spot market. Post your truck, or choose from over 500,000 loads posted daily. Find available loads in real time, and book them fast to get what you want!
With speed and stability you can count on, Truckstop Go moves you along in record time—and it’s included with your Truckstop Load Board subscription.
All the features you need are at your fingertips.

- Get instant alerts of new loads with Load Alert Notifications.
- Filter and save by equipment type and preferences.

- Get Rate Insights that put you in the driver’s seat for negotiations.
- Easy click-to-email and click-to-call makes communication fast and easy.
- Use Book It Now to instantly book with brokers you trust.
- Factor loads from anywhere and keep the cash coming in.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. bluejetty:00172503:ios.description:
In this thrilling mobile hyper-casual game, you take on the role of a heroic stickman who has mastered the art of shooting webs and teleporting to different locations. Armed with your trusty spiderweb-shooting abilities, you must navigate through a series of challenging obstacles and destroy enemies in your path.
As you progress through the game, you'll encounter increasingly difficult challenges that will test your skills as a master stickman. You'll need to be quick on your feet and strategic in your movements if you hope to make it to the end of each level.
To help you along the way, you can use your web-shooting abilities to swing from platform to platform and avoid obstacles. You can also use your teleportation powers to quickly move around the map and dodge enemy attacks.
But beware – your enemies are not easily defeated. They'll come at you with all sorts of weapons and traps, so you'll need to be on your guard at all times. Use your skills and quick reflexes to dodge their attacks and take them down before they can do any damage.
With its fast-paced action, challenging gameplay, and stunning graphics, this mobile hyper-casual game is sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. So what are you waiting for? Grab your web-shooter and start jumping, swinging, and teleporting your way to victory!

bluejetty:00129596:ios.summary:

Enter the number of pieces or expiration date of the commoditie
bluejetty:00129596:ios.description:
Have you ever wondered if you still have stocks when going grocery shopping?
"My Inventory" will help you in such situations.
Quickly launch the app, and check your inventory.
Enter the number of pieces or expiration date of the commodities in your fridge or kitchen storage, for example. Then subtract number when you use them or add when you restock the products.
This application helps you keep track of what you have at home, so you don't need to prepare notes before going at the grocery anymore. 
Furthermore it allows you to:
1. Take note of the price or store where you get a product.
2. See frequency of use (The increase and decrease will be recorded automatically).
3. Write down whatever you want to keep in mind in the Notes field.
The app features more than 600 icons. If you don't find an appropriate icon, you can take a picture and create your original icons. 
It also allows you to organize groups for your convenience. 
The items that are running out are shown in the Checklist.
Each item can be set to show a given number of warnings.
When you restock the item, the warning will automatically disappear from the Checklist.
Why don't you start using "My Inventory" as your daily living tool?
iCloud supported. It is useful for backing up and sharing data.
* Emoticons cannot be used
You can try it with the free version "My Inventory LT".

bluejetty:00164892:ios.name: RemNote - Notes & Flashcards
bluejetty:00164892:ios.summary: RemNote is an all-in-one learning tool that combines note-taking, knowledge management, flashcards, and spaced repetition to enable effective and efficient learning. Sure, it’s a note-taking tool. But there’s also flashcards, PDFs, backlink
bluejetty:00164892:ios.description:
RemNote is an all-in-one learning tool that combines note-taking, knowledge management, flashcards, and spaced repetition to enable effective and efficient learning. Sure, it’s a note-taking tool. But there’s also flashcards, PDFs, backlinks, and more - to help you study, stay organized, and think.
WHY CHOOSE REMNOTE?
Learn more in less time: RemNote makes learning easy. Get higher grades or reach your learning goals in less time.
Grow your knowledge: Using RemNote you’ll can connect the concept you learn about and generate more ideas. 
Organize your thoughts, plans, and tasks: We’re built to help you plan all of your life in one place.
WHAT DOES REMNOTE HAVE TO OFFER?
Notes, Docs & Outlines: Capture and link your ideas. RemNote is built for thinking and long-term knowledge management.
Smart Flashcards: Create flashcards directly from your notes.
Spaced Repetition: Remember more with less studying. Build your long-term memory with the spaced repetition plan built into your flashcards.
Linked Reference: Reference and review all notes connected to a specific topic with contextual links and create flashcard sets on-the-fly as you take notes.
PDF Annotation: Work with external documents directly in the app, make your notes and create flashcards using the source materials. Highlight, create margin notes, and link sections of your document to the rest of your digital library.
Multimedia Embedding: Incorporate documents, videos, and anything else embeddable into your notes as you make them.
Tags: Tag your notes, to-do items, and even multimedia source materials like images and video. And get your life sorted.
To-dos: Take in new information and generate to-do lists and action items with reminders on the fly, without juggling windows or switching apps.
WANT MORE?
Easy Formula Handling: The Latex feature allows you to create inline formulas with a simple annotation editor. Easily create and edit formulas on the fly as you take notes, and enjoy a clear and attractive display of these formulas as you review your notes and flashcards.
Templates: Create templates to make repetitive tasks a thing of the past. Whether you’re preparing briefs or structured lecture notes, a predefined template can help you create better materials, save time, and pay more attention to the subject matter.
Build knowledge that lasts forever: Import from every note-taking app. Bring your data, and enjoy!
Code Block Notes: Take notes with a tool designed to accommodate programming, keeping your notes and annotations visually and semantically separate from your code.
Works offline: Access and make changes with or without internet access.
Unlimited Free Plan: We’re committed to a powerful free plan for every inspired learner.
----
We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. If you have any questions or concerns about our practices with regard to your personal information, please contact us at support@remnote.com.
----
Make your life a little easier using RemNote’s structured note-taking, knowledge management, and intuitive memorization tools.
----
TERMS: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00043567:ios.name: GESKE: German Beauty Tech
bluejetty:00043567:ios.summary: GESKE, born from a deep yearning for radiant skin and self-worth, passionately embraces science-backed technology and ergonomic design to unlock the full potential of professional skincare at home. Now you can make your wildest beauty dream
bluejetty:00043567:ios.description:
GESKE, born from a deep yearning for radiant skin and self-worth, passionately embraces science-backed technology and ergonomic design to unlock the full potential of professional skincare at home. Now you can make your wildest beauty dreams come true with our AI-powered skin scan technology, customized skincare routines, and thousands of training sessions. Through an AI-powered Skin Scan, receive tailored product recommendations and expert skincare routines, providing you with the tools all the while gamifying the whole process for maximum engagement.
With an extensive range of 150+ proprietary technologies and 250+ beauty devices, GESKE provides users the tools to achieve remarkable results in the comfort of their homes. By utilizing dedicated sessions accessible through the free GESKE Beauty App, users can experience the transformative effects of reducing age spots and fine lines, revealing a radiant complexion. The App incorporates cutting-edge AI technology, featuring an unmatched Skin Scan function that analyzes the unique needs of each individual's skin. Armed with this valuable information, users receive expert advice based on real-time analysis, guiding them towards a personalized skincare routine tailored to their specific needs.
This beauty revolution required over 100 software developers and engineers, who dedicated more than four years of work to its development. Additionally, we invested countless hours in video production and editing to create over 50,000 video training sessions. This AI-fueled technological marvel has already impressed juries at prestigious awards such as the German Innovation Award, the CES Innovation Award, ELLE Magazine's Innovation No.1 Award, and many others.
About the App
- most advanced and globally awarded beauty app with guided tutorials on how to use 250+ tech products
- eliminate all your unwanted skin conditions with tailored skincare routines and 250+ skincare products
- discover the luxury of a private beauty spa with the help of your smartphone
- enjoy exclusive in-app rewards like promotions and discounts on state-of-the-art beauty products
How it Works
- use your smartphone to scan your skin once a week with our AI-enabled technology
- this helps the algorithm develop your personalized skincare routine and adapt the product recommendations to your skin type continuously
- monitor your skin's progress using advanced tracking interfaces
- experience training sessions that bring you the expertise of world-class dermatologists in the comfort of your own home
How to Use
- to start your Skin Scan, go to the "home" or "routine" tab and select the "skin scan" button. Our powerful algorithms will analyze your skin and create personalized recommendations for you
- once you register and add your owned products to your app inventory, the system will automatically create your personalized routine
- each routine lasts for 7 days. When it is completed, your next routine will be calculated and started automatically
- we recommend performing a Skin Scan at least once a week. Tracking the improvements in your skin can be highly motivating
For any assistance, please write to app.support@geske.com.
About GESKE: German Beauty Tech
GESKE's passion, fueled by years of experience in consumer technology, German engineering, dermatological expertise, and the power of AI, drives our mission to turn beauty from a dream into a reality for everyone. With GESKE, a new era begins, bringing forth a transformation that pushes the boundaries of the beauty industry. It is GESKE's time to lead, exploring new territories and redefining the concept of beauty itself. We are GESKE.

bluejetty:00062248:ios.summary:
LET YOUR CHILD PLAY THEIR WAY TO MATH FLUENCY
Funexpected Math is an award-winning math learning app for kids aged 3–7, helping your child build a strong foundation in early math. Our program is carefully crafted by top educators who have t
bluejetty:00062248:ios.description:
LET YOUR CHILD PLAY THEIR WAY TO MATH FLUENCY
Funexpected Math is an award-winning math learning app for kids aged 3–7, helping your child build a strong foundation in early math. Our program is carefully crafted by top educators who have trained national math champions. Delivered by a personal digital tutor, it allows any child to reach the top of their age group in math.
Embark on an early learning adventure to fall in love with numbers, shapes, and problem-solving. Whether you’re looking for a preschool math game, kindergarten math learning app, or first-grade math program, Funexpected provides age-appropriate challenges designed to make every kid confident in math. 
If you’re looking for an adequate challenge for your gifted child, Funexpected Math is a great solution. It includes multiple tasks that are 100% similar to those you can find in the most widely used gifted tests. 
Our app combines educational games, interactive stories, and adaptive practice — creating the ideal math-rich environment for early learners. With Funexpected Math, your child will develop curiosity, logic, number sense, spatial skills, and get a lifetime of math confidence.
BACKED BY STUDIES, RECOGNIZED BY EXPERTS:
Best Original Learning App (Kidscreen Award 2025)
Best Math Learning Solution (EdTech Breakthrough Award)
Best Visual Design (The Webby Award)
…and many more!
Funexpected Math is a perfect choice for a child’s first math learning program. It features multiple learning formats appropriate for preschool math, kindergarten math, and elementary math.
Our mistake-friendly approach sparks curiosity. Next, a personalized learning program builds knowledge. Finally, exercising each topic in various formats reinforces math confidence. With these three elements, any child can achieve lasting success in math that will carry through to higher grades and last a lifetime.
FROM BASICS TO ADVANCED MATH SKILLS
Funexpected offers various learning formats to exercise diverse math skills: numeracy practice, logic puzzles, spatial reasoning games, oral problems, math manipulatives, printable math worksheets and more!
Six learning programs cater to any preschooler, kindergartener, or elementary student, including advanced and gifted ones. Funexpected covers the standard PreK–2 math curriculum and goes beyond, giving children a deeper understanding of math concepts. It’s crucial for developing problem-solving skills, essential for success in STEM in middle school.
A PERSONALIZED, VOICE-BASED TUTOR
Our AI math tutor tailors the program to a child, scaffolds learning, asks guiding questions instead of serving up answers, introduces math terms, and provides hints when needed.
It transforms early math learning into an exciting journey through space and time, with an engaging storyline.
WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN
Ages 3–4:
Counting and Numbers
Identify Shapes
Compare and Sort Objects
Recognize Visual Patterns
Length and Height
…and more!
Ages 5–6:
Count up to 100
2D and 3D Shapes
Addition and Subtraction Strategies
Mental Folding and Rotation
Logic Puzzles
…and more!
Ages 6–7:
Place Value
Add and Subtract 2-Digit Numbers
Number Patterns
Logical Operators
Early Coding
…and more!
15 MINUTES A DAY IS ENOUGH FOR PROGRESS
No need for long study sessions! Just two 15-minute sessions a week are enough for your child to get ahead of 95% of their peers in a short time.
EXTRA BENEFITS:
Track progress easily in the Parents’ Section
100% ad-free & safe for kids
Available in 16 languages
One subscription for all kids in the family
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Try it free for 7 days
Choose between a monthly or annual subscription
Cancel anytime through your device settings
Auto-renews unless canceled at least 24 h before the next billing cycle
PRIVACY COMMITMENT
We prioritize your child’s safety. Read our full Privacy Policy and Terms of Use here:
funexpectedapps.com/privacy
funexpectedapps.com/terms

Here’s what else you can do with Endeavor Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts

Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Endeavor Bank app, you must be enrolled as an Endeavor Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Coordinate tactics with your team using voice chat or communicate your triumphs and near-misses with a range of fun emojis, bringing more interaction to the battlefield.
Gear up, customize your plane, enter the fight now, and dominate the skies!

bluejetty:00186587:ios.description:
Practice languages with native speakers on HelloTalk! We recently introduced HelloTalk Live and Voiceroom - interactive language and culture events to help you master languages through the content you love! 
HelloTalk, the original language exchange app, connects you with native speakers to practice languages (English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, Mandarin Chinese, Portuguese, German, Italian, Russian, Arabic, Turkish, Hindi, Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese and 260+ more) for FREE! 
HelloTalk equips you with learning tools such as translation and instant captions so you can learn by chatting with native speakers. Learn languages from locals around the world through livestreams and Voicerooms. Connect with expert hosts to discuss interesting topics with language partners in the learning community! 
Why HelloTalk? 
► Real language learning atmosphere 
Whether you're focused on a widely spoken language or a less common one, HelloTalk caters to your needs. The system smartly matches you based on your native language and proficiency, while allowing you to filter ideal language partners according to various criteria such as age, location, and gender. Plus, with built-in translation and transliteration tools, you can communicate confidently without any language barriers.
► A powerful tool for sharpening your language skills
Acquiring new words through conversations with native speakers is more effective than rigid memorization. Whether you're a student preparing for exams like the CET, GRE, TOEFL, IELTS, planning to study abroad, or a professional seeking career advancement through language skills, HelloTalk offers native speakers who match your proficiency level for engaging interactions and valuable learning experiences.
► Immersive multi-person language chat rooms
If you choose to learn Spanish, for example, every Voiceroom you enter on HelloTalk gathers Spanish learners and Spanish native speakers from around the world to discuss interesting topics. Here, only your voice needs to be heard, creating a comfortable, introvert-friendly atmosphere. Here, sharing mutual interests allows everyone to freely express themselves and share personal experiences, fostering both language intuition and authentic expression skills. It's incredibly addictive!
► Diverse global Livestreams
HelloTalk features handpicked foreign language hosts who offer online video lessons, share language insights, and provide glimpses into their lives abroad. You can even join them on stage for one-on-one video conversations with fellow language learners. Whether you're grappling with pronunciation, speaking speed, or shyness, these hosts will assist you in refining your language skills and guiding the conversation. For rapid improvement in spoken language, there's no substitute for direct communication with native speakers!
► International Moments
HelloTalk's Moments offers real-time posts covering learning, lifestyle, and cultural insights from around the world. It's your ticket to discovering fresh perspectives and gaining deeper insights into diverse cultural customs, all from the comfort of your home. Don't forget to engage with posts that catch your interest!
What the world is saying about HelloTalk
“One of the best apps to help you learn a new language.” - 9to5Mac 
"When you're ready to experiment with a foreign language, HelloTalk provides an excellent opportunity for interaction with other speakers." –PCMag

bluejetty:00120618:ios.summary:

Sumdog delivers highly engaging personalized practice for math and spelling, both in-school and at home. Suitable for children aged 5-14, our adaptive learning games and online rewards motivate children to le
bluejetty:00120618:ios.description:
Make learning fun with Sumdog!
Sumdog delivers highly engaging personalized practice for math and spelling, both in-school and at home. Suitable for children aged 5-14, our adaptive learning games and online rewards motivate children to learn and encourages regular practice. 
When children first use Sumdog, we run a short diagnostic test to provide a snapshot of their learning and areas for development. Our adaptive learning engine then uses the outcomes of the diagnostic to ensure each child’s starting point on Sumdog is at the right level. From this point, our sophisticated adaptive algorithms create a personalized learning journey based for each child based on their progress.
 - Over 30 engaging single and multiplayer games
 - Thousands of standards-aligned questions designed to consolidate and extend in-class learning
 - Virtual coin rewards to motivate children to learn
 - A 3D avatar, house and garden for children to personalize
“I never thought an online program could do so much in such short bursts of time.” D. Hendershot, West Elementary, Kansas, US. 
Account set-up
If your child has an account from school:
Your child can log in with their details from their school. They’ll then be able to access any work that has been set by their teachers.
If your child does not have an account from school:

bluejetty:00023469:ios.description:
Looking for a reliable companion to deepen your understanding of Islam? The "HalalGuide: Prayer Times & Quran" app is your perfect solution! This app offers the best tools for Muslims, including:
Halal Cafes and Mosques: Discover nearby halal venues and mosques in your city.
Prayer Times: Receive notifications for prayer times and follow the schedule.
Quran: Read and listen to Quranic verses with translations in Russian. Learning to recite the Quran has never been easier or more accessible.
Duas and Hadiths: Explore essential duas and hadiths to enrich your religious knowledge with content from the Fortress of the Muslim.
Islamic Books and Courses: Find books and courses for beginners to better understand the basics of Islam.
Muslim Habit Tracker: Monitor your Islamic habits with our user-friendly tracker.
Product Check: Access a list of food additives categorized as halal, haram, or doubtful.
"HalalGuide: Prayer Times & Quran" also includes:
Prayer Tutorials: Become proficient in performing prayers with step-by-step instructions.
Azkar and Tasbih: Practice dhikr using the app's specialized features.
Qibla Direction: Find the Qibla direction using GPS.
Marketplace: Easily find halal products in just a few clicks.
Muslim Radio: Listen to Islamic radio anytime.
Qurbani and Sadaqah: Learn about the importance of Qurbani and how to give Sadaqah correctly.
Ask an Imam: Ask questions to an imam and receive answers to your concerns.
Widgets: Custom widgets for nearly every feature are available for home screens, lock screens, and activity widgets.
Notifications: Stay informed with various notifications from each section. Get reminders 30 minutes before the prayer ends to ensure you never miss it.
This app is perfect for Muslims of all ages. We’ve created "HalalGuide" with your needs and wishes in mind. The app is free and designed with care for user convenience.
Download "Halal Guide: Prayer Times & Quran" and stay connected to your faith!
Use the app to:
- Read and listen to the Quran
- Track prayer times
- Learn and deepen your knowledge of hadiths
- Explore nearby halal options
- Connect with fellow Muslims and find like-minded individuals
This app is designed to inspire you to practice Islam in your daily life. "Halal Guide: Prayer Times" is your guide to the world of Islam and halal values.
The app is available in 10 languages: English, Türkçe, Русский, Қазақша, O‘zbekcha, 한국어, 日本語, Bahasa, العربية, Français.
Download now and begin your spiritual journey!Don’t miss the opportunity to deepen your understanding of Islam and strengthen your spiritual connection with Allah.

- Import one video (first video) to help you become the ultimate acapella maker
- Optimize your sound with EQ (music equalizer), noise gate and processor
- Collab with friends by making music together

- Share video with CD quality audio
- Download Apple lossless (ALAC) audio file or m4a.
- Listen to your songs from iTunes library to help you record songs
- Create playlist you can listen to on the go
- Share to favorite social platforms like Mixcord, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, etc...

What is Braves Square?
Braves Square helps schools and families stay connected and informed—all in one easy place. Whether it’s a quick message from a teacher, an important alert from the district, or a reminder about tomorrow’s field trip, Braves Square makes sure families never miss a thing.
Why families and teachers love Braves Square:
• Simple, easy-to-use app and website
• Messages are automatically translated into 190+ languages
• Best-in-class safety and security practices
• One place for all school updates, alerts, and messages
With Braves Square, families and staff save time and stay connected—so everyone can focus on helping students succeed.
Braves Square for iOS
The Braves Square app makes it easy for families to stay in the loop and engage with their child’s school community. With the app, parents and guardians can:
• See school news, classroom updates, and photos
• Receive important notices like attendance alerts and cafeteria balances
• Message teachers and staff directly
• Join group conversations
• Sign up for wishlist items, volunteering, and conferences
• Respond to absences or tardies*
• Pay school-related fees and invoices*
* If included with your school's implementation

Ready to build your dream garden and watch it bloom into a money-making, seed-sprouting paradise? Grow a Garden is more than just a gardening game — it’s a sandbox tycoon simulator where every tap brings new life to your plants, rare sprouts, and secret garden treasures!
Whether you're a fan of gardenscapes, garden joy, or even looking for stock simulator vibes like Live Garden Stocks, this game blends grow therapy with strategic planning. Plant it. Feed it. Auto Farm it. Then sell it all for profit!
Key Features:
Live Weather Effects – Plan your garden strategy in real-time!
Grow a Garden Stock Notifier – Track trends like a pro; it's the stock market… but for plants!
Merge Fruit & Infinite Seeds – Cultivate colorful combos and unlock wild hybrids.
Surprise guest? Spinosaurus pets and other quirky creatures join your orchard!
Inspired by hits like lily’s garden, fruitsies, and melon sandbox.
Hidden surprises in the Secret Garden App – discover rare seedlings, rare mutations, and magical blooms.
Use the LED Grow Calculator to experiment with optimal plant growth.
Unlock rewards and even Robux codes and sandbox tycoon bonuses!
For Gardeners & Gamers Alike
Whether you're using a plant tracker, setting up a garden schedule, or dreaming with seedream, Grow a Garden gives you everything from vegetable tracker tools to holistic seed care.
Get cozy with tile garden puzzles, manage your own market garden, and rise to fame as the ultimate garden simulation tycoon.
Download now and join millions of players turning soil into gold.
Bonus: Use codes from the "CODES" tab to unlock free seeds, pets, and fruitz boosters!
Grow big. Grow smart. Grow with Grow a Garden.

bluejetty:00016014:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00016014:ios.description:
The Most Complete and Authentic Big 2/Pusoy Dos ! (Chinese Poker,Capsa,Choh Dai Di, Da Lao Er)
****** Support the International Rule, Taiwan Rule and Philippines Pusoy Dos!
****** Innovative UI design helps you to identify different combination in your hand!
****** Powerful Automatic Card Pick up system "Slide-2-Select", just slide your card, and the computer will choose the most appropriate combination/card for you.
****** Automatic Pass Function. No more annoying Pass!(Activate in setting menu)
****** Voice with English,Cantonese and Mandarin enjoy the card playing experience ! 
****** Unpredictable Computer AI, which will hold the card and end the game in a way that you don't expect.
****** Unlock various achievements,collect your medal now!
****** Over 19 Ranks, Challenge to become the king in Big 2!
****** User interfaced designed in a way to help you play the game by using only one hand!
Big Two Rule (Base on Hong Kong/Pusoy Dos/International Rule)
Big Two (also known as Deuces, pusoy dos, 大老二, 鋤大D) is a card game similar to the game of Asshole, Crazy Eights, Bullshit, Winner, and other shedding games. 
Common game played with four players. The objective of the game is to be the first to get rid of all of your cards.
Cards may be played as singles or in groups of two or five, in combinations which resemble poker hands. The leading card to a trick sets down the number of cards to be played; all the cards of a trick must contain the same number of cards. The combinations and their rankings are as follows.
Single Card Ranking: 2->A->K->Q->J->.....->3
Suit: Hong Kong:Spade>Heart>Club>Diamond Taiwan:Spade>Heart>Diamond>Club Pusoy Dos:Diamond>Heart>Spade>Club 
Single cards: Any card from the deck, ordered by rank with suit being the tie-breaker.
Pairs: Any two cards of matching rank, ordered as with singular cards by the card of the higher suit.
Triples: Any Three card of matching rank, order by rank.
5-card hand: Uses the same ranking as Poker. There are five (var. 2) different valid 5-card poker hands, ranking, from low to high, as follows (the same ranking as in poker):
Straight : Any 5 cards in a sequence (but not the same suit). There isn't JQKA2, while A2345 is largest 23456 is 2nd largest. (For taiwan game, A2345 is the smallest while 23456 is largest)
Flush: Any 5 cards of the same suit (but not in a sequence). Rank is determined by highest value card and then by highest suit.
Full House: a composite of a three-of-a-kind combination and a pair. Rank is determined by the value of the triple.
Four of a kind + One card : Any set of 4 cards of the same rank, plus any 5th card. 
Straight Flush: A composite of the straight and flush: five cards in sequence in the same suit. 
Each player got 13 cards. 
At the beginning of each game, the player with the smallest card(Diamond 3 in Hong Kong, Club 3 in Pusoy Dos or Taiwan) starts by either playing it singly or as part of a combination, leading to the first trick. Play proceeds counter-clockwise, with normal climbing-game rules applying: each player must play a higher card or combination than the one before, with the same number of cards. Players may also pass, thus declaring that he does not want to discard any cards (or does not hold the necessary cards to make a play possible).
A player need to warn others when he/she is one playing combination away from winning. The goal is, then, for the other players to play (and get rid of) as many cards as possible while avoiding the combination that would allow the calling player to win the game. For example, if the said player has one last single card, the other players would play pairs or other combinations to force him/her to pass. If the other players doesn't do that, it is known as illegal assist. 3X Penalty will be applied.
The game ends when one player runs out of cards.

Step into a vibrant culinary world where your tapping skills are the key to success! Your mission: assemble amazing dishes by correctly filling up every order. It’s a fun challenge for your brain and a feast for your eyes!
How it works is simple and satisfying: a stream of tasty ingredients appears at the bottom of your screen. See an order on a plate? Just tap the right ingredient to send it flying! Once a plate has its three required items, POOF! It’s served, and a new empty plate is ready for your culinary magic.
Feeling the pressure with a tricky ingredient? No problem! Tuck it away for later in one of the five handy storage slots. This clever trick keeps your main area clear so you can focus on matching what’s needed right now. Use them wisely to become a true kitchen master!
It’s a delightful race against time and space! You’ll need quick reflexes and a smart plan to conquer levels and unlock exciting new recipes.
Features:
Simple & Addictive: Easy one-tap controls that are instantly fun.
Fast-Paced Action: Sort and match ingredients to fill orders at lightning speed.
Strategic Depth: Use the 5 storage slots to solve tricky situations and plan ahead.
Endless Fun: Discover tons of delicious ingredients and challenging new levels.
Pure Satisfaction: Enjoy the rewarding feeling of completing perfect orders one after another!
The ultimate foodie experience is just a tap away. Are you ready to cook up some fun?

bluejetty:00044150:ios.name: Nonogram Life
bluejetty:00044150:ios.summary: Nonograms, also known as Paint by Numbers, Picross, Griddlers, Pic-a-Pix, Hanjie, and various other names, are picture Logic puzzle in which cells in a grid must be colored or left blank according to numbers at the side of the grid to revea
bluejetty:00044150:ios.description:
Nonograms, also known as Paint by Numbers, Picross, Griddlers, Pic-a-Pix, Hanjie, and various other names, are picture Logic puzzle in which cells in a grid must be colored or left blank according to numbers at the side of the grid to reveal a hidden picture. 
*** Rule ***
In this puzzle type, the numbers are a form of discrete tomography that measures how many unbroken lines of filled-in squares there are in any given row or column. For example, a clue of "4 8 3" would mean there are sets of four, eight, and three filled squares, in that order, with at least one blank square between successive sets.
*** Features ***
● Hand crafted beautiful pixel arts
● There are various topics to have fun with
● Using hint can help you in difficult time
● Easy controls, either using drag or d-pad
● Mindfulness, relaxing music
● Playing session is saved/resumed automatically
● Don’t forget to using Mark (X) to solve the puzzle easier
*** Strategy ***
Simpler puzzles can usually be solved by a reasoning on a single row only (or a single column) at each given time, to determine as many boxes and spaces on that row as possible. Then trying another row (or column), until there are no rows that contain undetermined cells.
Some more difficult puzzles may also require several types of "what if?" reasoning that include more than one row (or column). This works on searching for contradictions: When a cell cannot be a box, because some other cell would produce an error, it will definitely be a space. And vice versa. Advanced solvers are sometimes able to search even deeper than into the first "what if?" reasoning. It takes, however, a lot of time to get some progress.

Health Articles
Read wellness and lifestyle articles for general informational purposes only. Content is not intended as medical advice.

## Description
CREATE YOUR OWN MERMAID LIFE!
Dive into BoBo World: Mermaid Life, a colorful underwater world where you can create your own mermaid, design beautiful spaces, dress up in your favorite styles, and make up stories your way.
Create a unique mermaid, explore stylish underwater locations, decorate your dream home, go shopping, visit the beach, enjoy a makeover, care for sea animals, and discover new ways to play throughout the ocean world.
CREATE YOUR OWN MERMAID
Design a mermaid that feels completely your own. Customize hairstyles, eyes, facial features, outfits, accessories, and more to create different characters for every story.
DRESS UP YOUR WAY
Explore beautiful mermaid fashion with colorful outfits, hairstyles, accessories, and fantasy styles. Mix and match your favorites to create a new look whenever you want.
DESIGN YOUR DREAM HOME
Bring your creativity into every room. Color furniture freely, experiment with different combinations, and create a mermaid home with your own personal style.
EXPLORE MERMAID LIFE
Discover a modern underwater world filled with fun places to visit:
• Relax in your mermaid home
• Enjoy a sunny holiday beach
• Shop for new outfits
• Try new looks at the cosmetics store
• Care for adorable sea animals
• Visit the underwater restaurant
• Discover interactive surprises along the way
CREATE YOUR OWN STORIES
There are no fixed rules. Move characters, interact with objects, change outfits, decorate spaces, and create your own mermaid adventures.
PLAY TOGETHER
Multi-touch support makes it easy to explore and create stories together.
PLAY ANYWHERE
Enjoy your mermaid world without needing Wi-Fi.

bluejetty:00029273:ios.description:
Let’s test your mind and memory with a triple bird-matching puzzle game
Bird Triple Match is a challenging matching game. In the game, you need to blow your mind and match 3 numbers of birds. When all birds are matched, you can pass the current level! Our matching puzzle game includes large numbers of levels. Some levels might be hard. Challenge your mind and solve the puzzles, and then you will find them easy and exciting!
How To Play Bird Triple Match:
Tap on three birds that look the same and connect them into triples
Keep collecting triple birds until you clear all birds from the screen
Enjoy relaxing brain puzzles, start new levels, and become a bird puzzle master
Bird Triple Match has many different triple sets of colorful birds that are designed to be easy to memorize, but still can challenge your mind
Bird Triple Match’s Features:
Unlimited play
Easy to play with simple rules, addictive gameplay, suitable for all ages
Many styles of cute colorful birds. Each bird is different and varies from one to the next
Challenging levels, collect more coins and unlock more rewards
Use a lot of helpful boosters to help you beat levels
Each level has limited time. Try to finish the game before the time runs out
This amazing matching game is perfect for relaxing & calming.
Test your mind and memory, start searching, find hidden birds, and match all the birds with Bird Triple Match

bluejetty:00021170:ios.description:
This app contains three main sections, which can be accessed through the tabs on top.
1. Home 2. Kirtan 3. Katha 4. Audio Books
Within each section, there are separate panels, such as:
Kirtan Section - Daily rituals, Prabhatiya, Aarti, kirtans on Murti, philosophical kirtans, kirtans for fasting, kirtans for children, and many others.
Katha Section - blessings of Guru Parampara, discourses of sadhus, different albums such as AARSH lecture series, Sant samagam lecture series, sant vyakhyanmala and many others.
Audio Section - Vachanamrut, Swamini Vato, Bhagwan Shri Swaminarayan’s detailed Jivan Charitra (5 parts), Bhaktachintamani, Aksharbrahma Shri Gunatitanand Swami’s detailed Jivan Charitra (2 parts), Brahmswarup Bhagatji Maharaj’s detailed Jivan Charitra, Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj’s detailed Jivan Charitra, Brahmaswarup Yogiji Maharaj’s brief Jivan Charitra, Brahmaswarup Pramukhswami Maharaj’s detailed Jivan Charitra (part 1 to 3), Eternal Virtues, Mahant Swami Maharaj’s brief Jivan Charitra (English version), Bhagwan Shri Swaminarayan na Bhaktratno and many other audio books.
This beneficial audio streaming app will be regularly updated with new content.
More than 2,000 kirtans, more than 900 katha and over 6,000 audio books - in total, around 9,000 audio tracks - all of them completely free. You will find most of the audio publications of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha and Swaminarayan Aksharpith in the last 40 years should be found here.
Some of the salient features of this app are:
- Search for a kirtan by its singer's name or album
- Sing along with the Gujarati lyrics of the kirtan, with English transliteration wherever available
- Create your own playlist of favorite tracks
- Share any album or track that you like, with anyone else using the app, and also with others through whatsapp, text messenger or email.
- Download your favorite tracks or albums and listen to them later without an internet connection
- Get notifications whenever a new album is uploaded on the app.
- Customize the home screen.
- Play position of the tracks are saved, so if you leave a track midway, it will replay from the point where you left.
- Place your favorite album on your home screen for easy access.
- Titles are shown in Gujarati as well as in English.

• 300+ real cat photos — every round feels fresh

• Trains memory, focus, and concentration a few relaxed minutes at a time
• Daily challenges, achievements, and a collection of cats to unlock
• Big, clear cards and simple controls — comfortable for everyone
• Play at your own pace — short rounds that fit into any coffee break
Whether you want a gentle mental warm-up in the morning or a calm wind-down before bed, the cats are always ready. Flip your first card and see how sharp your memory really is!

bluejetty:00162887:ios.description:
'Even the smallest things, documenting my own life can be a wonderful thing. It's a record of me living as myself, and a record that no one else can create.'
From 『I've decided to record it』 
Introducing MOODA!
1. My Cozy Room
- You can have your own cozy room in MOODA. 
- You can decorate the wall, the desk, the lighting, and the window as you wish. 
- Try recording your own small daily life and memories in this cozy space of your own.
2. Record Your Daily Emotions
- Record your daily emotions in MOODA's diary. 
- If you write consistently day by day, you can look back on your month uniquely in the MOODA BALLS in your own room.
3. With Friends
- You can add friends on MOODA and share diaries and communicate. 
- Share the little stories that can't be told in words with your loved ones. Also, visit your friends' rooms too!
4. Memo, Photo and More
- Try using the analog style note and photo features in your own room. 
- Write down your favorite book quotes, jot down your to-do list for the day, and even add your favorite photos. 
- There are plans for future updates to enable even more diverse recording options in your room.
5. Diary Search
- You can search your diary by tapping the search icon at the top right of the app screen. 
- Enter the keyword you want and find the diary entries you wrote in the past. Relive forgotten memories!
6. Powerful Customization
- You can decorate the app screen, diaries, and your own room with a charming touch. 
- There are cute handwriting fonts and a variety of beautiful backgrounds available. 
- Try your hand at creative journaling with MOODA's unique stickers.
7. Account Login and Data Encryption
- Create a MOODA account to access your diary data anytime, anywhere.
- You can log in with your MOODA account on various devices such as iPhone, iPad, Mac, etc.
- Diary data is encrypted and securely stored.
8. Widget
- Check your emotions for this month at a glance with the adorable MOODA calendar widget. 
- More diverse forms of widgets are planned for future updates.
MOODA will continue to strive to be a space where you can record your daily life and emotions and connect more closely with your loved ones.
Thank you for your interest and support.

- Contact for Customers: help@analoglab.io
- Follow on Instagram: @moodaforyou

bluejetty:00090720:ios.summary:

An enriching tool for all Muslims, by providing access to a rich Shia Hadith collection it is especially val
bluejetty:00090720:ios.description:
Anwaar app is a search engine for the Hadith and narrations of Prophet Muhammad (saww) and Ahl al-Bayt (as) in Arabic and English.
An enriching tool for all Muslims, by providing access to a rich Shia Hadith collection it is especially valuable for those looking to explore the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt (as).
The app contains the following features:
- Search for Hadith: searching can be done using phrases from the Hadith text, and it is possible to filter the search results by choosing the sayer or by choosing several topics.
- Browse Topics and Search for Topic: these two features allow exploring all included Hadith.
- Hadith of the Day: it is possible to enable a daily notification as reminder to read the Hadith of the day.
- Favorites: this feature allows adding any Hadith to the list of favorites so that it can be easily found at a later time.
- Browse Group: this feature allows browsing a group of Hadith regularly and to add notification reminders to do so.
- Random Browsing: this feature allows displaying a random group of Hadith.
- Topic Links: this feature makes it easy to discover related topics.
Count of Hadith in Arabic: 4450
Count of Hadith in English: 2800
The Hadith included in the app have been shared by respected Shia Muslim scholar associations.
Insha'Allah the app will be regularly updated to add more Hadith, to add new features, and to resolve any bugs.
We would be delighted to hear your suggestions about improving Anwaar.

bluejetty:00074014:ios.description:
广受欢迎的「熊猫吃短信」推出了 2.0 版本，使用新的机器学习模型架构，更加准确，也支持了更多的分类。
全面适配 iOS 16 的最新的短信分类，在正常短信、垃圾短信之外能够识别更加细致的短信分类：财务（银行信息、保险、理财、水电费）、订单（取件码、物流、订单状态、旅游出行）、运营商、天气等等。
熊猫吃短信创新性的使用 CoreML 机器学习框架在手机端离线拦截垃圾短信。我们不上传用户短信，拒绝云端识别。
我们依靠广大的用户群体主动向我们举报垃圾短信来建立机器学习的样本库。然后使用基于统计学的机器学习算法从百万条各类短信样本中学习而成。无需用户配置任何关键词，它通过识别一个短信的语义特征，自己就可以精准的判断收到的短信是正常短信、公益短信、交易记录还是广告骚扰短信等等。
如果熊猫有判断失误的时候，大家可以在 App 里面投喂新的短信样本帮助熊猫进化，喂养越多熊猫越聪明。
** 隐私条款：熊猫会收集哪些信息？**
「熊猫吃短信」不会收集您的任何信息，更不会上传您的短信内容。如果您自愿向熊猫提交短信样本，那么会收集脱敏后的短信文本以及一个您标注是否是垃圾短信的数字，仅此两项数据。

bluejetty:00074132:ios.description:
Superpedestrian brings you the next generation of safe and thoughtful e-scooters. Whether you’re exploring a new place or getting to the office, Superpedestrian scooters are a fun, affordable, and convenient way to get around. Use the app to find a Superpedestrian scooter near you and experience the joy of one of our easy to ride two-wheelers. 
HOW TO RIDE
— Download the Superpedestrian app and make an account
— Explore the map to find a scooter near you
— Scan the scooter’s QR code or enter the scooter ID to unlock
— Ride safely and have fun
— Park respectfully
— End your ride in the app

bluejetty:00114291:ios.description:
Picai is a powerful yet simple iOS app that helps you replace photo backgrounds with solid colors using advanced AI technology. Perfect for creating professional ID photos, social media content, or business headshots - all with just a few taps.
Key Features:
AI-Powered Background Replacement
Transform your photos instantly with intelligent AI that automatically detects and preserves your subject while replacing the background with a clean, solid color. Our advanced AI technology ensures natural-looking results while maintaining the original quality of your photos.
Multiple Background Colors
Choose from 9 carefully selected background colors: White, Black, Blue, Red, Green, Purple, Pink, Orange, and Gray. Each color is optimized for different use cases, from professional ID photos to creative social media posts.
Easy Photo Upload
Upload photos directly from your photo library or take a new photo using your device's camera. The app supports various image formats and maintains the original aspect ratio of your photos.
High-Quality Results
Generate high-resolution images that preserve all the details of your original photo. All processing is done using advanced AI algorithms to ensure professional-quality results.
Save & Share
Save your edited photos directly to your device's photo library in high quality. Share your creations with friends, family, or colleagues through any app that supports image sharing.
History Management
Keep track of all your edited photos in one convenient place. View your creation history, compare original and edited versions, and easily access previous work for saving or sharing again.
Flexible Pricing Options
Choose the plan that works best for you:
- Pay-per-use with coins: Purchase coins to use the app as needed
- Subscription plans: Monthly, 6-month, or annual subscriptions for unlimited use
Privacy & Security
Your privacy is our top priority. Picai does not collect, store, or transmit any personal information, facial data, or biometric information. All photo processing happens locally on your device or through secure, privacy-focused AI services that do not retain your images. We do not track your usage, collect analytics, or share your data with third parties. Your photos remain yours - we simply provide the tools to enhance them.
Perfect For:
- Creating professional ID photos and passport photos

bluejetty:00094450:ios.description:
Marble Match is a colorful, satisfying puzzle game where your goal is to sort marbles by color into their correct tubes. Sounds simple? Think again. As you progress through thousands of increasingly tricky levels, you’ll need focus, logic, and a clever strategy to keep things flowing smoothly.
Each sorting puzzle level begins with a jumbled mix of vibrant marbles. With limited space to move, your challenge is to untangle the chaos and match marbles of the same color. Make the right moves in the right order and feel the satisfaction of clearing the board.
Marble Match combines relaxing gameplay with brain-teasing puzzles. Whether you're looking to unwind or put your logic skills to the test, it's easy to pick up and hard to put down.
Features:
- Thousands of sorting puzzle levels with increasing difficulty
- No timers or pressure – play our exciting puzzle game at your own pace
- Satisfying mechanics, stunning visuals and smooth animations
Marble Match is the perfect game to relax with during a break, a commute, or any time you want to challenge your mind in a fun and stress-free way. As you advance, unlock new characters, and special marbles. You’ll need to think a few steps ahead to solve the more difficult puzzles without getting stuck.
Stuck on a level? Use helpful tools and hints to get back on track. Whether it’s undoing a move or getting a suggestion for your next action, Marble Match offers support to keep things challenging but never frustrating. It’s a sorting puzzle experience designed to be satisfying from start to finish.
Marble Match is designed for players of all ages. Whether you're a casual gamer looking for a daily mental workout or a puzzle game As you advance, unlock new characters, and special marbles. enthusiast ready to take on tougher challenges, there's something for everyone. Its minimal design and intuitive mechanics mean you can start playing right away, no tutorial needed.
Play whenever and wherever you like. With offline support, you can enjoy Marble Match without needing a Wi-Fi connection. Take it with you on the go, and enjoy smooth, stress-free gameplay no matter where you are
Download now and see if you can master the art of marble sorting

+ Quests reward up to 10
+ Journey milestones
+ Today's Daily puzzle
+ Random old Daily puzzles
+ Random Classic puzzles

bluejetty:00016456:ios.description:
• Ghost EVP Radio - Spirit Box, EMF & Motion Tracker
Step into the world of the unexplained with Ghost EVP Radio - a powerful ghost hunting experience that combines spirit box audio, EMF readings, and now a motion tracker into one immersive app.
Whether you’re a curious explorer or a seasoned paranormal investigator, Ghost EVP Radio gives you the tools to experience EVP phenomena and energy fluctuations in real time.
• What Is EVP?
EVP (Electronic Voice Phenomena) are mysterious sounds that resemble human speech and often appear in audio recordings. Many ghost hunters believe these voices may come from spirits or energy-based entities.
Ghost EVP Radio recreates the classic spirit box experience, generating real-time audio from randomized signals and surfacing potential words and phrases for you to explore.
• Advanced Paranormal Tools
Real-Time Audio Engine
Our advanced speech and noise generators emulate spirit box behavior and attempts to surface meaningful words from the randomized signals.
EMF Scanner
Uses your device’s built-in magnetometer sensor to detect real electromagnetic field changes.
Motion Tracker
Powered by your device’s accelerometer to help you monitor unusual movement or vibrations in your environment.
Smart Recordings
Record manually or let the app auto-capture when anomalies are detected. Save, share, or analyze your sessions anytime.
Audio Visualization
Watch signals unfold with the built-in Oscilloscope, Spectrometer, and Voicegram.
Text Log
Every detected word is logged for later review, sorting, or sharing.
Custom Alerts
Set vibration, audio alarms or even the device flashlight to notify you of anomalies in real time.
Themes & Personalization
Switch between multiple user interface themes to fit your mood or environment.
• How to Use
Be patient. Like a real ghost box, the app needs time to calibrate and begin detecting possible anomalies. Results may vary depending on your environment, sensor accuracy, and noise conditions. Don’t expect instant voices - give it time and explore with an open mind.
• Languages
Full support for English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Czech, Polish, Portuguese, Slovak, Swedish, Turkish, and Latin.
• Disclaimer
Ghost EVP Radio is designed for entertainment and exploration. While inspired by tools used by real ghost hunters, the results cannot be scientifically verified. Use responsibly and with an open mind.
Get Ghost EVP Radio today and, like hundreds of thousands of users already have, turn your mobile device into a complete ghost hunting kit - with spirit box, EMF scanner, and motion tracker in one app. A fascinating eye-opening experience that is more powerful than ever before.

bluejetty:00150158:ios.description:
One Onsite by Lessen helps vendors and their technicians complete their facilities maintenance work orders successfully while collecting valuable information along the way.
With One Onsite, technicians can see the work they need to do for the day, read through relevant information around the issue, location and historical work done while effectively executing their work on-site with minimal disruption.
Some of the key features around this app include:
· Guided – With its seamless flow, simple language and focus on one task at a time, One Onsite is simple for the technicians to understand, and they require minimal training to use the app
· Informational – One Onsite provides information and photos around the work order, guides the technician to the location that they need to visit and provides relevant historical service information. It also helps the technicians understand what information needs to be provided to their back office based on the trade
· Efficient – One Onsite boasts of a vastly improved tech stack from its predecessor with better performance in offline and low connectivity areas, faster upload times and greater battery optimization

bluejetty:00016665:ios.name: Light DJ Entertainment Effects
bluejetty:00016665:ios.summary: Connect to Philips Hue Entertainment, LIFX, and Nanoleaf Light Panels and take command of your music & entertainment lighting needs. Customize one of over 100+ lighting effects using the app's 3 unique light controllers, or create your own
bluejetty:00016665:ios.description:
Connect to Philips Hue Entertainment, LIFX, and Nanoleaf Light Panels and take command of your music & entertainment lighting needs. Customize one of over 100+ lighting effects using the app's 3 unique light controllers, or create your own custom effects. Light DJ has been used in lots of creative applications, including special effects for home DJs, house parties, stage & video productions, holiday decorations, mood lighting for bars & restaurants, haunted houses, or just to create the ultimate music listening experience in your living room. Light DJ is the #1 app for configurable entertainment effects for smart lighting.
MUSIC VISUALIZER: Create the ultimate music listening experience. The app listens to your music and changes the effects based on the mood of the song. Lights get active during intense parts of a song and flowy with softer melodies and magically change colors at just the right moment. Special controls for Nanoleaf allow you to control rotation and fill angle to match your Aurora or Canvas panel orientation.
BEAT-SYNCED EFFECTS: Use the Super SceneMaker controller for looping effects that sync to the beat of your music. Each of the 100+ effects can be customized with your favorite colors. Play and mix local audio tracks into your playlists and sheets or select one from Apple Music.
HUE ENTERTAINMENT: Using a Hue Entertainment area you'll enjoy higher quality effects; all of Light DJ's effects respond faster and with better sync. Send waves of color across your room with the updated Groove Wave effect, or strobe faster with the Matrix controller.
EFFECT MAKER: Create your own looping special effects with our powerful Effects Maker. Share your custom-made effects & sheets using AirDrop.
IPAD VERSION: A DJ controller-inspired design for ultimate live-performance lighting control. Configurable sheets allow you to setup your effects and colors in advance, and the push-button interface lets making rapid changes easy.
STUFF FOR DJs: Precision tempo controls allows you to sync the lights with your set. Optional automatic beat detection using your device's built-in microphone. Also supports Ableton Link and MIDI Clock Sync for syncing tempo across devices, and MIDI Program Change or Control Change codes for controlling effects. 
Light DJ offers monthly and yearly subscription options. Each subscription includes:
-Full use of all of the app's controllers and effects
-Universal access & cloud sync
-Continual updates to support new hardware and features
-Direct email technical support (I respond to every email!)
-For more details see lightdjapp.com/blog
Visit lightdjapp.com for support and previews.
This app requires hardware from one of these vendors:
- Philips Hue: meethue.com
- LIFX: lifx.com
- Nanoleaf lights and panels (Shapes, Canvas, Lines, Elements, Blocks, Skylight, EXPO Cases, Aurora, A19 bulbs, LED strips, multicolor floor lamp, outdoor permanent and string lights, and holiday lights): nanoleaf.me
Your purchase will be applied to your iTunes account at the end of the trial. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Use: Subscription includes full access to the app including cloud backup & sync, periodic feature updates, and new light hardware support.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use: http://lightdjapp.com/terms
------------------------------

Does World Time Widget have a home screen widget?

Join Alto and his friends on an endless sandboarding journey to find The Lost City and unearth the secrets hidden within. Soar above windswept dunes, traverse thrilling canyons, explore ancient temples and delve into vast caverns in a fantastical place far from home.

• Original music and handcrafted audio. Headphones recommended!
• iCloud support. Play on your Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV, and your progress will always be in sync.

fdroid:com.github.mwiest.voclet.name: Voclet
fdroid:com.github.mwiest.voclet.summary: Learn vocabulary with playful practice, camera import and optional offline AI
fdroid:com.github.mwiest.voclet.description:
Voclet helps you learn vocabulary with short, playful practice. Make word lists by typing, by importing a file, or by photographing a page of your workbook, then practise them in four ways.
 Four ways to practise 
• Connect: draw lines between words and their translations
• Flashcards: flip a card, then say whether you knew it
• Fill the blank: drag the missing letters into the word
• Spell it: type the word; a letter-by-letter comparison shows what went wrong
Words are read aloud with your device's text-to-speech voices.
 Focus on what is hard 
• Practise one list, several at once, or only the pairs you starred
• "Hard words" picks the pairs you got wrong recently
 Build lists quickly 
• Photograph a vocabulary page, mark the area, and the word pairs are added to your list for review
• Get translation suggestions while you type
• Import pairs from CSV files; share lists and back them up as files
 AI on your terms 
Camera import and translation suggestions are optional. They can run entirely on your device with small models you download in Settings, or use a cloud AI provider with your own API key: Google Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral, or any compatible server. Voclet has no server of its own.
 Private by design 
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your lists stay on your device
• Free and open-source software (Apache 2.0)
 Languages 
Word lists in English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish and Hungarian, in any combination. The app itself is available in the same thirteen languages.
Made for tablets, works on phones. Light and dark themes.
